+/// Resolve a session identifier (UUID or name) to the UUID used as the JSONL file stem.
+/// Priority: exact session_id in DB → session_name in DB → customTitle scan of JSONL files → input as-is.
+fn resolve_session_id(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, input: &str) -> String {
+    if conn.query_row(
+        "SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?1",
+        rusqlite::params![input], |_| Ok(()),
+    ).is_ok() {
+        return input.to_string();
     }
 
+    if let Ok(id) = conn.query_row(
+        "SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE session_name = ?1 LIMIT 1",
+        rusqlite::params![input], |row| row.get::<_, String>(0),
+    ) {
+        return id;
+    }
+
+    if let Some(id) = find_jsonl_by_title(input) {
+        return id;
+    }
+
+    input.to_string()
+}
+
+fn find_jsonl_by_title(title: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
+    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
+    for dir in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()?.flatten() {
+        for file in std::fs::read_dir(dir.path()).ok()?.flatten() {
+            let path = file.path();
+            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some("jsonl") { continue; }
+            let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) else { continue };
+            for line in content.lines() {
+                let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(line) else { continue };
+                if v["type"].as_str() == Some("custom-title")
+                    && v["customTitle"].as_str() == Some(title)
+                {
+                    if let Some(stem) = path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
+                        return Some(stem.to_string());
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+

> AGENT

Here's a summary of the uncommitted changes across the three modified files:

---

**`src/commands/clean.rs`** — Major improvement to session resolution

- Added `resolve_session_id()` which lets you pass either a UUID or a session name to `clean`. It tries: exact UUID match in DB → name match in DB → scan JSONL files for a `customTitle` match → falls back to the raw input.
- `entire clean` is now non-fatal — it prints a warning instead of bailing if the external command fails or the session is already gone.

---

**`src/commands/show.rs`** — Added delete action to the session pager

- Introduced a `PagerOutcome` enum (`Quit`, `Resume`, `Delete`) replacing the old `bool` return from `pager()`.
- Pressing `d` in the pager prompts "Delete session? Press y to confirm", and confirming calls `clean::run()` to remove it.
- Any other key cancels the pending delete. The status bar hint was updated accordingly.

---

**`src/commands/status.rs`** — Visual distinction for backed-up vs. local-only sessions

- Added a `backed_up: bool` field to `RepoSession` — `true` for sessions tracked in the gossamer DB, `false` for locally-discovered JSONL files not yet indexed.
- Backed-up sessions render brighter (white name, blue branch, colored agent, `*` dot); local-only sessions render dimmed (grays, `·` dot).

51	pub fn run() -> Result<()> {
52	    let conn = db::connect()?;
53	    let repos = fetch_repos(&conn)?;
54	
55	    if repos.is_empty() {
56	        println!("No repositories tracked. Run `gossamer init` in a git repo to get started.");
57	        return Ok(());
58	    }
59	
60	    // The shell wrapper sets GOSSAMER_CDPATH to a temp file path.
61	    // We write the selected directory there instead of stdout, avoiding all
62	    // the stdout-capture / /dev/tty complexity.
63	    let cd_file = std::env::var("GOSSAMER_CDPATH").ok();
64	
65	    if !io::stdout().is_terminal() && cd_file.is_none() {
66	        // Plain list when truly non-interactive (piped, no wrapper)
67	        let cwd = env::current_dir().ok().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string());
68	        let current_dir = cwd.as_deref().and_then(|cwd| {
69	            repos.iter().find(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())).map(|r| r.directory.as_str())
70	        });
71	        for repo in &repos {
72	            let is_cur = current_dir == Some(repo.directory.as_str());
73	            let dot = if is_cur { "*" } else { " " };
74	            println!("{dot} {}  {}  {}", repo.name, repo.directory, repo.remote);
75	        }
76	        return Ok(());
77	    }
78	
79	    // Register panic hook to restore terminal
80	    let orig_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
81	    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
82	        let mut out = io::stdout();
83	        let _ = execute!(out, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show);
84	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
85	        orig_hook(info);
86	    }));
87	
88	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
89	    terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
90	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide)?;
91

136	fn tui_loop(stdout: &mut impl Write, repos: &[Repository], has_cd: bool, start_repo: Option<usize>) -> Result<Option<TuiOutcome>> {
137	    let cwd = env::current_dir().ok().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string());
138	    let current_repo_dir = cwd.as_deref().and_then(|cwd| {
139	        repos.iter().find(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())).map(|r| r.directory.as_str())
140	    });
141	
142	    let start_sel = cwd.as_deref()
143	        .and_then(|cwd| repos.iter().position(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())))
144	        .unwrap_or(0);
145	
146	    let initial = if let Some(idx) = start_repo.filter(|&i| i < repos.len()) {
147	        let sessions = load_sessions(&repos[idx].directory);
148	        let worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[idx].directory);
149	        Screen::Sessions { repo_idx: idx, sel: 0, sessions, worktrees }
150	    } else {
151	        Screen::Repos { sel: start_sel }
152	    };
153	
154	    // Navigation stack — back pops; when empty the TUI exits.
155	    let mut stack: Vec<Screen> = vec![initial];
156	
157	    // Commands produced inside match arms, executed after the borrow ends.
158	    enum Cmd {
159	        None,
160	        Break,
161	        Back,
162	        PushSessions(usize),
163	        Cd(String),
164	        ShowSession(String),
165	        ResumeSession(String),
166	        Search(String),
167	        NewWorktree(String), // branch name
168	        NewSession(NewSessionConfig),
169	        Redraw,
170	    }
171	
172	    loop {
173	        let (w, h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
174	        let w = w as usize;
175	        let h = h as usize;
176	
177	        match stack.last().unwrap() {
178	            Screen::Repos { sel } => draw_repos(stdout, repos, *sel, current_repo_dir, w, h, has_cd)?,
179	            Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, sel, sessions, worktrees } => {
180	                draw_sessions(stdout, repos, *repo_idx, sessions, worktrees, *sel, w, h)?
181	            }
182	        }
183	
184	        let cmd = match event::read()? {
185	            Event::Key(k) => match stack.last_mut().unwrap() {
186	                Screen::Repos { sel } => match k.code {
187	                    KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => Cmd::Break,
188	                    KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if *sel > 0 { *sel -= 1; } Cmd::None }
189	                    KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if *sel + 1 < repos.len() { *sel += 1; } Cmd::None }
190	                    KeyCode::Char('g') => { *sel = 0; Cmd::None }
191	                    KeyCode::Char('G') => { *sel = repos.len().saturating_sub(1); Cmd::None }
192	                    KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right => Cmd::PushSessions(*sel),
193	                    KeyCode::Char('c') if has_cd => Cmd::Cd(repos[*sel].directory.clone()),
194	                    KeyCode::Char('s') => {
195	                        let repo_dir = repos[*sel].directory.clone();
196	                        match new_session_wizard(stdout, &repo_dir, w, h) {
197	                            Some(cfg) => Cmd::NewSession(cfg),
198	                            None => Cmd::Redraw,
199	                        }
200	                    }
201	                    KeyCode::Char('/') => match collect_search_query(stdout, w, h) {
202	                        Some(q) if !q.trim().is_empty() => Cmd::Search(q),
203	                        _ => Cmd::Redraw,
204	                    },
205	                    _ => Cmd::None,
206	                },
207	                Screen::Sessions { sel, sessions, repo_idx, .. } => match k.code {
208	                    KeyCode::Char('q') => Cmd::Break,
209	                    KeyCode::Esc | KeyCode::Char('h') | KeyCode::Left => Cmd::Back,
210	                    KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if *sel > 0 { *sel -= 1; } Cmd::None }
211	                    KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if *sel + 1 < sessions.len() { *sel += 1; } Cmd::None }
212	                    KeyCode::Char('g') => { *sel = 0; Cmd::None }
213	                    KeyCode::Char('G') => { *sel = sessions.len().saturating_sub(1); Cmd::None }
214	                    KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right => {

238	                },
239	            },
240	            Event::Resize(_, _) => Cmd::Redraw,
241	            _ => Cmd::None,
242	        };
243	
244	        match cmd {
245	            Cmd::None => {}
246	            Cmd::Break => break,
247	            Cmd::Back => {
248	                stack.pop();
249	                if stack.is_empty() { break; }
250	            }
251	            Cmd::PushSessions(idx) => {
252	                let sessions = load_sessions(&repos[idx].directory);
253	                let worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[idx].directory);
254	                stack.push(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx: idx, sel: 0, sessions, worktrees });
255	            }
256	            Cmd::Cd(path) => return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::CdTo(path))),
257	            Cmd::ResumeSession(id) => return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::ResumeSession(id))),
258	            Cmd::ShowSession(id) => {
259	                execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
260	                terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
261	                let _ = super::show::run(&id);
262	                terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();
263	                execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();
264	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
265	            }
266	            Cmd::Search(query) => {
267	                execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
268	                terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
269	                let _ = super::search::run(&query, 10);
270	                terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();
271	                execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();
272	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
273	            }
274	            Cmd::NewWorktree(branch) => {
275	                if let Some(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, worktrees, .. }) = stack.last_mut() {
276	                    let repo_dir = &repos[*repo_idx].directory;
277	                    let notification = create_worktree(repo_dir, &branch);
278	                    // Refresh the worktree list whether or not it succeeded.
279	                    *worktrees = fetch_worktrees(repo_dir);
280	                    // Show the result in the status bar until the next keypress.
281	                    let (tw, th) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
282	                    let msg: String = notification.chars().take(tw as usize).collect();
283	                    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", msg, width = tw as usize);
284	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, th - 1)).ok();
285	                    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m").ok();
286	                    stdout.flush().ok();
287	                }
288	            }
289	            Cmd::NewSession(cfg) => {
290	                // Create worktree if requested, then launch the agent.
291	                let launch_dir = if let Some(ref branch) = cfg.branch {
292	                    let _ = create_worktree(&cfg.repo_dir, branch);
293	                    if let Some(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, worktrees, .. }) = stack.last_mut() {
294	                        *worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[*repo_idx].directory);
295	                    }
296	                    let repo_path = std::path::Path::new(&cfg.repo_dir);
297	                    let parent = repo_path.parent().unwrap_or(repo_path);
298	                    let repo_name = repo_path.file_name()
299	                        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
300	                        .unwrap_or_else(|| "repo".to_string());
301	                    parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{}", branch)).to_string_lossy().to_string()
302	                } else {
303	                    cfg.repo_dir.clone()
304	                };
305	
306	                // Copy prompt to clipboard as a convenience.
307	                let prompt = cfg.prompt.trim().to_string();
308	                if !prompt.is_empty() {
309	                    if let Ok(mut child) = std::process::Command::new("pbcopy")
310	                        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
311	                        .spawn()
312	                    {
313	                        if let Some(stdin) = child.stdin.as_mut() {
314	                            let _ = stdin.write_all(prompt.as_bytes());
315	                        }
316	                        let _ = child.wait();
317	                    }
318	                }
319	
320	                let session_name = cfg.session_name.trim().to_string();
321	                return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::LaunchAgent {
322	                    cli: cfg.agent_cli,
323	                    cwd: launch_dir,
324	                    session_name,
325	                    prompt,
326	                }));
327	            }
328	            Cmd::Redraw => { execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok(); }
329	        }
330	    }
331	
332	    Ok(None)
333	}

335	// ── Renderers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
336	
337	fn draw_repos(
338	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
339	    repos: &[Repository],
340	    sel: usize,
341	    current_repo_dir: Option<&str>,
342	    w: usize,
343	    h: usize,
344	    has_cd: bool,
345	) -> io::Result<()> {
346	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
347	
348	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
349	
350	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(1);
351	    let mut row = 0usize;
352	
353	    for (i, repo) in repos.iter().enumerate() {
354	        if row >= content_h { break }
355	
356	        let is_sel = i == sel;
357	        let is_cur = current_repo_dir == Some(repo.directory.as_str());
358	        let dot_col = if is_cur { "38;5;82" } else { "38;5;240" };
359	
360	        let line = format!(
361	            "\x1b[{dot_col}m*\x1b[0m \x1b[38;5;255m{}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;240m{}  {}\x1b[0m",
362	            repo.name, repo.directory, repo.remote
363	        );
364	
365	        print_row(stdout, &line, is_sel, SEL_BG, w, row as u16)?;
366	        row += 1;
367	    }
368	
369	    // Clear remaining rows
370	    while row < content_h {
371	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
372	        row += 1;
373	    }
374	
375	    // Status bar
376	    let cd_hint = if has_cd { "   c: cd" } else { "" };
377	    let bar = format!(
378	        "  {} repos   ↑↓/jk navigate   space: sessions   s: new session   /: search{}   q: quit  ",
379	        repos.len(), cd_hint
380	    );
381	    draw_status(stdout, &bar, w, h)?;
382	
383	    stdout.flush()
384	}
385	
386	fn draw_sessions(
387	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
388	    repos: &[Repository],
389	    repo_idx: usize,
390	    sessions: &[RepoSession],
391	    worktrees: &[RepoWorktree],
392	    sel: usize,
393	    w: usize,
394	    h: usize,
395	) -> io::Result<()> {
396	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
397	
398	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
399	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[1;38;5;229m{}\x1b[0m", repos[repo_idx].name)?;
400	    execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
401	
402	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2); // header + status bar
403	    let mut row = 1usize;
404	
405	    // ── Worktrees ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
406	    if !worktrees.is_empty() {
407	        for wt in worktrees.iter().take(content_h.saturating_sub(row + 1)) {
408	            if row >= content_h { break; }
409	
410	            let (branch_col, branch_label) = if wt.branch == "(detached)" {
411	                ("38;5;196", format!("detached:{}", &wt.head))
412	            } else if wt.is_main {
413	                ("38;5;229", wt.branch.clone())   // gold — main worktree
414	            } else {
415	                ("38;5;75",  wt.branch.clone())   // blue — linked worktree
416	            };
417	
418	            let path_short = short_path_s(&wt.path);
419	            let line = format!(
420	                "\x1b[38;5;240m  @ \x1b[{branch_col}m{branch_label}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;240m{path_short}\x1b[0m"
421	            );
422	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16))?;
423	            write!(stdout, "{line}")?;
424	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
425	            row += 1;
426	        }
427	
428	        // Blank separator between worktrees and sessions
429	        if row < content_h {
430	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
431	            row += 1;
432	        }
433	    }
434	
435	    // ── Sessions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
436	    let sessions_start = row;
437	    let sessions_h = content_h.saturating_sub(sessions_start);
438	    let scroll = if sel >= sessions_h { sel + 1 - sessions_h } else { 0 };
439	
440	    if sessions.is_empty() {
441	        if row < content_h {
442	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16))?;
443	            write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;240m  no sessions found\x1b[0m")?;
444	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
445	            row += 1;
446	        }
447	    } else {
448	        for (i, s) in sessions.iter().enumerate().skip(scroll) {
449	            if row >= content_h { break; }
450	
451	            let id_short: String = s.session_id.chars().take(8).collect();
452	            let ts = relative_time(s.updated_at);
453	            let name = s.session_name.trim();
454	            let age = (Utc::now() - s.updated_at).num_seconds().max(0);
455	            let dot_col = match age {
456	                a if a < 900   => "38;5;82",
457	                a if a < 3_600 => "38;5;214",
458	                _              => "38;5;240",
459	            };
460	
461	            let (name_col, meta_col, dot_char) = if s.backed_up {
462	                ("38;5;255", "38;5;240", "*")
463	            } else {
464	                ("38;5;242", "38;5;238", "·")
465	            };
466	            let branch_col = if s.backed_up { "38;5;75" } else { "38;5;239" };
467	            let branch_part = if s.branch.is_empty() {
468	                String::new()
469	            } else {
470	                format!("  \x1b[{branch_col}m{}\x1b[0m", s.branch)
471	            };
472	            let agent_part = if s.agent.is_empty() {
473	                String::new()
474	            } else {
475	                let col = if s.backed_up { agent_color(&s.agent) } else { 239 };
476	                format!("  \x1b[38;5;{col}m{}\x1b[0m", s.agent)
477	            };
478	            let line = if name.is_empty() {
479	                format!("\x1b[{dot_col}m{dot_char}\x1b[{meta_col}m  {id_short}  {ts}\x1b[0m")
480	            } else {
481	                format!("\x1b[{dot_col}m{dot_char}\x1b[0m \x1b[{name_col}m{name}\x1b[0m{branch_part}{agent_part}\x1b[{meta_col}m  {id_short}  {ts}\x1b[0m")
482	            };
483	
484	            print_row(stdout, &line, i == sel, SEL_BG, w, row as u16)?;
485	            row += 1;
486	        }
487	    }
488	
489	    while row < content_h {
490	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
491	        row += 1;
492	    }
493	
494	    let bar = format!(
495	        "  {} sessions   ↑↓/jk navigate   space: view   r: resume   s: new session   n: new worktree   /: search   ←/h: back   q: quit  ",
496	        sessions.len()
497	    );
498	    draw_status(stdout, &bar, w, h)?;
499	
500	    stdout.flush()
501	}
502	
503	fn print_row(stdout: &mut impl Write, line: &str, selected: bool, bg: &str, w: usize, row: u16) -> io::Result<()> {
504	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row))?;
505	    if selected {
506	        let colored = with_bg(line, bg);
507	        let vis = visible_width(line);
508	        let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);
509	        write!(stdout, "\x1b[{bg}m{colored}{}\x1b[0m", " ".repeat(pad))?;
510	    } else {
511	        write!(stdout, "{line}")?;
512	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
513	    }
514	    Ok(())
515	}
516	
517	fn draw_status(stdout: &mut impl Write, bar: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
518	    let display: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();
519	    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", display, width = w);
520	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;
521	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")
522	}

524	// ── Worktree loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
525	
526	fn fetch_worktrees(repo_dir: &str) -> Vec<RepoWorktree> {
527	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
528	        .args(["worktree", "list", "--porcelain"])
529	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
530	        .output();
531	
532	    let Ok(out) = out else { return vec![]; };
533	    if !out.status.success() { return vec![]; }
534	    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
535	
536	    let mut result = Vec::new();
537	    let mut first = true;
538	
539	    // Each worktree block is separated by a blank line.
540	    for block in text.split("\n\n") {
541	        let mut path = String::new();
542	        let mut head = String::new();
543	        let mut branch = String::new();
544	        let mut detached = false;
545	
546	        for line in block.lines() {
547	            if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("worktree ") {
548	                path = v.to_string();
549	            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("HEAD ") {
550	                head = v.chars().take(8).collect();
551	            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("branch refs/heads/") {
552	                branch = v.to_string();
553	            } else if line == "detached" {
554	                detached = true;
555	            }
556	        }
557	
558	        if path.is_empty() { continue; }
559	        if detached { branch = "(detached)".to_string(); }
560	        if branch.is_empty() { continue; } // bare worktree — skip
561	
562	        result.push(RepoWorktree { path, branch, head, is_main: first });
563	        first = false;
564	    }
565	
566	    result
567	}
568	
569	// ── Session loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
570	
571	fn load_sessions(cwd_prefix: &str) -> Vec<RepoSession> {
572	    let mut sessions: Vec<RepoSession> = Vec::new();
573	
574	    // From DB
575	    if let Ok(conn) = db::connect() {
576	        if let Ok(mut stmt) = conn.prepare(
577	            "SELECT session_id, session_name, updated_at, agent_name FROM sessions WHERE cwd LIKE ?1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC"
578	        ) {
579	            let prefix_pattern = format!("{cwd_prefix}%");
580	            let _ = stmt.query_map([&prefix_pattern], |row| {
581	                let ts_str: String = row.get(2)?;
582	                let updated_at = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str)
583	                    .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))
584	                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now());
585	                Ok(RepoSession {
586	                    session_id: row.get(0)?,
587	                    session_name: row.get(1)?,
588	                    updated_at,
589	                    branch: String::new(),
590	                    agent: row.get(3)?,
591	                    backed_up: true,
592	                })
593	            }).map(|rows| {
594	                for r in rows.flatten() { sessions.push(r); }
595	            });
596	        }
597	    }
598	
599	    // From ~/.claude/projects/ — refresh existing DB sessions and add new ones
600	    if let Ok(home) = std::env::var("HOME") {
601	        let projects = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
602	        if let Ok(dirs) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects) {
603	            for dir_entry in dirs.flatten() {
604	                let dir = dir_entry.path();
605	                if !dir.is_dir() { continue }
606	                if let Ok(files) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) {
607	                    for f in files.flatten() {
608	                        let path = f.path();
609	                        if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some("jsonl") { continue }
610	                        let session_id = match path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
611	                            Some(s) => s.to_string(),
612	                            None => continue,
613	                        };
614	
615	                        let file_mtime = f.metadata().ok()
616	                            .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
617	                            .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
618	                            .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
619	
620	                        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&path) else { continue };
621	                        let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);
622	                        let mut session_name = String::new();
623	                        let mut cwd_found = String::new();
624	                        let mut last_prompt = String::new();
625	                        let mut git_branch = String::new();
626	
627	                        for line in reader.lines().flatten() {
628	                            let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };
629	                            match v["type"].as_str() {
630	                                Some("custom-title") => {
631	                                    if let Some(t) = v["customTitle"].as_str() { session_name = t.to_string(); }
632	                                }
633	                                Some("user") | Some("system") => {
634	                                    if cwd_found.is_empty() {
635	                                        if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str() { cwd_found = c.to_string(); }
636	                                    }
637	                                }
638	                                _ => {}
639	                            }
640	                            if v["type"].as_str() == Some("user") {
641	                                if let Some(t) = user_text(&v["message"]["content"]) {
642	                                    last_prompt = t;
643	                                }
644	                            }
645	                            // Track the most recent branch seen in this session
646	                            if let Some(b) = v["gitBranch"].as_str() {
647	                                if !b.is_empty() { git_branch = b.to_string(); }
648	                            }
649	                        }
650	
651	                        let display_name = if !session_name.is_empty() { session_name } else { last_prompt };
652	
653	                        if let Some(existing) = sessions.iter_mut().find(|s| s.session_id == session_id) {
654	                            // Refresh the name, timestamp, and branch from live JSONL
655	                            if !display_name.is_empty() { existing.session_name = display_name; }
656	                            if file_mtime > existing.updated_at { existing.updated_at = file_mtime; }
657	                            if !git_branch.is_empty() { existing.branch = git_branch; }
658	                            continue;
659	                        }
660	
661	                        if !cwd_found.starts_with(cwd_prefix) { continue }
662	
663	                        sessions.push(RepoSession {
664	                            session_id,
665	                            session_name: display_name,
666	                            updated_at: file_mtime,
667	                            branch: git_branch,
668	                            agent: String::new(),
669	                            backed_up: false,
670	                        });
671	                    }
672	                }
673	            }
674	        }
675	    }
676	
677	    sessions.sort_by(|a, b| b.updated_at.cmp(&a.updated_at));
678	    sessions
679	}

681	// ── Text input prompt ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
682	
683	/// Generic single-line input shown in the status bar. Returns None on Esc.
684	fn collect_text_input(stdout: &mut impl Write, prefix: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<String> {
685	    let mut value = String::new();
686	    execute!(stdout, cursor::Show).ok();
687	    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
688	
689	    loop {
690	        match event::read().ok()? {
691	            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {
692	                KeyCode::Esc => {
693	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::Hide).ok();
694	                    return None;
695	                }
696	                KeyCode::Enter => {
697	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::Hide).ok();
698	                    return Some(value);
699	                }
700	                KeyCode::Backspace => {
701	                    value.pop();
702	                    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
703	                }
704	                KeyCode::Char(c) => {
705	                    value.push(c);
706	                    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
707	                }
708	                _ => {}
709	            },
710	            _ => {}
711	        }
712	    }
713	}
714	
715	fn draw_input_bar(stdout: &mut impl Write, prefix: &str, value: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
716	    let prefix_len = prefix.chars().count();
717	    let text: String = value.chars().take(w.saturating_sub(prefix_len + 2)).collect();
718	    let content = format!("{prefix}{text}");
719	    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", content, width = w);
720	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;
721	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")?;
722	    let col = (prefix_len + text.chars().count()).min(w.saturating_sub(1)) as u16;
723	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(col, (h - 1) as u16))?;
724	    stdout.flush()
725	}
726	
727	fn collect_search_query(stdout: &mut impl Write, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<String> {
728	    collect_text_input(stdout, "  / ", w, h)
729	}

731	// ── New session wizard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
732	
733	/// A 4-step panel drawn over the bottom of the screen. Each completed step
734	/// stays visible with its confirmed value while the user fills the next one.
735	fn new_session_wizard(stdout: &mut impl Write, repo_dir: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<NewSessionConfig> {
736	    const LABEL_W: usize = 24;
737	    // Panel rows: title, blank, agent, branch, name, prompt, blank  (7 rows + 1 status bar)
738	    const PANEL_H: usize = 7;
739	
740	    let panel_top = h.saturating_sub(PANEL_H + 1);
741	
742	    let mut step = 0usize;           // 0=agent 1=branch 2=name 3=prompt
743	    let mut agent_sel = 0usize;
744	    let mut confirmed_agent = 0usize;
745	    let mut inputs = [String::new(), String::new(), String::new()]; // branch, name, prompt
746	
747	    execute!(stdout, cursor::Show).ok();
748	
749	    loop {
750	        // ── Draw panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
751	        // Title row
752	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, panel_top as u16)).ok();
753	        write!(stdout, "\x1b[1;38;5;229m  New Session\x1b[0m").ok();
754	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine)).ok();
755	
756	        // Blank separator
757	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (panel_top + 1) as u16)).ok();
758	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine)).ok();
759	
760	        let step_rows  = [panel_top + 2, panel_top + 3, panel_top + 4, panel_top + 5];
761	        let step_labels = ["  Agent", "  Worktree branch", "  Session name", "  Prompt"];
762	
763	        for (i, (&row, &label)) in step_rows.iter().zip(step_labels.iter()).enumerate() {
764	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16)).ok();
765	            let lpart = format!("{label:<LABEL_W$}");
766	
767	            if i < step {
768	                // Completed — dim label, value in colour
769	                let val = if i == 0 {
770	                    let (name, _, col) = AGENTS[confirmed_agent];
771	                    format!("\x1b[38;5;{col}m{name}\x1b[0m")
772	                } else {
773	                    let v = inputs[i - 1].trim();

789	                        }
790	                    }

795	            } else {
796	                // Future step — very dim label only

798	            }

812	        } else {
813	            "  type to enter   enter: next   esc: cancel  "
814	        };

830	                    return None;
831	                }

833	                    if agent_sel > 0 { agent_sel -= 1; }
834	                }

837	                }
838	                KeyCode::Backspace if step > 0 => {

840	                }
841	                KeyCode::Char(c) if step > 0 && !k.modifiers.contains(crossterm::event::KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
842	                    inputs[step - 1].push(c);
843	                }

846	                    1 | 2 => { step += 1; }

850	                        let branch_raw = inputs[0].trim().to_string();

870	fn create_worktree(repo_dir: &str, branch: &str) -> String {
871	    let repo_path = std::path::Path::new(repo_dir);
872	    let parent = match repo_path.parent() {
873	        Some(p) => p,
874	        None => return "Error: cannot determine repo parent directory".to_string(),
875	    };
876	    let repo_name = repo_path
877	        .file_name()
878	        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
879	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "repo".to_string());
880	    let wt_path = parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{branch}"));
881	
882	    // Try -b (new branch) first; fall back to checking out an existing branch.
883	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
884	        .args(["worktree", "add", "-b", branch, wt_path.to_str().unwrap_or("")])
885	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
886	        .output();
887	
888	    match out {
889	        Err(e) => format!("Error: {e}"),
890	        Ok(o) if o.status.success() => {
891	            format!("Created worktree: {}", short_path_s(wt_path.to_str().unwrap_or("")))
892	        }
893	        Ok(o) => {
894	            let msg = String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stderr);
895	            let first = msg.lines().find(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).unwrap_or("unknown error");
896	            format!("Error: {first}")
897	        }
898	    }
899	}
900	
901	fn agent_color(name: &str) -> u8 {
902	    if      name.contains("Claude")   { 214 }
903	    else if name.contains("Copilot")  { 99  }
904	    else if name.contains("Cursor")   { 33  }
905	    else if name.contains("Gemini")   { 75  }
906	    else if name.contains("Aider")    { 42  }
907	    else if name.contains("ChatGPT")  { 35  }
908	    else if name.contains("Windsurf") { 44  }
909	    else if name.contains("Amazon Q") { 208 }
910	    else                              { 245 }
911	}
912	
913	fn short_path_s(path: &str) -> String {
914	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_default();
915	    if !home.is_empty() && path.starts_with(&home) {
916	        format!("~{}", &path[home.len()..])
917	    } else {
918	        path.to_string()
919	    }
920	}
921	
922	fn user_text(content: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<String> {
923	    match content {
924	        serde_json::Value::String(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => Some(s.trim().to_string()),
925	        serde_json::Value::Array(blocks) => {
926	            blocks.iter().find_map(|b| {
927	                if b["type"].as_str() == Some("text") {
928	                    b["text"].as_str().filter(|t| !t.trim().is_empty()).map(|t| t.trim().to_string())
929	                } else { None }
930	            })
931	        }
932	        _ => None,
933	    }
934	}
935	
936	fn with_bg(s: &str, bg: &str) -> String {
937	    let reinsert = format!("\x1b[0m\x1b[{bg}m");
938	    let body = s.replace("\x1b[0m", &reinsert);
939	    format!("\x1b[{bg}m{body}")
940	}

942	fn visible_width(s: &str) -> usize {
943	    let mut w = 0usize;
944	    let mut chars = s.chars().peekable();
945	    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
946	        if c == '\x1b' {
947	            for nc in chars.by_ref() { if nc.is_ascii_alphabetic() { break; } }
948	        } else {
949	            w += 1;
950	        }
951	    }
952	    w
953	}
954	
955	fn relative_time(dt: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
956	    let secs = (Utc::now() - dt).num_seconds().max(0);
957	    if secs < 604_800 {
958	        match secs {
959	            s if s < 60     => "just now".to_string(),
960	            s if s < 3_600  => format!("{} min{} ago", s/60,     if s/60==1     {""} else {"s"}),
961	            s if s < 86_400 => format!("{} hr{} ago",  s/3_600,  if s/3_600==1  {""} else {"s"}),
962	            s               => format!("{} day{} ago", s/86_400, if s/86_400==1 {""} else {"s"}),
963	        }
964	    } else {
965	        dt.with_timezone(&Local).format("%m/%d/%y").to_string()
966	    }
967	}

969	pub fn run_for_dir(repo_dir: &str) -> Result<()> {
970	    let conn = db::connect()?;
971	    let repos = fetch_repos(&conn)?;
972	    let start = repos.iter().position(|r| r.directory == repo_dir);
973	
974	    let orig_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
975	    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
976	        let mut out = io::stdout();
977	        let _ = execute!(out, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show);
978	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
979	        orig_hook(info);
980	    }));
981	
982	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
983	    terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
984	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide)?;
985	
986	    let outcome = tui_loop(&mut stdout, &repos, false, start);
987	
988	    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show)?;
989	    terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;
990	
991	    match outcome? {
992	        Some(TuiOutcome::ResumeSession(session_id)) => {
993	            std::process::Command::new("claude")
994	                .arg("--resume")
995	                .arg(&session_id)
996	                .status()
997	                .ok();
998	        }
999	        Some(TuiOutcome::LaunchAgent { cli, cwd, session_name, prompt }) => {
1000	            use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
1001	            let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(&cli);
1002	            if !cwd.is_empty() { cmd.current_dir(&cwd); }
1003	            if !session_name.is_empty() { cmd.args(["-n", &session_name]); }
1004	            if !prompt.is_empty() { cmd.arg(&prompt); }
1005	            let err = cmd.exec();
1006	            eprintln!("Failed to launch {cli}: {err}");
1007	        }
1008	        _ => {}
1009	    }
1010	
1011	    Ok(())
1012	}
1013	
1014	pub fn fetch_repos(conn: &rusqlite::Connection) -> Result<Vec<Repository>> {
1015	    let mut stmt = conn.prepare("SELECT id, directory, remote, name FROM repositories ORDER BY name")?;
1016	    let repos = stmt.query_map([], |row| {
1017	        Ok(Repository {
1018	            id: row.get(0)?,
1019	            directory: row.get(1)?,
1020	            remote: row.get(2)?,
1021	            name: row.get(3)?,
1022	        })
1023	    })?
1024	    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
1025	    Ok(repos)
1026	}

> AGENT

Done. Here's what changed:

Before the session loop, I now compute three column widths across all sessions:
- `name_w` — max session name length (capped at 40)
- `branch_w` — max branch name length (0 if none have branches)
- `agent_w` — max agent name length (0 if none have agents)

Each row is then rendered by padding `name`, `branch`, and `agent` to exactly those widths using `format!("{:<width$}", ...)`. If a column is zero-width (e.g. no sessions have branches), it's omitted entirely so you don't get phantom whitespace.

The `id_short` and `ts` columns anchor the right side — they're always the same width naturally (`id_short` is always 8 chars, and `ts` values like `"5 mins ago"` / `"2 hrs ago"` are similar lengths).

# Entire CLI: `configure` Command & Setup Commands

## configure Command

**Purpose**: Adjust Entire settings within the current repository. For agent-specific hook management, use `entire agent` instead.

```bash
entire configure [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `--absolute-git-hook-path` | boolean | Embed complete binary path in Git hooks; necessary for GUI Git clients not sourcing shell profiles |
| `--checkpoint-remote <provider:owner/repo>` | string | Direct checkpoint branches to separate repository (e.g., `github:org/checkpoints-private`) |
| `-f, --force` | boolean | Compel reinstallation of the Entire Git hook |
| `--local` | boolean | Write settings to `.entire/settings.local.json` instead of `.entire/settings.json` |
| `--project` | boolean | Write settings to `.entire/settings.json` even if already present |
| `--skip-push-sessions` | boolean | Prevent automatic pushing of session logs during Git push |
| `--summarize-model <model>` | string | Designate the model hint for `checkpoint explain --generate` |
| `--summarize-provider <provider>` | string | Designate the provider for `checkpoint explain --generate` |
| `--telemetry` | boolean | Activate anonymous usage tracking (default: enabled) |

## Related Setup Commands

**`entire enable`**: "Initialize Entire in a Git repository. This installs the necessary Git hooks to capture AI coding sessions." Includes similar flags plus `--agent`, `--yes`, and `-y` for automation.

**`entire agent`**: Manages agent integration; subcommands include `add`, `remove`, and `list` for hook installation/removal.
```

# Enable and Agent Commands

## `enable` Command

**Purpose**: Initialize Entire in a Git repository by installing Git hooks for AI coding session capture.

**Syntax**: `entire enable [flags]`

**Flags**:

| Flag | Description | Type |
|------|-------------|------|
| `--absolute-git-hook-path` | Embed full binary path in Git hooks (required for GUI Git clients) | boolean |
| `--agent <name>` | Specify agent for hook setup; enables non-interactive mode | string |
| `--checkpoint-remote <provider:owner/repo>` | Push checkpoint branches to separate repository | string |
| `-f, --force` | Force reinstall hooks (removes existing ones first) | boolean |
| `--local` | Write to `.entire/settings.local.json` instead of `.entire/settings.json` | boolean |
| `--project` | Write to `.entire/settings.json` even if it exists | boolean |
| `--skip-push-sessions` | Disable automatic session log pushing on Git push | boolean |
| `--telemetry` | Enable anonymous usage analytics | boolean |
| `-y, --yes` | Accept defaults without prompting | boolean |

**Supported Agents**: `claude-code`, `codex`, `gemini`, `opencode`, `cursor`, `copilot-cli`, `factoryai-droid`, `pi`

---

## `agent` Command

**Purpose**: Manage agent integrations in the current repository.

**Syntax**: `entire agent <subcommand>`

**Subcommands**:

1. **`agent list`** — List installed and available agents
2. **`agent add <agent-name>`** — Install hooks for an agent
   - `--force`: Reinstall hooks even if present
   - `--local-dev`: Install hooks in local-dev mode
3. **`agent remove <agent-name>`** — Uninstall hooks for an agent
```

7	const HOOK_MARKER: &str = "# gossamer:";
8	const HOOK_SNIPPET: &str = r#"
9	# gossamer: re-index sessions after entireio checkpoints
10	if git log -1 --format="%B" | grep -q "Entire-Checkpoint:"; then
11	    gossamer index >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
12	fi"#;

15	const SHELL_SNIPPET: &str = r#"
16	# gossamer-shell-init: cd into a repo selected interactively
17	gr() {
18	  local tmp
19	  tmp=$(mktemp)
20	  GOSSAMER_CDPATH="$tmp" gossamer repo

27	pub fn run() -> Result<()> {
28	    let cwd = env::current_dir().context("failed to get current directory")?;
29	    let cwd_str = cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string();
30	
31	    let remote = git_remote(&cwd_str)?;
32	    let name = repo_name_from_remote(&remote);
33	
34	    let (has_settings, has_branch) = entire_check(&cwd_str);
35	    if has_settings {
36	        println!("Found .entire/settings.json — respecting existing entire configuration.");
37	    } else if has_branch {
38	        println!("Found entire/checkpoints/v1 branch — entire already initialized, skipping configure.");
39	    } else {
40	        println!("Running `entire configure`...");
41	        let status = Command::new("entire")
42	            .args(["configure", "--push-sessions=false"])
43	            .status()
44	            .context("`entire configure` failed to launch — is entireio installed?")?;
45	
46	        if !status.success() {
47	            anyhow::bail!("`entire configure` exited with status {}", status);
48	        }
49	    }
50	
51	    install_post_commit_hook(&cwd_str)?;
52	    install_claude_hook()?;
53	    install_shell_function()?;
54	
55	    let conn = db::connect()?;
56	
57	    let exists: bool = conn
58	        .query_row(
59	            "SELECT 1 FROM repositories WHERE directory = ?1",
60	            [&cwd_str],
61	            |_| Ok(true),
62	        )
63	        .unwrap_or(false);
64	
65	    if exists {
66	        println!("'{}' is already registered with gossamer.", name);
67	        return Ok(());
68	    }
69	
70	    conn.execute(
71	        "INSERT INTO repositories (directory, remote, name) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)",
72	        rusqlite::params![cwd_str, remote, name],
73	    )
74	    .context("failed to register repository")?;
75	
76	    println!("Initialized '{}' ({}).", name, cwd_str);
77	    Ok(())
78	}

80	fn entire_check(repo_dir: &str) -> (bool, bool) {
81	    let has_settings = std::path::Path::new(repo_dir)
82	        .join(".entire")
83	        .join("settings.json")
84	        .exists();
85	
86	    let has_branch = Command::new("git")
87	        .args(["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/entire/checkpoints/v1"])
88	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
89	        .status()
90	        .map(|s| s.success())
91	        .unwrap_or(false);
92	
93	    (has_settings, has_branch)
94	}

96	fn install_post_commit_hook(repo_dir: &str) -> Result<()> {
97	    let git_dir = git_common_dir(repo_dir)?;
98	    let hook_path = git_dir.join("hooks").join("post-commit");
99	
100	    if hook_path.exists() {
101	        let content = fs::read_to_string(&hook_path)?;
102	        if content.contains(HOOK_MARKER) {
103	            println!("post-commit hook already contains gossamer indexing, skipping.");
104	            return Ok(());
105	        }
106	        let mut file = fs::OpenOptions::new().append(true).open(&hook_path)?;
107	        writeln!(file, "{}", HOOK_SNIPPET)?;
108	    } else {
109	        fs::create_dir_all(hook_path.parent().unwrap())?;
110	        fs::write(&hook_path, format!("#!/bin/sh\n{}\n", HOOK_SNIPPET))?;
111	    }
112	
113	    #[cfg(unix)]
114	    {
115	        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
116	        let mut perms = fs::metadata(&hook_path)?.permissions();
117	        perms.set_mode(0o755);
118	        fs::set_permissions(&hook_path, perms)?;
119	    }
120	
121	    println!("Installed post-commit hook at {}.", hook_path.display());
122	    Ok(())
123	}
124	
125	fn git_common_dir(repo_dir: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
126	    let out = Command::new("git")
127	        .args(["rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"])
128	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
129	        .output()
130	        .context("failed to run git")?;
131	
132	    if !out.status.success() {
133	        anyhow::bail!("could not locate .git directory");
134	    }
135	
136	    let rel = PathBuf::from(String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?.trim().to_string());
137	    Ok(if rel.is_absolute() {
138	        rel
139	    } else {
140	        PathBuf::from(repo_dir).join(rel)
141	    })
142	}
143	
144	fn git_remote(dir: &str) -> Result<String> {
145	    let out = Command::new("git")
146	        .args(["remote", "get-url", "origin"])
147	        .current_dir(dir)
148	        .output()
149	        .context("failed to run git")?;
150	
151	    if !out.status.success() {
152	        anyhow::bail!("not a git repository or no 'origin' remote is configured");
153	    }
154	
155	    Ok(String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?.trim().to_string())
156	}

158	fn install_claude_hook() -> Result<()> {
159	    let settings_path = dirs::home_dir()

161	        .join(".claude")
162	        .join("settings.json");

164	    let mut settings: Value = if settings_path.exists() {
165	        let raw = fs::read_to_string(&settings_path)?;
166	        serde_json::from_str(&raw).unwrap_or(json!({}))
167	    } else {
168	        json!({})
169	    };
170	
171	    let hooks_obj = settings
172	        .as_object_mut()
173	        .context("settings.json is not an object")?
174	        .entry("hooks")
175	        .or_insert(json!({}))
176	        .as_object_mut()
177	        .context("hooks is not an object")?;
178	
179	    // SessionStart
180	    {
181	        let start_hooks = hooks_obj
182	            .entry("SessionStart")
183	            .or_insert(json!([]))
184	            .as_array_mut()
185	            .context("SessionStart is not an array")?;
186	
187	        let already = start_hooks.iter().any(|e| {
188	            e.get("hooks")
189	                .and_then(Value::as_array)
190	                .map_or(false, |cmds| {
191	                    cmds.iter().any(|c| {
192	                        c.get("command").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("gossamer session-start")
193	                    })
194	                })
195	        });
196	        if !already {
197	            start_hooks.push(json!({
198	                "matcher": "",
199	                "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "gossamer session-start" }]
200	            }));
201	            println!("Registered Claude Code SessionStart hook.");
202	        } else {
203	            println!("Claude Code SessionStart hook already registered, skipping.");
204	        }
205	    }
206	
207	    // Stop
208	    {
209	        let stop_hooks = hooks_obj
210	            .entry("Stop")
211	            .or_insert(json!([]))
212	            .as_array_mut()
213	            .context("Stop is not an array")?;
214	
215	        let already = stop_hooks.iter().any(|e| {
216	            e.get("hooks")
217	                .and_then(Value::as_array)
218	                .map_or(false, |cmds| {
219	                    cmds.iter().any(|c| {
220	                        c.get("command").and_then(Value::as_str)
221	                            == Some("gossamer session-stop >/dev/null 2>&1")
222	                    })
223	                })
224	        });
225	        if !already {
226	            stop_hooks.push(json!({
227	                "matcher": "",
228	                "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "gossamer session-stop >/dev/null 2>&1" }]
229	            }));
230	            println!("Registered Claude Code Stop hook.");
231	        } else {
232	            println!("Claude Code Stop hook already registered, skipping.");
233	        }
234	    }
235	
236	    if let Some(parent) = settings_path.parent() {
237	        fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
238	    }
239	    fs::write(&settings_path, serde_json::to_string_pretty(&settings)?)?;
240	    println!("Claude Code hooks saved to {}.", settings_path.display());
241	    Ok(())
242	}

244	fn install_shell_function() -> Result<()> {
245	    let home = dirs::home_dir().context("could not find home directory")?;
246	
247	    // Detect which rc file to use based on $SHELL
248	    let shell = std::env::var("SHELL").unwrap_or_default();
249	    let rc_path = if shell.contains("zsh") {
250	        home.join(".zshrc")
251	    } else if shell.contains("bash") {
252	        // Prefer .bash_profile on macOS, .bashrc elsewhere
253	        let bp = home.join(".bash_profile");
254	        if bp.exists() { bp } else { home.join(".bashrc") }
255	    } else {
256	        // Unknown shell — skip silently
257	        println!("Shell function not installed (unknown shell '{shell}'). Add manually:");
258	        println!("  gr() {{ local p; p=$(gossamer repo); [[ -n \"$p\" ]] && cd \"$p\"; }}");
259	        return Ok(());
260	    };
261	
262	    // Check if already installed
263	    if rc_path.exists() {
264	        let content = fs::read_to_string(&rc_path)?;
265	        if content.contains(SHELL_MARKER) {
266	            println!("Shell function `gr` already in {}, skipping.", rc_path.display());
267	            return Ok(());
268	        }
269	    }
270	
271	    let mut file = fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(&rc_path)?;
272	    writeln!(file, "{}", SHELL_SNIPPET)?;
273	    println!("Added `gr` shell function to {}.", rc_path.display());
274	    println!("Run `source {}` or open a new terminal to activate it.", rc_path.display());
275	    Ok(())
276	}

278	fn repo_name_from_remote(remote: &str) -> String {
279	    remote
280	        .rsplit('/')
281	        .next()
282	        .unwrap_or(remote)
283	        .trim_end_matches(".git")
284	        .to_string()
285	}

11	#[derive(Parser)]
12	#[command(name = "gossamer", about = "Manage AI sessions with entireio")]
13	struct Cli {
14	    #[command(subcommand)]
15	    command: Commands,
16	}
17	
18	#[derive(Subcommand)]
19	enum Commands {
20	    /// Initialize gossamer in the current git repository
21	    Init,
22	    /// Print all repositories tracked by gossamer
23	    Repo,
24	    /// Print sessions from the past 3 days
25	    Sessions {
26	        /// Show all sessions regardless of age
27	        #[arg(long)]
28	        all: bool,
29	    },
30	    /// Scan checkpoint logs and index sessions into the database
31	    Index,
32	    /// Incrementally index only new checkpoint commits since the last index/refresh
33	    Refresh,
34	    /// Browse a session's messages interactively (arrow keys to navigate)
35	    Show {
36	        /// Session ID or path to a JSONL file
37	        session: String,
38	    },
39	    /// Semantic search across indexed sessions
40	    Search {
41	        /// Search query (separate words are joined into one query)
42	        #[arg(required = true)]
43	        query: Vec<String>,
44	        /// Number of results to return
45	        #[arg(short = 'n', long, default_value = "10")]
46	        top_k: usize,
47	    },
48	    /// Remove a session: runs `entire clean`, deletes from DB, removes search index entries
49	    Clean {
50	        /// Session ID to clean up
51	        session_id: String,
52	    },
53	    /// Attach an existing session with entireio and index it into witchcraft
54	    Attach {
55	        /// Session ID to attach
56	        session_id: String,
57	        /// Agent name passed to `entire attach`
58	        #[arg(short, long, default_value = "claude-code")]
59	        agent: String,
60	        /// Pass --force to `entire attach`
61	        #[arg(short, long)]
62	        force: bool,
63	    },
64	    /// Show or set gossamer configuration
65	    Config {
66	        /// Path to the witchcraft assets directory (enables semantic search)
67	        assets: Option<String>,
68	    },
69	    /// Called by the Claude Code SessionStart hook — reads JSON from stdin
70	    #[command(hide = true)]
71	    SessionStart,
72	    /// Called by the Claude Code Stop hook — ingests the finished session
73	    #[command(hide = true)]
74	    SessionStop,
75	}
76	
77	fn main() -> Result<()> {
78	    let cli = Cli::parse();
79	    match cli.command {
80	        Commands::Init => commands::init::run()?,
81	        Commands::Repo => commands::status::run()?,
82	        Commands::Sessions { all } => commands::sessions::run(all)?,
83	        Commands::Index => commands::index::run()?,
84	        Commands::Refresh => commands::refresh::run()?,
85	        Commands::Show { session } => commands::show::run(&session)?,
86	        Commands::Search { query, top_k } => commands::search::run(&query.join(" "), top_k)?,
87	        Commands::Clean { session_id } => commands::clean::run(&session_id)?,
88	        Commands::Attach { session_id, agent, force } => commands::attach::run(&session_id, &agent, force)?,
89	        Commands::Config { assets: Some(path) } => config::set_warp_assets(&path)?,
90	        Commands::Config { assets: None }       => config::show(),
91	        Commands::SessionStart => commands::session_start::run()?,
92	        Commands::SessionStop  => commands::session_stop::run()?,
93	    }
94	    Ok(())
95	}

k.code {\n                KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') => {\n                    if sel > 0 { sel -= 1; }\n                    draw_agent_list(stdout, agents, sel, list_top)?;\n                }\n Done. Here's what `gossamer init` now does when entire isn't yet configured:

**Step 1 — Agent picker** (interactive, raw mode)
```
  Agents  ↑↓/jk navigate  space toggle  enter confirm

  [x] claude-code           detected

Agents are pre-checked if their CLI binary is found in PATH (`claude`, `gemini`, `codex`, etc.). Cursor also checks `/Applications/Cursor.app`. Navigate with arrows/jk, space to toggle, enter to confirm.

**Steps 2–4 — y/n prompts** (single keypress, defaults shown)
```
  Auto-push sessions on git push? [y/N] no        ← default: skip

```

```
  Checkpoint remote (e.g. github:org/repo) (blank to skip): 
  Summarize provider (e.g. anthropic) (blank to skip): 
```
Summarize model is only asked if a provider was given.

    "allowManagedMcpServersOnly": {
      "description": "When true (and set in managed settings), allowedMcpServers is only read from managed settings. deniedMcpServers still merges from all sources, so users can deny servers for themselves. Users can still add their own MCP servers, but only the admin-defined allowlist applies.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "strictPluginOnlyCustomization": {
      "description": "When set in managed settings, blocks non-plugin customization sources for the listed surfaces. Array form locks specific surfaces (e.g. [\"skills\", \"hooks\"]); `true` locks all four; `false` is an explicit no-op. Blocked: ~/.claude/{surface}/, .claude/{surface}/ (project), settings.json hooks, .mcp.json. NOT blocked: managed (policySettings) sources, plugin-provided customizations. Composes with strictKnownMarketplaces for end-to-end admin control — plugins gated by marketplace allowlist, everything else blocked here.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "skills",
              "agents",
              "hooks",
              "mcp"
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    },

    "forceLoginMethod": {
      "description": "Force a specific login method: \"claudeai\" for Claude Pro/Max, \"console\" for Console billing",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "claudeai",
        "console"
      ]
    },
    "parentSettingsBehavior": {
      "description": "Controls whether the SDK parent tier (Options.managedSettings / --managed-settings) layers under this admin tier. \"first-wins\" (default): parent is dropped — admin tiers are the only policy source. \"merge\": parent's restrictive-only-filtered settings union under the admin winner. Has no effect when no admin tier exists (parent applies as the sole policy tier, still filtered restrictive-only).",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "first-wins",
        "merge"
      ]
    },
    "forceLoginOrgUUID": {
      "description": "Organization UUID to require for OAuth login. Accepts a single UUID string or an array of UUIDs (any one is permitted). When set in managed settings, login fails if the authenticated account does not belong to a listed organization.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "forceRemoteSettingsRefresh": {
      "description": "When set in managed settings, the CLI blocks startup until remote managed settings are freshly fetched, and exits if the fetch fails",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "otelHeadersHelper": {
      "description": "Path to a script that outputs OpenTelemetry headers",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "outputStyle": {
      "description": "Controls the output style for assistant responses",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "viewMode": {
      "description": "Default transcript view mode on startup",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "default",
        "verbose",
        "focus"
      ]
    },
    "language": {
      "description": "Preferred language for Claude responses and voice dictation (e.g., \"japanese\", \"spanish\")",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "skipWebFetchPreflight": {
      "description": "Skip the WebFetch blocklist check for enterprise environments with restrictive security policies",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "sandbox": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "failIfUnavailable": {
          "description": "Exit with an error at startup if sandbox.enabled is true but the sandbox cannot start (missing dependencies or unsupported platform). When false (default), a warning is shown and commands run unsandboxed. Intended for managed-settings deployments that require sandboxing as a hard gate.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "autoAllowBashIfSandboxed": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "allowUnsandboxedCommands": {
          "description": "Allow commands to run outside the sandbox via the dangerouslyDisableSandbox parameter. When false, the dangerouslyDisableSandbox parameter is completely ignored and all commands must run sandboxed. Default: true.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "network": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "allowedDomains": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "deniedDomains": {
              "description": "Domains that are always blocked, even if matched by allowedDomains. Supports the same wildcard syntax as allowedDomains. Merged from all settings sources regardless of allowManagedDomainsOnly.",
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "allowManagedDomainsOnly": {
              "description": "When true (and set in managed settings), only allowedDomains and WebFetch(domain:...) allow rules from managed settings are respected. User, project, local, and flag settings domains are ignored. Denied domains are still respected from all sources.",
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "allowUnixSockets": {
              "description": "macOS only: Unix socket paths to allow. Ignored on Linux (seccomp cannot filter by path).",
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "allowAllUnixSockets": {
              "description": "If true, allow all Unix sockets (disables blocking on both platforms).",
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "allowLocalBinding": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "allowMachLookup": {
              "description": "macOS only: Additional XPC/Mach service names to allow looking up. Supports trailing-wildcard prefix matching (e.g., \"com.apple.coresimulator.*\"). Needed for tools that communicate via XPC such as the iOS Simulator or Playwright.",
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "httpProxyPort": {
              "type": "number"
            },
            "socksProxyPort": {
              "type": "number"
            },
            "tlsTerminate": {
              "description": "[EXPERIMENTAL] Enable in-process TLS termination so the per-request filter can see HTTPS request bodies. Provide a CA cert+key, or omit both to have sandbox-runtime generate an ephemeral one for the session.",
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "caCertPath": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1
                },
                "caKeyPath": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1
                }
              },
              "additionalProperties": false
            }
          },
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "filesystem": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "allowWrite": {
              "description": "Additional paths to allow writing within the sandbox. Merged with paths from Edit(...) allow permission rules.",
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "denyWrite": {
              "description": "Additional paths to deny writing within the sandbox. Merged with paths from Edit(...) deny permission rules.",
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "denyRead": {
              "description": "Additional paths to deny reading within the sandbox. Merged with paths from Read(...) deny permission rules.",
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "allowRead": {
              "description": "Paths to re-allow reading within denyRead regions. Takes precedence over denyRead for matching paths.",
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "allowManagedReadPathsOnly": {
              "description": "When true (set in managed settings), only allowRead paths from policySettings are used.",
              "type": "boolean"
            }
          },
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "ignoreViolations": {
          "type": "object",
          "propertyNames": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        },
        "enableWeakerNestedSandbox": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "enableWeakerNetworkIsolation": {
          "description": "macOS only: Allow access to com.apple.trustd.agent in the sandbox. Needed for Go-based CLI tools (gh, gcloud, terraform, etc.) to verify TLS certificates when using httpProxyPort with a MITM proxy and custom CA. **Reduces security** — opens a potential data exfiltration vector through the trustd service. Default: false",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "excludedCommands": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "ripgrep": {
          "description": "Custom ripgrep configuration for bundled ripgrep support",
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "command": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "args": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "command"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "bwrapPath": {
          "description": "Linux/WSL only: Absolute path to the bwrap (bubblewrap) binary. Overrides auto-detection via PATH. Only honored from admin-controlled managed settings.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "socatPath": {
          "description": "Linux/WSL only: Absolute path to the socat binary used for the sandbox network proxy. Overrides auto-detection via PATH. Only honored from admin-controlled managed settings.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": {}

598	fn git_current_branch(cwd: &str) -> Option<String> {
599	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
600	        .args(["rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"])
601	        .current_dir(cwd)
602	        .output()
603	        .ok()?;
604	    if !out.status.success() { return None; }
605	    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
606	    if s.is_empty() || s == "HEAD" { None } else { Some(s) }
607	}
608	
609	fn create_resume_worktree(cwd: &str, branch: &str) -> Option<String> {
610	    let root_out = std::process::Command::new("git")
611	        .args(["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
612	        .current_dir(cwd)
613	        .output()
614	        .ok()?;
615	    if !root_out.status.success() { return None; }
616	    let repo_root = String::from_utf8_lossy(&root_out.stdout).trim().to_string();
617	
618	    let repo_path = std::path::Path::new(&repo_root);
619	    let parent = repo_path.parent()?;
620	    let repo_name = repo_path.file_name()?.to_str()?;
621	    let wt_path = parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{branch}"));
622	
623	    // Branch already exists; add a worktree pointing at it.
624	    let _ = std::process::Command::new("git")
625	        .args(["worktree", "add", wt_path.to_str()?, branch])
626	        .current_dir(&repo_root)
627	        .output();
628	
629	    if wt_path.exists() { Some(wt_path.to_string_lossy().to_string()) } else { None }
630	}

632	fn resume_via_entire(dir: &str) {
633	    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;

636	        .current_dir(dir)
637	        .output() else { eprintln!("entire resume failed"); return; };

639	    let cmd_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
640	    if cmd_str.is_empty() { eprintln!("entire resume returned no command"); return; }
641	
642	    let mut parts = cmd_str.split_whitespace();
643	    let Some(prog) = parts.next() else { return; };
644	    let args: Vec<&str> = parts.collect();
645	    let err = std::process::Command::new(prog).args(&args).current_dir(dir).exec();
646	    eprintln!("exec failed: {err}");
647	}

> AGENT

Yes — Claude Code sessions live as `.jsonl` files under `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-dir>/<session-id>.jsonl`. We can just check if that file exists before exec'ing claude. No API call needed; it's a local filesystem lookup.

The fix is a small `claude_session_exists(session_id)` helper, then use it in `do_resume` to decide: file present → exec claude, file absent → fall back to `entire resume`.

> TOOL

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/stephanostsoucas/p/gossamer/src/commands/show.rs",
  "old_string": "fn do_resume(agent: &str, session_id: &str, session_branch: &str, session_cwd: &str) {\n    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;\n\n    let current = git_current_branch(session_cwd);\n    let same_branch = !session_branch.is_empty()\n        && current.as_deref() == Some(session_branch);\n\n    if same_branch {\n        let err = std::process::Command::new(agent_cli(agent))\n            .arg(\"--resume\")\n            .arg(session_id)\n            .current_dir(session_cwd)\n            .exec();\n        eprintln!(\"exec failed: {err}\");\n    } else {\n        let dir = if !session_branch.is_empty() {\n            create_resume_worktree(session_cwd, session_branch)\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| session_cwd.to_string())\n        } else {\n            session_cwd.to_string()\n        };\n        resume_via_entire(&dir);\n    }\n}",
  "new_string": "fn claude_session_exists(session_id: &str) -> bool {\n    let home = match std::env::var(\"HOME\") { Ok(h) => h, Err(_) => return false };\n    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(home).join(\".claude/projects\");\n    let Ok(dirs) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects) else { return false };\n    dirs.flatten().any(|d| d.path().join(format!(\"{session_id}.jsonl\")).exists())\n}\n\nfn do_resume(agent: &str, session_id: &str, session_branch: &str, session_cwd: &str) {\n    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;\n\n    let current = git_current_branch(session_cwd);\n    let same_branch = !session_branch.is_empty()\n        && current.as_deref() == Some(session_branch);\n\n    let dir = if same_branch || session_branch.is_empty() {\n        session_cwd.to_string()\n    } else {\n        create_resume_worktree(session_cwd, session_branch)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| session_cwd.to_string())\n    };\n\n    if claude_session_exists(session_id) {\n        let err = std::process::Command::new(agent_cli(agent))\n            .arg(\"--resume\")\n            .arg(session_id)\n            .current_dir(&dir)\n            .exec();\n        eprintln!(\"exec failed: {err}\");\n    } else {\n        resume_via_entire(&dir);\n    }\n}"
}

> AGENT

Back to the original warning count. The Stop hook will reinstall momentarily. Here's what changed:

**Detection approach:** `claude_session_exists()` scans `~/.claude/projects/*/` for `<session-id>.jsonl`. Claude Code always writes this file for every session it knows about, so its presence is a reliable signal — no API call needed, just a filesystem `exists()` check.

**Fallback logic** (in the new `pub fn resume_session`):
- JSONL found → `exec claude --resume <id>` (replaces the process)
- JSONL absent → `entire resume` in the session's directory (which knows how to reconstruct the right resume command)

This covers all three resume entry points: the session pager (`r` key in `show.rs`), and both repo-screen resume handlers in `status.rs`.

> DEVELOPER

im `No conversation found with session ID: 67388535-7546-4454-b0a6-0a7894610496` - are we handling directories correctly? maybe we need to cd if the session didn't originate in our directory

> AGENT

The problem is that `claude --resume` only looks in `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/` for the current working directory. If we run it from the wrong directory (e.g. a worktree, or wherever gossamer was launched from), Claude looks in the wrong project folder and can't find the session.

The JSONL itself contains the original `cwd` field on the first user/system message. We can read that and use it as the `current_dir` for `claude --resume`, making the lookup reliable regardless of where gossamer is running from.

id: toolu_01GRmgxygCsYj49Vn1CCa9uN
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/stephanostsoucas/p/gossamer/src/commands/show.rs",
  "old_string": "fn claude_session_exists(session_id: &str) -> bool {\n    let home = match std::env::var(\"HOME\") { Ok(h) => h, Err(_) => return false };\n    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(home).join(\".claude/projects\");\n    let Ok(dirs) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects) else { return false };\n    dirs.flatten().any(|d| d.path().join(format!(\"{session_id}.jsonl\")).exists())\n}",
  "new_string": "/// Find a Claude session by ID. Returns the session's original cwd (from the JSONL) if found,\n/// so `claude --resume` can be run from the correct project directory.\nfn find_claude_session_cwd(session_id: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    use std::io::BufRead;\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").ok()?;\n    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(\".claude/projects\");\n    for dir in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()?.flatten() {\n        let jsonl = dir.path().join(format!(\"{session_id}.jsonl\"));\n        if !jsonl.exists() { continue; }\n        // Extract the cwd from the first entry that has one.\n        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&jsonl) else { return Some(String::new()); };\n        for line in std::io::BufReader::new(file).lines().flatten() {\n            let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };\n            if matches!(v[\"type\"].as_str(), Some(\"user\") | Some(\"system\")) {\n                if let Some(c) = v[\"cwd\"].as_str() {\n                    return Some(c.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return Some(String::new()); // file exists but no cwd entry\n    }\n    None\n}"
}

Clean. The Stop hook will reinstall. Here's what changed:

Instead of `claude_session_exists` (a boolean check), we now have `find_claude_session_cwd` which reads the JSONL and extracts the `cwd` field from the first user/system message. That's the directory where the session was originally created — the exact directory Claude Code will look in when searching `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/`.

`resume_session` now runs `claude --resume` from that extracted cwd rather than whatever directory gossamer happens to be running from. The `fallback_cwd` (from the gossamer DB) is only used if the JSONL doesn't exist at all (→ `entire resume`) or if the extracted cwd no longer exists on disk.

47	pub fn run_at(session_id: &str, start_ts: Option<&str>) -> Result<()> {
48	    let path = find_session(session_id)
49	        .with_context(|| format!("no session file found for '{session_id}'"))?;
50	
51	    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)
52	        .with_context(|| format!("cannot read {}", path.display()))?;
53	
54	    // Look up agent name from the gossamer DB using the session UUID (file stem).
55	    let agent = path.file_stem()
56	        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
57	        .and_then(|uuid| {
58	            let conn = crate::db::connect().ok()?;
59	            conn.query_row(
60	                "SELECT agent_name FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?1",
61	                [uuid],
62	                |row| row.get::<_, String>(0),
63	            ).ok()
64	        })
65	        .unwrap_or_default();
66	
67	    let cards = parse(&raw, &agent);
68	    if cards.is_empty() {
69	        println!("No messages found.");
70	        return Ok(());
71	    }
72	
73	    // Extract branch and cwd from the Header before cards are consumed by pager.
74	    let session_branch = cards.iter().find_map(|c| {
75	        if let Card::Header { branch, .. } = c { Some(branch.clone()) } else { None }
76	    }).unwrap_or_default();
77	    let session_cwd = cards.iter().find_map(|c| {
78	        if let Card::Header { cwd, .. } = c { Some(cwd.clone()) } else { None }
79	    }).unwrap_or_default();
80	
81	    match pager(cards, start_ts)? {
82	        PagerOutcome::Resume => do_resume(&agent, session_id, &session_branch, &session_cwd),
83	        PagerOutcome::Delete => { super::clean::run(session_id)?; }
84	        PagerOutcome::Quit   => {}
85	    }
86	
87	    Ok(())
88	}

90	fn find_session(id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
91	    let p = PathBuf::from(id);
92	    if p.exists() { return Some(p); }
93	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
94	    let projects = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
95	    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()? {
96	        let dir = entry.ok()?.path();
97	        let candidate = dir.join(format!("{id}.jsonl"));
98	        if candidate.exists() { return Some(candidate); }
99	    }
100	    None
101	}
