103	// ── Parsing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
104	
105	fn parse(raw: &str, agent: &str) -> Vec<Card> {
106	    let mut tool_names: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
107	    for line in raw.lines() {
108	        if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(line) {
109	            if let Some(blocks) = v["message"]["content"].as_array() {
110	                for b in blocks {
111	                    if b["type"].as_str() == Some("tool_use") {
112	                        if let (Some(id), Some(name)) = (b["id"].as_str(), b["name"].as_str()) {
113	                            tool_names.insert(id.to_string(), name.to_string());
114	                        }
115	                    }
116	                }
117	            }
118	        }
119	    }
120	
121	    let mut cards: Vec<Card> = Vec::new();
122	    let mut first_cwd    = String::new();
123	    let mut first_branch = String::new();
124	    let mut first_ts     = String::new();
125	    let mut title: Option<String> = None;
126	
127	    for line in raw.lines() {
128	        if line.trim().is_empty() { continue; }
129	        let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(line) else { continue };
130	        let ts = v["timestamp"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
131	        if first_ts.is_empty() && !ts.is_empty() { first_ts = ts.clone(); }
132	
133	        match v["type"].as_str() {
134	            Some("custom-title") => {
135	                title = v["customTitle"].as_str().map(str::to_string);
136	            }
137	            Some("system") => {
138	                if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str() { if first_cwd.is_empty() { first_cwd = c.to_string(); } }
139	                let content = v["content"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
140	                if !content.is_empty() {
141	                    let subtype = v["subtype"].as_str().unwrap_or("system").replace('_', " ");
142	                    cards.push(Card::System { ts, subtype, content });
143	                }
144	            }
145	            Some("user") => {
146	                if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str()       { if first_cwd.is_empty()    { first_cwd    = c.to_string(); } }
147	                if let Some(b) = v["gitBranch"].as_str() { if first_branch.is_empty() { first_branch = b.to_string(); } }
148	                let parts = parse_user(&v["message"]["content"], &tool_names);
149	                if !parts.is_empty() { cards.push(Card::UserMsg { ts, parts }); }
150	            }
151	            Some("assistant") => {
152	                let parts = parse_asst(&v["message"]["content"]);
153	                if !parts.is_empty() { cards.push(Card::AsstMsg { ts, parts }); }
154	            }
155	            _ => {}
156	        }
157	    }
158	
159	    let mut result = vec![Card::Header { title, cwd: first_cwd, branch: first_branch, ts: first_ts, agent: agent.to_string() }];
160	    result.extend(cards);
161	
162	    // Merge each pure tool-result UserMsg into the preceding AsstMsg.
163	    let mut i = 1;
164	    while i < result.len() {
165	        let is_pure_results = if let Card::UserMsg { parts, .. } = &result[i] {
166	            parts.iter().all(|p| matches!(p, UserPart::ToolResult { .. }))
167	        } else { false };
168	
169	        if is_pure_results && matches!(&result[i - 1], Card::AsstMsg { .. }) {
170	            let tool_results: Vec<(String, String, bool)> =
171	                if let Card::UserMsg { parts, .. } = &result[i] {
172	                    parts.iter().filter_map(|p| {
173	                        if let UserPart::ToolResult { id, content, is_error, .. } = p {
174	                            Some((id.clone(), content.clone(), *is_error))
175	                        } else { None }
176	                    }).collect()
177	                } else { vec![] };
178	
179	            if let Card::AsstMsg { parts: asst_parts, .. } = &mut result[i - 1] {
180	                for part in asst_parts.iter_mut() {
181	                    if let AsstPart::ToolCall { id, result: res, .. } = part {
182	                        if let Some((_, content, is_error)) =
183	                            tool_results.iter().find(|(rid, _, _)| rid == id)
184	                        {
185	                            *res = Some((content.clone(), *is_error));
186	                        }
187	                    }
188	                }
189	            }
190	            result.remove(i);
191	        } else {
192	            i += 1;
193	        }
194	    }
195	
196	    // Merge consecutive AsstMsg cards so the assistant name appears only once per run.
197	    let mut i = 1;
198	    while i < result.len() {
199	        if matches!(&result[i - 1], Card::AsstMsg { .. }) && matches!(&result[i], Card::AsstMsg { .. }) {
200	            if let Card::AsstMsg { parts: new_parts, .. } = result.remove(i) {
201	                if let Card::AsstMsg { parts, .. } = &mut result[i - 1] {
202	                    parts.extend(new_parts);
203	                }
204	            }
205	        } else {
206	            i += 1;
207	        }
208	    }
209	
210	    // Split each AsstMsg into a text-only AsstMsg (if any text) + a ToolRound (if any tools).
211	    let mut split: Vec<Card> = Vec::with_capacity(result.len());
212	    for card in result {
213	        match card {
214	            Card::AsstMsg { ts, parts } => {
215	                let (text_parts, tool_parts): (Vec<AsstPart>, Vec<AsstPart>) =
216	                    parts.into_iter().partition(|p| matches!(p, AsstPart::Text(_)));
217	                if !text_parts.is_empty() { split.push(Card::AsstMsg  { ts, parts: text_parts }); }
218	                if !tool_parts.is_empty() { split.push(Card::ToolRound { parts: tool_parts }); }
219	            }
220	            other => split.push(other),
221	        }
222	    }
223	    let mut result = split;
224	
225	    // Merge adjacent ToolRound cards (can arise when consecutive asst turns were all-tools).
226	    let mut i = 1;
227	    while i < result.len() {
228	        if matches!(&result[i - 1], Card::ToolRound { .. }) && matches!(&result[i], Card::ToolRound { .. }) {
229	            if let Card::ToolRound { parts: new_parts } = result.remove(i) {
230	                if let Card::ToolRound { parts } = &mut result[i - 1] {
231	                    parts.extend(new_parts);
232	                }
233	            }
234	        } else {
235	            i += 1;
236	        }
237	    }
238	
239	    result
240	}
241	
242	fn parse_user(content: &Value, tool_names: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Vec<UserPart> {
243	    let mut out = Vec::new();
244	    match content {
245	        Value::String(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => out.push(UserPart::Text(s.clone())),
246	        Value::Array(blocks) => {
247	            for b in blocks {
248	                match b["type"].as_str() {
249	                    Some("text") => {
250	                        if let Some(t) = b["text"].as_str() {
251	                            if !t.trim().is_empty() { out.push(UserPart::Text(t.to_string())); }
252	                        }
253	                    }
254	                    Some("tool_result") => {
255	                        let id = b["tool_use_id"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
256	                        let name = tool_names.get(&id).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "tool".to_string());
257	                        let is_error = b["is_error"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false);
258	                        let content = match &b["content"] {
259	                            Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
260	                            Value::Array(arr) => arr.iter()
261	                                .filter(|x| x["type"].as_str() == Some("text"))
262	                                .filter_map(|x| x["text"].as_str())
263	                                .collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n"),
264	                            _ => String::new(),
265	                        };
266	                        out.push(UserPart::ToolResult { id, name, content, is_error });
267	                    }
268	                    _ => {}
269	                }
270	            }
271	        }
272	        _ => {}
273	    }
274	    out
275	}
276	
277	fn parse_asst(content: &Value) -> Vec<AsstPart> {
278	    let mut out = Vec::new();
279	    match content {
280	        Value::String(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => out.push(AsstPart::Text(s.clone())),
281	        Value::Array(blocks) => {
282	            for b in blocks {
283	                match b["type"].as_str() {
284	                    Some("text") => {
285	                        if let Some(t) = b["text"].as_str() {
286	                            if !t.trim().is_empty() { out.push(AsstPart::Text(t.to_string())); }
287	                        }
288	                    }
289	                    Some("tool_use") => {
290	                        out.push(AsstPart::ToolCall {
291	                            id:     b["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(),
292	                            name:   b["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("unknown").to_string(),
293	                            input:  b["input"].clone(),
294	                            result: None,
295	                        });
296	                    }
297	                    _ => {}
298	                }
299	            }
300	        }
301	        _ => {}
302	    }
303	    out
304	}

307	
308	fn card_text(card: &Card) -> String {
309	    let mut out = String::new();
310	    match card {
311	        Card::Header { title, cwd, branch, agent, .. } => {
312	            if let Some(t) = title { out.push_str(t); out.push('\n'); }
313	            if !cwd.is_empty()    { out.push_str(cwd);               out.push('\n'); }
314	            if !branch.is_empty() { out.push_str(&format!("[{branch}]")); out.push('\n'); }
315	            if !agent.is_empty()  { out.push_str(agent); out.push('\n'); }
316	        }
317	        Card::System { content, .. } => { if !content.is_empty() { out.push_str(content); out.push('\n'); } }
318	        Card::UserMsg { parts, .. } => {
319	            for part in parts {
320	                match part {
321	                    UserPart::Text(t) => { out.push_str(t); out.push('\n'); }
322	                    UserPart::ToolResult { name, content, .. } => {
323	                        out.push_str(&format!("[Result: {name}]\n{content}\n"));
324	                    }
325	                }
326	            }
327	        }
328	        Card::AsstMsg { parts, .. } => {
329	            for part in parts {
330	                if let AsstPart::Text(t) = part { out.push_str(t); out.push('\n'); }
331	            }
332	        }
333	        Card::ToolRound { parts } => {
334	            for part in parts {
335	                if let AsstPart::ToolCall { name, input, result, .. } = part {
336	                    out.push_str(&format!("[Tool: {name}]\n"));
337	                    if let Some(obj) = input.as_object() {
338	                        for (k, v) in obj {
339	                            let val = if let Value::String(s) = v { s.clone() } else { v.to_string() };
340	                            out.push_str(&format!("{k}: {val}\n"));
341	                        }
342	                    }
343	                    if let Some((content, _)) = result {
344	                        out.push_str(&format!("[Result]\n{content}\n"));
345	                    }
346	                }
347	            }
348	        }
349	    }
350	    out
351	}

368	fn copy_to_clipboard(text: &str) {
369	    use std::io::Write as _;
370	    use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
371	    if let Ok(mut child) = Command::new("pbcopy").stdin(Stdio::piped()).spawn() {
372	        if let Some(stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
373	            let mut stdin = stdin;
374	            let _ = stdin.write_all(text.as_bytes());
375	        }
376	        let _ = child.wait();
377	    }
378	}

382	fn agent_color(name: &str) -> u8 {
383	    if      name.contains("Claude")   { 214 }
384	    else if name.contains("Copilot")  { 99  }
385	    else if name.contains("Cursor")   { 33  }
386	    else if name.contains("Gemini")   { 75  }
387	    else if name.contains("Aider")    { 42  }
388	    else if name.contains("ChatGPT")  { 35  }
389	    else if name.contains("Windsurf") { 44  }
390	    else if name.contains("Amazon Q") { 208 }
391	    else                              { 245 }
392	}

394	fn render_card(card: &Card, width: usize, agent: &str) -> Vec<String> {
395	    let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
396	    let w = width.saturating_sub(2);
397	
398	    match card {
399	        Card::Header { title, cwd, branch, ts, agent: hdr_agent } => {
400	            let t = title.as_deref().unwrap_or("(untitled session)");
401	            lines.push(format!("\x1b[1;38;5;229m{t}\x1b[0m"));
402	            if !cwd.is_empty()       { lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;240m{cwd}\x1b[0m")); }
403	            if !branch.is_empty()    { lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;220m[{branch}]\x1b[0m")); }
404	            if !hdr_agent.is_empty() {
405	                let col = agent_color(hdr_agent);
406	                lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;{col}m{hdr_agent}\x1b[0m"));
407	            }
408	            if !ts.is_empty()        { lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;240m{}\x1b[0m", rel_time(ts))); }
409	        }
410	        Card::System { ts, subtype, content } => {
411	            lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;240m── {subtype}  {}\x1b[0m", rel_time(ts)));
412	            lines.push(String::new());
413	            for l in wrap(content, w) { lines.push(format!("  \x1b[38;5;240m{l}\x1b[0m")); }
414	        }
415	        Card::UserMsg { ts, parts } => {
416	            lines.push(format!("\x1b[1;38;5;82m── user  \x1b[0m\x1b[38;5;240m{}\x1b[0m", rel_time(ts)));
417	            for part in parts {
418	                match part {
419	                    UserPart::Text(text) => {
420	                        lines.push(String::new());
421	                        for l in wrap(text, w) { lines.push(format!("  \x1b[38;5;255m{l}\x1b[0m")); }
422	                    }
423	                    UserPart::ToolResult { name, content, is_error, .. } => {
424	                        let col = if *is_error { "38;5;196" } else { "38;5;177" };
425	                        lines.push(format!("\x1b[{col}m  ◀ {name}\x1b[0m"));
426	                        let visible: Vec<&str> = content.lines()
427	                            .filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).take(8).collect();
428	                        for l in wrap(&visible.join("\n"), w.saturating_sub(4)) {
429	                            lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;240m    {l}\x1b[0m"));
430	                        }
431	                        let total = content.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).count();
432	                        if total > 8 {
433	                            lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;238m    … {} more lines\x1b[0m", total - 8));
434	                        }
435	                    }
436	                }
437	            }
438	        }
439	        Card::AsstMsg { ts, parts } => {
440	            let (agent_label, agent_col) = if agent.is_empty() {
441	                ("claude".to_string(), 75u8)
442	            } else {
443	                (agent.to_lowercase(), agent_color(agent))
444	            };
445	            lines.push(format!("\x1b[1;38;5;{agent_col}m── {agent_label}  \x1b[0m\x1b[38;5;240m{}\x1b[0m", rel_time(ts)));
446	            for part in parts {
447	                if let AsstPart::Text(text) = part {
448	                    lines.push(String::new());
449	                    for l in wrap(text, w) { lines.push(format!("  \x1b[38;5;252m{l}\x1b[0m")); }
450	                }
451	            }
452	        }
453	        Card::ToolRound { .. } => {} // handled in build_flat
454	    }
455	
456	    lines.push(String::new());
457	    lines
458	}

460	fn render_tool_summary(parts: &[AsstPart]) -> Vec<String> {
461	    let count = parts.len();
462	    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
463	    let unique: Vec<&str> = parts.iter().filter_map(|p| {
464	        if let AsstPart::ToolCall { name, .. } = p {
465	            if seen.insert(name.as_str()) { Some(name.as_str()) } else { None }
466	        } else { None }
467	    }).collect();
468	    vec![
469	        format!("\x1b[38;5;240m  ▶ ({count} tool call{}: {})\x1b[0m",
470	            if count == 1 { "" } else { "s" }, unique.join(", ")),
471	        String::new(),
472	    ]
473	}

487	fn render_one_tool_call(part: &AsstPart, w: usize) -> Vec<String> {
488	    let mut lines = Vec::new();
489	    if let AsstPart::ToolCall { name, input, result, .. } = part {
490	        lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;220m  ▶ {name}\x1b[0m"));
491	        if let Some(obj) = input.as_object() {
492	            let mut is_first = true;
493	            for (_, v) in obj.iter().take(4) {
494	                let raw_val = if let Value::String(s) = v { s.clone() } else { v.to_string() };
495	                let first_line = raw_val.lines().next().unwrap_or("");
496	                let preview: String = first_line.chars().take(120).collect();
497	                let suffix = if raw_val.lines().count() > 1 || first_line.chars().count() > 120 { " …" } else { "" };
498	                let col = if is_first { "38;5;255" } else { "38;5;245" };
499	                lines.push(format!("\x1b[{col}m    {preview}{suffix}\x1b[0m"));
500	                is_first = false;
501	            }
502	            if obj.len() > 4 {
503	                lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;238m    … {} more fields\x1b[0m", obj.len() - 4));
504	            }
505	        }
506	        if let Some((content, is_error)) = result {
507	            lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;238m  ────────────────────────────────────────\x1b[0m"));
508	            let col = if *is_error { "38;5;196" } else { "38;5;240" };
509	            let visible: Vec<&str> = content.lines()
510	                .filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).take(8).collect();
511	            for l in wrap(&visible.join("\n"), w.saturating_sub(4)) {
512	                lines.push(format!("\x1b[{col}m    {l}\x1b[0m"));
513	            }
514	            let total = content.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).count();
515	            if total > 8 {
516	                lines.push(format!("\x1b[38;5;238m    … {} more lines\x1b[0m", total - 8));
517	            }
518	        }
519	        lines.push(String::new());
520	    }
521	    lines
522	}

524	// Visible character width, skipping ANSI escape sequences.
525	fn visible_width(s: &str) -> usize {
526	    let mut w = 0usize;
527	    let mut chars = s.chars().peekable();
528	    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
529	        if c == '\x1b' {
530	            // consume up to and including the final byte of the CSI sequence
531	            for nc in chars.by_ref() {
532	                if nc.is_ascii_alphabetic() { break; }
533	            }
534	        } else {
535	            w += 1;
536	        }
537	    }
538	    w
539	}
540	
541	// Apply a background color code to a pre-colored ANSI string by re-inserting
542	// the background after every reset sequence.
543	fn with_bg(s: &str, bg: &str) -> String {
544	    let reinsert = format!("\x1b[0m\x1b[{bg}m");
545	    let body = s.replace("\x1b[0m", &reinsert);
546	    format!("\x1b[{bg}m{body}")
547	}
548	
549	fn wrap(text: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
550	    if width < 4 { return text.lines().map(str::to_string).collect(); }
551	    let mut out = Vec::new();
552	    for raw_line in text.lines() {
553	        if raw_line.is_empty() { out.push(String::new()); continue; }
554	        let mut remaining = raw_line;
555	        loop {
556	            if remaining.chars().count() <= width {
557	                out.push(remaining.to_string());
558	                break;
559	            }
560	            let break_pos = remaining.chars().take(width)
561	                .collect::<String>()
562	                .rfind(' ')
563	                .unwrap_or(width);
564	            let byte_pos = remaining.char_indices().nth(break_pos)
565	                .map(|(i, _)| i)
566	                .unwrap_or(remaining.len());
567	            out.push(remaining[..byte_pos].to_string());
568	            remaining = remaining[byte_pos..].trim_start_matches(' ');
569	        }
570	    }
571	    out
572	}
573	
574	fn rel_time(iso: &str) -> String {
575	    let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(iso) else { return iso.to_string(); };
576	    let secs = (Utc::now() - dt.with_timezone(&Utc)).num_seconds().max(0);
577	    if secs < 604_800 {
578	        match secs {
579	            s if s < 60     => "just now".into(),
580	            s if s < 3_600  => format!("{} min{} ago", s/60,     if s/60==1     {""} else {"s"}),
581	            s if s < 86_400 => format!("{} hr{} ago",  s/3_600,  if s/3_600==1  {""} else {"s"}),
582	            s               => format!("{} day{} ago", s/86_400, if s/86_400==1 {""} else {"s"}),
583	        }
584	    } else {
585	        dt.with_timezone(&Local).format("%m/%d/%y").to_string()
586	    }
587	}

589	// ── Resume logic ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

591	fn git_current_branch(cwd: &str) -> Option<String> {
592	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
593	        .args(["rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"])
594	        .current_dir(cwd)
595	        .output()
596	        .ok()?;
597	    if !out.status.success() { return None; }
598	    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
599	    if s.is_empty() || s == "HEAD" { None } else { Some(s) }
600	}
601	
602	fn create_resume_worktree(cwd: &str, branch: &str) -> Option<String> {
603	    let root_out = std::process::Command::new("git")
604	        .args(["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
605	        .current_dir(cwd)
606	        .output()
607	        .ok()?;
608	    if !root_out.status.success() { return None; }
609	    let repo_root = String::from_utf8_lossy(&root_out.stdout).trim().to_string();
610	
611	    let repo_path = std::path::Path::new(&repo_root);
612	    let parent = repo_path.parent()?;
613	    let repo_name = repo_path.file_name()?.to_str()?;
614	    let wt_path = parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{branch}"));
615	
616	    // Branch already exists; add a worktree pointing at it.
617	    let _ = std::process::Command::new("git")
618	        .args(["worktree", "add", wt_path.to_str()?, branch])
619	        .current_dir(&repo_root)
620	        .output();
621	
622	    if wt_path.exists() { Some(wt_path.to_string_lossy().to_string()) } else { None }
623	}
624	
625	fn resume_via_entire(dir: &str) {
626	    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
627	    let Ok(out) = std::process::Command::new("entire")
628	        .arg("resume")
629	        .current_dir(dir)
630	        .output() else { eprintln!("entire resume failed"); return; };
631	
632	    let cmd_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
633	    if cmd_str.is_empty() { eprintln!("entire resume returned no command"); return; }
634	
635	    let mut parts = cmd_str.split_whitespace();
636	    let Some(prog) = parts.next() else { return; };
637	    let args: Vec<&str> = parts.collect();
638	    let err = std::process::Command::new(prog).args(&args).current_dir(dir).exec();
639	    eprintln!("exec failed: {err}");
640	}

642	/// Find a Claude session by ID. Returns the session's original cwd (from the JSONL) if found,
643	/// so `claude --resume` can be run from the correct project directory.
644	fn find_claude_session_cwd(session_id: &str) -> Option<String> {
645	    use std::io::BufRead;
646	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
647	    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
648	    for dir in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()?.flatten() {
649	        let jsonl = dir.path().join(format!("{session_id}.jsonl"));
650	        if !jsonl.exists() { continue; }
651	        // Extract the cwd from the first entry that has one.
652	        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&jsonl) else { return Some(String::new()); };
653	        for line in std::io::BufReader::new(file).lines().flatten() {
654	            let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };
655	            if matches!(v["type"].as_str(), Some("user") | Some("system")) {
656	                if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str() {
657	                    return Some(c.to_string());
658	                }
659	            }
660	        }
661	        return Some(String::new()); // file exists but no cwd entry
662	    }
663	    None
664	}
665	
666	fn do_resume(_agent: &str, session_id: &str, session_branch: &str, session_cwd: &str) {
667	    let current = git_current_branch(session_cwd);
668	    let same_branch = !session_branch.is_empty()
669	        && current.as_deref() == Some(session_branch);
670	
671	    let dir = if same_branch || session_branch.is_empty() {
672	        session_cwd.to_string()
673	    } else {
674	        create_resume_worktree(session_cwd, session_branch)
675	            .unwrap_or_else(|| session_cwd.to_string())
676	    };
677	
678	    resume_session(session_id, &dir);
679	}

681	/// Resume a session by ID, falling back to `entire resume` if the Claude JSONL is absent.
682	/// `fallback_cwd` is used for `entire resume` if the Claude session isn't found.
683	pub fn resume_session(session_id: &str, fallback_cwd: &str) {
684	    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
685	    if let Some(session_cwd) = find_claude_session_cwd(session_id) {
686	        let launch_dir = if session_cwd.is_empty() || !std::path::Path::new(&session_cwd).exists() {
687	            fallback_cwd.to_string()
688	        } else {
689	            session_cwd
690	        };
691	        let err = std::process::Command::new("claude")
692	            .arg("--resume")
693	            .arg(session_id)
694	            .current_dir(&launch_dir)
695	            .exec();
696	        eprintln!("exec failed: {err}");
697	    } else {
698	        resume_via_entire(fallback_cwd);
699	    }
700	}

702	// ── Pager ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
703	
704	fn build_flat(
705	    cards: &[Card],
706	    term_w: usize,
707	    collapsed: &std::collections::HashSet<usize>,
708	) -> (Vec<(usize, String)>, Vec<Selectable>, Vec<usize>) {
709	    let w = term_w.saturating_sub(2);
710	    let mut flat: Vec<(usize, String)> = Vec::new();
711	    let mut selectables: Vec<Selectable> = Vec::new();
712	    let mut starts: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
713	
714	    // Pull the agent name from the Header card so render_card can use it.
715	    let agent: &str = cards.iter().find_map(|c| {
716	        if let Card::Header { agent, .. } = c { Some(agent.as_str()) } else { None }
717	    }).unwrap_or("");
718	
719	    for (card_idx, card) in cards.iter().enumerate() {
720	        if let Card::ToolRound { parts } = card {
721	            if collapsed.contains(&card_idx) {
722	                let si = selectables.len();
723	                starts.push(flat.len());
724	                selectables.push(Selectable::Card(card_idx));
725	                for l in render_tool_summary(parts) { flat.push((si, l)); }
726	            } else {
727	                // Header row (collapses the round when space is pressed)
728	                let si = selectables.len();
729	                starts.push(flat.len());
730	                selectables.push(Selectable::ToolHeader(card_idx));
731	                for l in render_tool_header(parts) { flat.push((si, l)); }
732	                // One selectable per individual tool call
733	                for (tool_idx, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
734	                    let si = selectables.len();
735	                    starts.push(flat.len());
736	                    selectables.push(Selectable::ToolCall(card_idx, tool_idx));
737	                    for l in render_one_tool_call(part, w) { flat.push((si, l)); }
738	                }
739	            }
740	        } else {
741	            let si = selectables.len();
742	            starts.push(flat.len());
743	            selectables.push(Selectable::Card(card_idx));
744	            for l in render_card(card, w, agent) { flat.push((si, l)); }
745	        }
746	    }
747	
748	    (flat, selectables, starts)
749	}
750	
751	enum PagerOutcome { Quit, Resume, Delete }
752	
753	fn pager(cards: Vec<Card>, start_ts: Option<&str>) -> Result<PagerOutcome> {
754	    let (term_w, term_h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
755	    let mut w = term_w as usize;
756	    let mut h = (term_h as usize).saturating_sub(1);
757	
758	    let mut collapsed: std::collections::HashSet<usize> = cards.iter().enumerate()
759	        .filter_map(|(i, c)| if matches!(c, Card::ToolRound { .. }) { Some(i) } else { None })
760	        .collect();
761	
762	    let (mut flat, mut selectables, mut starts) = build_flat(&cards, w, &collapsed);
763	
764	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
765	
766	    let orig_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
767	    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
768	        let mut out = io::stdout();
769	        let _ = execute!(out, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show);
770	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
771	        orig_hook(info);
772	    }));
773	
774	    terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
775	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide)?;
776	
777	    // If a target timestamp was given, jump to the first card whose ts matches.
778	    let initial_sel = start_ts.and_then(|ts| {
779	        cards.iter().enumerate().find_map(|(ci, card)| {
780	            let card_ts = match card {
781	                Card::UserMsg { ts, .. } | Card::AsstMsg { ts, .. } | Card::System { ts, .. } => ts.as_str(),
782	                _ => return None,
783	            };
784	            if card_ts == ts {
785	                selectables.iter().position(|s| *s == Selectable::Card(ci))
786	            } else {
787	                None
788	            }
789	        })
790	    }).unwrap_or(if selectables.len() > 1 { 1 } else { 0 });
791	
792	    let mut sel: usize = initial_sel;
793	    let mut scroll: usize = 0;
794	    let mut flash:  Option<&str> = None;
795	    let mut awaiting_delete = false;
796	
797	    let result: Result<PagerOutcome> = loop {
798	        let s = starts[sel];
799	        let e = starts.get(sel + 1).copied().unwrap_or(flat.len());
800	        if s < scroll          { scroll = s; }
801	        else if e > scroll + h { scroll = e.saturating_sub(h); }
802	
803	        if let Err(err) = draw(&mut stdout, &flat, &starts, sel, scroll, h, w, selectables.len(), flash) {
804	            break Err(anyhow::anyhow!(err));
805	        }
806	
807	        match event::read() {
808	            Err(e) => break Err(e.into()),
809	            Ok(Event::Key(k)) => {
810	                let prev_flash = flash.take();
811	                match (k.code, k.modifiers) {
812	                    (KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc | KeyCode::Left, _) => break Ok(PagerOutcome::Quit),
813	                    (KeyCode::Char('c'), KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => break Ok(PagerOutcome::Quit),
814	                    (KeyCode::Char('r'), _) => break Ok(PagerOutcome::Resume),
815	                    (KeyCode::Char('d'), _) => {
816	                        awaiting_delete = true;
817	                        flash = Some("  Delete session? Press y to confirm, any other key to cancel  ");
818	                        continue;
819	                    }
820	                    (KeyCode::Char('y'), _) if awaiting_delete => {
821	                        break Ok(PagerOutcome::Delete);
822	                    }
823	
824	                    (KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j'), _) => {
825	                        if sel + 1 < selectables.len() { sel += 1; }
826	                    }
827	                    (KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k'), _) => {
828	                        if sel > 0 { sel -= 1; }
829	                    }
830	                    (KeyCode::Char('g'), _) => { sel = 0; }
831	                    (KeyCode::Char('G'), _) => { sel = selectables.len().saturating_sub(1); }
832	                    (KeyCode::Char('d'), _) => { scroll = (scroll + h / 2).min(flat.len().saturating_sub(1)); }
833	                    (KeyCode::Char('u'), _) => { scroll = scroll.saturating_sub(h / 2); }
834	
835	                    (KeyCode::Char('y'), _) | (KeyCode::Char('c'), _) => {
836	                        let text = match &selectables[sel] {
837	                            Selectable::Card(ci)         => card_text(&cards[*ci]),
838	                            Selectable::ToolHeader(ci)   => card_text(&cards[*ci]),
839	                            Selectable::ToolCall(ci, ti) => {
840	                                if let Card::ToolRound { parts } = &cards[*ci] {
841	                                    parts.get(*ti).map_or(String::new(), tool_call_text)
842	                                } else { String::new() }
843	                            }
844	                        };
845	                        copy_to_clipboard(&text);
846	                        flash = Some("  ✓ copied to clipboard  ");
847	                    }
848	
849	                    // Space/Right: expand collapsed ToolRound, or collapse via its header
850	                    (KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right, _) => {
851	                        let action = match &selectables[sel] {
852	                            Selectable::Card(ci) if matches!(&cards[*ci], Card::ToolRound { .. }) => {
853	                                Some((true, *ci))   // expand
854	                            }
855	                            Selectable::ToolHeader(ci) => Some((false, *ci)), // collapse
856	                            _ => None,
857	                        };
858	                        if let Some((expand, card_idx)) = action {
859	                            if expand { collapsed.remove(&card_idx); } else { collapsed.insert(card_idx); }
860	                            let (nf, ns, nst) = build_flat(&cards, w, &collapsed);
861	                            flat   = nf;
862	                            starts = nst;
863	                            sel = if expand {
864	                                ns.iter().position(|s| *s == Selectable::ToolHeader(card_idx))
865	                            } else {
866	                                ns.iter().position(|s| *s == Selectable::Card(card_idx))
867	                            }.unwrap_or_else(|| sel.min(ns.len().saturating_sub(1)));
868	                            selectables = ns;
869	                        } else {
870	                            flash = prev_flash;
871	                        }
872	                    }
873	
874	                    _ => { awaiting_delete = false; flash = prev_flash; }
875	                }
876	            }
877	            Ok(Event::Resize(new_w, new_h)) => {
878	                w = new_w as usize;
879	                h = (new_h as usize).saturating_sub(1);
880	                let (nf, ns, nst) = build_flat(&cards, w, &collapsed);
881	                flat = nf; selectables = ns; starts = nst;
882	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
883	            }
884	            Ok(_) => {}
885	        }
886	    };
887	
888	    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show)?;
889	    terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;
890	    result
891	}
892	
893	fn draw(
894	    stdout:  &mut impl Write,
895	    flat:    &[(usize, String)],
896	    starts:  &[usize],
897	    sel:     usize,
898	    scroll:  usize,
899	    h:       usize,
900	    w:       usize,
901	    total:   usize,
902	    flash:   Option<&str>,
903	) -> io::Result<()> {
904	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
905	
906	    let end = (scroll + h).min(flat.len());
907	
908	    for row in 0..h {
909	        // Clear the whole row first so tabs and short lines never leave stale chars.
910	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
911	
912	        if scroll + row < end {
913	            let (card_idx, line) = &flat[scroll + row];
914	            let is_sel = *card_idx == sel;
915	
916	            if is_sel {
917	                let line_bg = with_bg(line, SEL_BG);
918	                let vis = visible_width(line);
919	                let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);
920	                write!(stdout, "\x1b[{SEL_BG}m{line_bg}{}\x1b[0m", " ".repeat(pad))?;
921	            } else {
922	                write!(stdout, "{line}")?;
923	            }
924	        }
925	    }
926	
927	    // Status bar
928	    let sel_end = starts.get(sel + 1).copied().unwrap_or(flat.len());
929	    let base = format!(
930	        "  {}/{} msgs  lines {}-{}  ↑↓/jk  space expand  d/u page  g/G ends  y/c copy  r resume  d delete  q quit  ",
931	        sel + 1, total, starts[sel] + 1, sel_end,
932	    );
933	    let bar = if let Some(msg) = flash {
934	        let skip = msg.chars().count();
935	        let rest: String = base.chars().skip(skip).collect();
936	        format!("{msg}{rest}")
937	    } else {
938	        base
939	    };
940	    let bar_display: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();
941	    let padded = format!("{:width$}", bar_display, width = w);
942	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, h as u16))?;
943	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")?;
944	
945	    stdout.flush()
946	}
947

  "old_string": "/// Find a Claude session by ID. Returns the session's original cwd (from the JSONL) if found,\n/// so `claude --resume` can be run from the correct project directory.\nfn find_claude_session_cwd(session_id: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    use std::io::BufRead;\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").ok()?;\n    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(\".claude/projects\");\n    for dir in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()?.flatten() {\n        let jsonl = dir.path().join(format!(\"{session_id}.jsonl\"));\n        if !jsonl.exists() { continue; }\n        // Extract the cwd from the first entry that has one.\n        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&jsonl) else { return Some(String::new()); };\n        for line in std::io::BufReader::new(file).lines().flatten() {\n            let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };\n            if matches!(v[\"type\"].as_str(), Some(\"user\") | Some(\"system\")) {\n                if let Some(c) = v[\"cwd\"].as_str() {\n                    return Some(c.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return Some(String::new()); // file exists but no cwd entry\n    }\n    None\n}",
  "new_string": "/// Find a Claude session by ID. Returns `(cwd, git_branch)` from the JSONL if found,\n/// so `claude --resume` can be run from the correct directory and branch is known.\nfn find_claude_session_cwd(session_id: &str) -> Option<(String, String)> {\n    use std::io::BufRead;\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").ok()?;\n    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(\".claude/projects\");\n    for dir in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()?.flatten() {\n        let jsonl = dir.path().join(format!(\"{session_id}.jsonl\"));\n        if !jsonl.exists() { continue; }\n        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&jsonl) else { return Some((String::new(), String::new())); };\n        let mut cwd = String::new();\n        let mut branch = String::new();\n        for line in std::io::BufReader::new(file).lines().flatten() {\n            let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };\n            if matches!(v[\"type\"].as_str(), Some(\"user\") | Some(\"system\")) {\n                if cwd.is_empty() {\n                    if let Some(c) = v[\"cwd\"].as_str() { cwd = c.to_string(); }\n                }\n                if branch.is_empty() {\n                    if let Some(b) = v[\"gitBranch\"].as_str() { branch = b.to_string(); }\n                }\n                if !cwd.is_empty() && !branch.is_empty() { break; }\n            }\n        }\n        return Some((cwd, branch));\n    }\n    None\n}"
}

  "new_string": "/// Resume a session by ID, falling back to `entire resume` if the Claude JSONL is absent.\n/// `fallback_cwd` is used for `entire resume` if the Claude session isn't found.\npub fn resume_session(session_id: &str, fallback_cwd: &str) {\n    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;\n    if let Some((session_cwd, session_branch)) = find_claude_session_cwd(session_id) {\n        let launch_dir = if session_cwd.is_empty() || !std::path::Path::new(&session_cwd).exists() {\n            fallback_cwd.to_string()\n        } else {\n            session_cwd\n        };\n        let err = std::process::Command::new(\"claude\")\n            .arg(\"--resume\")\n            .arg(session_id)\n            .current_dir(&launch_dir)\n            .exec();\n        eprintln!(\"exec failed: {err}\");\n        // exec failed — fall back to entire resume, checking out the session branch first\n        resume_via_entire(&launch_dir, &session_branch);\n    } else {\n        resume_via_entire(fallback_cwd, \"\");\n    }\n}"

> AGENT

Compiles cleanly. The changes:

- `find_claude_session_cwd` now returns `Option<(String, String)>` — `(cwd, git_branch)` — scanning the JSONL for both fields in a single pass, stopping early once both are found.
- `resume_session` unpacks the tuple; if `exec()` fails (the `claude` binary isn't found or errors before replacing the process), it now calls `resume_via_entire` with the session's branch.
- `resume_via_entire` now accepts a `branch` parameter. Before calling `entire resume`, it checks whether the repo is already on that branch; if not, it runs `git checkout <branch>` first.

10	struct DisplaySession {

16	}

18	pub fn run(all: bool) -> Result<()> {
19	    let conn = db::connect()?;
20	
21	    let repos = fetch_repos(&conn)?;
22	    let cwd_env = env::current_dir().ok().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string());
23	    let current_repo_dir: Option<String> = cwd_env.as_deref().and_then(|cwd| {
24	        repos.iter()
25	            .find(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str()))
26	            .map(|r| r.directory.clone())
27	    });
28	
29	    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(
30	        "SELECT session_id, agent_name, user, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name, tokens_used
31	         FROM sessions ORDER BY updated_at DESC"
32	    )?;
33	
34	    let db_sessions: Vec<Session> = stmt.query_map([], |row| {
35	        let created_str: String = row.get(3)?;
36	        let updated_str: String = row.get(4)?;
37	        Ok(Session {
38	            session_id: row.get(0)?,
39	            agent_name: row.get(1)?,
40	            user: row.get(2)?,
41	            created_at: DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&created_str)
42	                .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))
43	                .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now()),
44	            updated_at: DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&updated_str)
45	                .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))
46	                .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now()),
47	            cwd: row.get(5)?,
48	            session_name: row.get(6)?,
49	            tokens_used: row.get(7)?,
50	        })
51	    })?
52	    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
53	
54	    let known_ids: HashSet<String> = db_sessions.iter().map(|s| s.session_id.clone()).collect();
55	    let cutoff = Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::days(3);
56	
57	    let mut sessions: Vec<DisplaySession> = db_sessions.into_iter()
58	        .filter(|s| all || s.updated_at >= cutoff)
59	        .map(|s| DisplaySession {
60	            session_id: s.session_id,
61	            session_name: s.session_name,
62	            cwd: s.cwd,
63	            updated_at: s.updated_at,
64	            agent_name: s.agent_name,
65	        })
66	        .collect();
67	
68	    sessions.extend(scan_claude_projects(&known_ids, all, cutoff));
69	
70	    // Local-repo sessions first, then by recency
71	    sessions.sort_by(|a, b| {
72	        let a_local = current_repo_dir.as_deref().map_or(false, |d| a.cwd.starts_with(d));
73	        let b_local = current_repo_dir.as_deref().map_or(false, |d| b.cwd.starts_with(d));
74	        b_local.cmp(&a_local).then(b.updated_at.cmp(&a.updated_at))
75	    });
76	
77	    if sessions.is_empty() {
78	        println!("No sessions found.");
79	        return Ok(());
80	    }
81	
82	    let term_w = crossterm::terminal::size().map(|(w, _)| w as usize).unwrap_or(120);
83	    let now = Utc::now();
84	
85	    for s in &sessions {
86	        let age = (now - s.updated_at).num_seconds();
87	        let is_local = current_repo_dir.as_deref().map_or(false, |d| s.cwd.starts_with(d));
88	
89	        let dot = match age {
90	            a if a < 900    => "\x1b[38;5;82m*\x1b[0m",
91	            a if a < 3_600  => "\x1b[38;5;214m*\x1b[0m",
92	            _               => "\x1b[38;5;240m*\x1b[0m",
93	        };
94	
95	        let id_short: String = s.session_id.chars().take(8).collect();
96	        let ts = relative_time(s.updated_at);
97	        let cwd_short = short_cwd(&s.cwd);
98	        let agent_col = agent_color(&s.agent_name);
99	        let meta = format!(
100	            "\x1b[38;5;240m{id_short}  \x1b[38;5;{agent_col}m{agent}\x1b[38;5;240m  {cwd_short}  {ts}\x1b[0m",
101	            agent = s.agent_name,
102	        );
103	
104	        let name_col = if is_local { "38;5;255" } else { "38;5;245" };
105	        let name = s.session_name.trim();
106	
107	        if name.is_empty() {
108	            println!("{dot}  {meta}");
109	        } else {
110	            let name_trunc = truncate(name, term_w.saturating_sub(4));
111	            println!("{dot} \x1b[{name_col}m{name_trunc}\x1b[0m");
112	            println!("   {meta}");
113	        }
114	    }
115	
116	    Ok(())
117	}

119	fn scan_claude_projects(known_ids: &HashSet<String>, all: bool, cutoff: DateTime<Utc>) -> Vec<DisplaySession> {
120	    let home = match std::env::var("HOME") {
121	        Ok(h) => h,
122	        Err(_) => return vec![],
123	    };
124	    let projects_dir = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
125	    let Ok(projects) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects_dir) else { return vec![] };
126	
127	    let mut sessions: Vec<DisplaySession> = Vec::new();
128	
129	    for project_entry in projects.flatten() {
130	        let project_dir = project_entry.path();
131	        if !project_dir.is_dir() { continue }
132	
133	        let Ok(files) = std::fs::read_dir(&project_dir) else { continue };
134	
135	        for file_entry in files.flatten() {
136	            let path = file_entry.path();
137	            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some("jsonl") { continue }
138	
139	            let session_id = match path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
140	                Some(s) => s.to_string(),
141	                None => continue,
142	            };
143	
144	            let file_mtime = file_entry.metadata().ok()
145	                .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
146	                .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
147	                .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
148	
149	            if !all && file_mtime < cutoff { continue }
150	
151	            let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&path) else { continue };
152	            let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);
153	            let mut session_name = String::new();
154	            let mut cwd = String::new();
155	            let mut last_prompt = String::new();
156	
157	            for line in reader.lines().flatten() {
158	                if line.trim().is_empty() { continue }
159	                let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };
160	                match v["type"].as_str() {
161	                    Some("custom-title") => {
162	                        if let Some(t) = v["customTitle"].as_str() { session_name = t.to_string(); }
163	                    }
164	                    Some("user") | Some("system") => {
165	                        if cwd.is_empty() {
166	                            if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str() { cwd = c.to_string(); }
167	                        }
168	                    }
169	                    _ => {}
170	                }
171	                if v["type"].as_str() == Some("user") {
172	                    if let Some(t) = user_text(&v["message"]["content"]) {
173	                        last_prompt = t;
174	                    }
175	                }
176	            }
177	
178	            let display_name = if !session_name.is_empty() { session_name } else { last_prompt };
179	
180	            if known_ids.contains(&session_id) {
181	                // Refresh the existing DB entry's name and timestamp
182	                if let Some(existing) = sessions.iter_mut().find(|s| s.session_id == session_id) {
183	                    if !display_name.is_empty() { existing.session_name = display_name; }
184	                    if file_mtime > existing.updated_at { existing.updated_at = file_mtime; }
185	                }
186	                continue;
187	            }
188	
189	            sessions.push(DisplaySession {
190	                session_id,
191	                session_name: display_name,
192	                cwd,
193	                updated_at: file_mtime,
194	                agent_name: "Claude Code".to_string(),
195	            });
196	        }
197	    }
198	
199	    sessions
200	}
201	
202	fn user_text(content: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<String> {
203	    match content {
204	        serde_json::Value::String(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => Some(s.trim().to_string()),
205	        serde_json::Value::Array(blocks) => {
206	            blocks.iter().find_map(|b| {
207	                if b["type"].as_str() == Some("text") {
208	                    b["text"].as_str().filter(|t| !t.trim().is_empty()).map(|t| t.trim().to_string())
209	                } else { None }
210	            })
211	        }
212	        _ => None,
213	    }
214	}
215	
216	fn agent_color(name: &str) -> u8 {
217	    if      name.contains("Claude")   { 214 }
218	    else if name.contains("Copilot")  { 99  }
219	    else if name.contains("Cursor")   { 33  }
220	    else if name.contains("Gemini")   { 75  }
221	    else if name.contains("Aider")    { 42  }
222	    else if name.contains("ChatGPT")  { 35  }
223	    else if name.contains("Windsurf") { 44  }
224	    else if name.contains("Amazon Q") { 208 }
225	    else                              { 245 }
226	}
227	
228	fn relative_time(dt: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
229	    let secs = (Utc::now() - dt).num_seconds().max(0);
230	    if secs < 604_800 {
231	        match secs {
232	            s if s < 60     => "just now".to_string(),
233	            s if s < 3_600  => format!("{} min{} ago", s/60,     if s/60==1     {""} else {"s"}),
234	            s if s < 86_400 => format!("{} hr{} ago",  s/3_600,  if s/3_600==1  {""} else {"s"}),
235	            s               => format!("{} day{} ago", s/86_400, if s/86_400==1 {""} else {"s"}),
236	        }
237	    } else {
238	        dt.with_timezone(&Local).format("%m/%d/%y").to_string()
239	    }
240	}
241	
242	fn truncate(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {
243	    if s.chars().count() <= max {
244	        s.to_string()
245	    } else {
246	        format!("{}…", s.chars().take(max.saturating_sub(1)).collect::<String>())
247	    }
248	}
249	
250	fn short_cwd(cwd: &str) -> String {
251	    let parts: Vec<&str> = cwd.trim_end_matches('/').split('/').filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
252	    match parts.len() {
253	        0 => "/".to_string(),
254	        1 => format!("/{}", parts[0]),
255	        _ => format!("…/{}/{}", parts[parts.len() - 2], parts[parts.len() - 1]),
256	    }
257	}

51	pub fn run() -> Result<()> {
52	    let conn = db::connect()?;
53	    let repos = fetch_repos(&conn)?;
54	
55	    if repos.is_empty() {
56	        println!("No repositories tracked. Run `gossamer init` in a git repo to get started.");
57	        return Ok(());
58	    }
59	
60	    // The shell wrapper sets GOSSAMER_CDPATH to a temp file path.
61	    // We write the selected directory there instead of stdout, avoiding all
62	    // the stdout-capture / /dev/tty complexity.
63	    let cd_file = std::env::var("GOSSAMER_CDPATH").ok();
64	
65	    if !io::stdout().is_terminal() && cd_file.is_none() {
66	        // Plain list when truly non-interactive (piped, no wrapper)
67	        let cwd = env::current_dir().ok().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string());
68	        let current_dir = cwd.as_deref().and_then(|cwd| {
69	            repos.iter().find(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())).map(|r| r.directory.as_str())
70	        });
71	        for repo in &repos {
72	            let is_cur = current_dir == Some(repo.directory.as_str());
73	            let dot = if is_cur { "*" } else { " " };
74	            println!("{dot} {}  {}  {}", repo.name, repo.directory, repo.remote);
75	        }
76	        return Ok(());
77	    }
78	
79	    // Register panic hook to restore terminal
80	    let orig_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
81	    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
82	        let mut out = io::stdout();
83	        let _ = execute!(out, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show);
84	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
85	        orig_hook(info);
86	    }));
87	
88	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
89	    terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
90	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide)?;
91	
92	    let outcome = tui_loop(&mut stdout, &repos, cd_file.is_some(), None);
93	
94	    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show)?;
95	    terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;
96	
97	    match outcome? {
98	        Some(TuiOutcome::CdTo(path)) => {
99	            if let Some(file) = cd_file {
100	                std::fs::write(&file, &path)?;
101	            }
102	        }
103	        Some(TuiOutcome::ResumeSession { id, cwd }) => {
104	            super::show::resume_session(&id, &cwd);
105	        }
106	        Some(TuiOutcome::LaunchAgent { cli, cwd, session_name, prompt }) => {
107	            use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
108	            let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(&cli);
109	            if !cwd.is_empty() { cmd.current_dir(&cwd); }
110	            if !session_name.is_empty() { cmd.args(["-n", &session_name]); }
111	            if !prompt.is_empty() { cmd.arg(&prompt); }
112	            let err = cmd.exec();
113	            eprintln!("Failed to launch {cli}: {err}");
114	        }
115	        None => {}
116	    }
117	
118	    Ok(())
119	}

121	enum TuiOutcome {
122	    CdTo(String),
123	    ResumeSession { id: String, cwd: String },
124	    LaunchAgent { cli: String, cwd: String, session_name: String, prompt: String },
125	}
126	
127	enum Screen {
128	    Repos { sel: usize },
129	    Sessions { repo_idx: usize, sel: usize, sessions: Vec<RepoSession>, worktrees: Vec<RepoWorktree> },
130	}
131	
132	fn tui_loop(stdout: &mut impl Write, repos: &[Repository], has_cd: bool, start_repo: Option<usize>) -> Result<Option<TuiOutcome>> {
133	    let cwd = env::current_dir().ok().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string());
134	    let current_repo_dir = cwd.as_deref().and_then(|cwd| {
135	        repos.iter().find(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())).map(|r| r.directory.as_str())
136	    });
137	
138	    let start_sel = cwd.as_deref()
139	        .and_then(|cwd| repos.iter().position(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())))
140	        .unwrap_or(0);
141	
142	    let initial = if let Some(idx) = start_repo.filter(|&i| i < repos.len()) {
143	        let sessions = load_sessions(&repos[idx].directory);
144	        let worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[idx].directory);
145	        Screen::Sessions { repo_idx: idx, sel: 0, sessions, worktrees }
146	    } else {
147	        Screen::Repos { sel: start_sel }
148	    };
149	
150	    // Navigation stack — back pops; when empty the TUI exits.
151	    let mut stack: Vec<Screen> = vec![initial];
152	
153	    // Commands produced inside match arms, executed after the borrow ends.
154	    enum Cmd {
155	        None,
156	        Break,
157	        Back,
158	        PushSessions(usize),
159	        Cd(String),
160	        ShowSession(String),
161	        ResumeSession(String, String), // (session_id, repo_dir)
162	        Search(String),
163	        NewWorktree(String), // branch name
164	        NewSession(NewSessionConfig),
165	        Redraw,
166	    }
167	
168	    loop {
169	        let (w, h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
170	        let w = w as usize;
171	        let h = h as usize;
172	
173	        match stack.last().unwrap() {
174	            Screen::Repos { sel } => draw_repos(stdout, repos, *sel, current_repo_dir, w, h, has_cd)?,
175	            Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, sel, sessions, worktrees } => {
176	                draw_sessions(stdout, repos, *repo_idx, sessions, worktrees, *sel, w, h)?
177	            }
178	        }
179	
180	        let cmd = match event::read()? {
181	            Event::Key(k) => match stack.last_mut().unwrap() {
182	                Screen::Repos { sel } => match k.code {
183	                    KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => Cmd::Break,
184	                    KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if *sel > 0 { *sel -= 1; } Cmd::None }
185	                    KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if *sel + 1 < repos.len() { *sel += 1; } Cmd::None }
186	                    KeyCode::Char('g') => { *sel = 0; Cmd::None }
187	                    KeyCode::Char('G') => { *sel = repos.len().saturating_sub(1); Cmd::None }
188	                    KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right => Cmd::PushSessions(*sel),
189	                    KeyCode::Char('c') if has_cd => Cmd::Cd(repos[*sel].directory.clone()),
190	                    KeyCode::Char('s') => {
191	                        let repo_dir = repos[*sel].directory.clone();
192	                        match new_session_wizard(stdout, &repo_dir, w, h) {
193	                            Some(cfg) => Cmd::NewSession(cfg),
194	                            None => Cmd::Redraw,
195	                        }
196	                    }
197	                    KeyCode::Char('/') => match collect_search_query(stdout, w, h) {
198	                        Some(q) if !q.trim().is_empty() => Cmd::Search(q),
199	                        _ => Cmd::Redraw,
200	                    },
201	                    _ => Cmd::None,
202	                },
203	                Screen::Sessions { sel, sessions, repo_idx, .. } => match k.code {
204	                    KeyCode::Char('q') => Cmd::Break,
205	                    KeyCode::Esc | KeyCode::Char('h') | KeyCode::Left => Cmd::Back,
206	                    KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if *sel > 0 { *sel -= 1; } Cmd::None }
207	                    KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if *sel + 1 < sessions.len() { *sel += 1; } Cmd::None }
208	                    KeyCode::Char('g') => { *sel = 0; Cmd::None }
209	                    KeyCode::Char('G') => { *sel = sessions.len().saturating_sub(1); Cmd::None }
210	                    KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right => {
211	                        if sessions.is_empty() { Cmd::None }
212	                        else { Cmd::ShowSession(sessions[*sel].session_id.clone()) }
213	                    }
214	                    KeyCode::Char('r') => {
215	                        if sessions.is_empty() { Cmd::None }
216	                        else { Cmd::ResumeSession(sessions[*sel].session_id.clone(), repos[*repo_idx].directory.clone()) }
217	                    }
218	                    KeyCode::Char('/') => match collect_search_query(stdout, w, h) {
219	                        Some(q) if !q.trim().is_empty() => Cmd::Search(q),
220	                        _ => Cmd::Redraw,
221	                    },
222	                    KeyCode::Char('n') => match collect_text_input(stdout, "  new worktree branch: ", w, h) {
223	                        Some(b) if !b.trim().is_empty() => Cmd::NewWorktree(b.trim().to_string()),
224	                        _ => Cmd::Redraw,
225	                    },
226	                    KeyCode::Char('s') => {
227	                        let repo_dir = repos[*repo_idx].directory.clone();
228	                        match new_session_wizard(stdout, &repo_dir, w, h) {
229	                            Some(cfg) => Cmd::NewSession(cfg),
230	                            None => Cmd::Redraw,
231	                        }
232	                    }
233	                    _ => Cmd::None,
234	                },
235	            },
236	            Event::Resize(_, _) => Cmd::Redraw,
237	            _ => Cmd::None,
238	        };
239	
240	        match cmd {
241	            Cmd::None => {}
242	            Cmd::Break => break,
243	            Cmd::Back => {
244	                stack.pop();
245	                if stack.is_empty() { break; }
246	            }
247	            Cmd::PushSessions(idx) => {
248	                let sessions = load_sessions(&repos[idx].directory);
249	                let worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[idx].directory);
250	                stack.push(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx: idx, sel: 0, sessions, worktrees });
251	            }
252	            Cmd::Cd(path) => return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::CdTo(path))),
253	            Cmd::ResumeSession(id, cwd) => return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::ResumeSession { id, cwd })),
254	            Cmd::ShowSession(id) => {
255	                execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
256	                terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
257	                let _ = super::show::run(&id);
258	                terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();
259	                execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();
260	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
261	            }
262	            Cmd::Search(query) => {
263	                execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
264	                terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
265	                let _ = super::search::run(&query, 10);
266	                terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();
267	                execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();
268	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
269	            }
270	            Cmd::NewWorktree(branch) => {
271	                if let Some(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, worktrees, .. }) = stack.last_mut() {
272	                    let repo_dir = &repos[*repo_idx].directory;
273	                    let notification = create_worktree(repo_dir, &branch);
274	                    // Refresh the worktree list whether or not it succeeded.
275	                    *worktrees = fetch_worktrees(repo_dir);
276	                    // Show the result in the status bar until the next keypress.
277	                    let (tw, th) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
278	                    let msg: String = notification.chars().take(tw as usize).collect();
279	                    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", msg, width = tw as usize);
280	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, th - 1)).ok();
281	                    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m").ok();
282	                    stdout.flush().ok();
283	                }
284	            }
285	            Cmd::NewSession(cfg) => {
286	                // Create worktree if requested, then launch the agent.
287	                let launch_dir = if let Some(ref branch) = cfg.branch {
288	                    let _ = create_worktree(&cfg.repo_dir, branch);
289	                    if let Some(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, worktrees, .. }) = stack.last_mut() {
290	                        *worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[*repo_idx].directory);
291	                    }
292	                    let repo_path = std::path::Path::new(&cfg.repo_dir);
293	                    let parent = repo_path.parent().unwrap_or(repo_path);
294	                    let repo_name = repo_path.file_name()
295	                        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
296	                        .unwrap_or_else(|| "repo".to_string());
297	                    parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{}", branch)).to_string_lossy().to_string()
298	                } else {
299	                    cfg.repo_dir.clone()
300	                };
301	
302	                // Copy prompt to clipboard as a convenience.
303	                let prompt = cfg.prompt.trim().to_string();
304	                if !prompt.is_empty() {
305	                    if let Ok(mut child) = std::process::Command::new("pbcopy")
306	                        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
307	                        .spawn()
308	                    {
309	                        if let Some(stdin) = child.stdin.as_mut() {
310	                            let _ = stdin.write_all(prompt.as_bytes());
311	                        }
312	                        let _ = child.wait();
313	                    }
314	                }
315	
316	                let session_name = cfg.session_name.trim().to_string();
317	                return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::LaunchAgent {
318	                    cli: cfg.agent_cli,
319	                    cwd: launch_dir,
320	                    session_name,
321	                    prompt,
322	                }));
323	            }
324	            Cmd::Redraw => { execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok(); }
325	        }
326	    }
327	
328	    Ok(None)
329	}

331	// ── Renderers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
332	
333	fn draw_repos(
334	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
335	    repos: &[Repository],
336	    sel: usize,
337	    current_repo_dir: Option<&str>,
338	    w: usize,
339	    h: usize,
340	    has_cd: bool,
341	) -> io::Result<()> {
342	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
343	
344	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
345	
346	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(1);
347	    let mut row = 0usize;
348	
349	    let name_w = repos.iter().map(|r| r.name.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
350	    let dir_w  = repos.iter().map(|r| r.directory.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
351	
352	    for (i, repo) in repos.iter().enumerate() {
353	        if row >= content_h { break }
354	
355	        let is_sel = i == sel;
356	        let is_cur = current_repo_dir == Some(repo.directory.as_str());
357	        let dot_col = if is_cur { "38;5;82" } else { "38;5;240" };
358	
359	        let name_padded = format!("{:<name_w$}", repo.name);
360	        let dir_padded  = format!("{:<dir_w$}",  repo.directory);
361	        let line = format!(
362	            "\x1b[{dot_col}m*\x1b[0m \x1b[38;5;255m{name_padded}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;240m{dir_padded}  {}\x1b[0m",
363	            repo.remote
364	        );
365	
366	        print_row(stdout, &line, is_sel, SEL_BG, w, row as u16)?;
367	        row += 1;
368	    }
369	
370	    // Clear remaining rows
371	    while row < content_h {
372	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
373	        row += 1;
374	    }
375	
376	    // Status bar
377	    let cd_hint = if has_cd { "   c: cd" } else { "" };
378	    let bar = format!(
379	        "  {} repos   ↑↓/jk navigate   space: sessions   s: new session   /: search{}   q: quit  ",
380	        repos.len(), cd_hint
381	    );
382	    draw_status(stdout, &bar, w, h)?;
383	
384	    stdout.flush()
385	}
386	
387	fn draw_sessions(
388	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
389	    repos: &[Repository],
390	    repo_idx: usize,
391	    sessions: &[RepoSession],
392	    worktrees: &[RepoWorktree],
393	    sel: usize,
394	    w: usize,
395	    h: usize,
396	) -> io::Result<()> {
397	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
398	
399	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
400	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[1;38;5;229m{}\x1b[0m", repos[repo_idx].name)?;
401	    execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
402	
403	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2); // header + status bar
404	    let mut row = 1usize;
405	
406	    // ── Worktrees ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
407	    if !worktrees.is_empty() {
408	        for wt in worktrees.iter().take(content_h.saturating_sub(row + 1)) {
409	            if row >= content_h { break; }
410	
411	            let (branch_col, branch_label) = if wt.branch == "(detached)" {
412	                ("38;5;196", format!("detached:{}", &wt.head))
413	            } else if wt.is_main {
414	                ("38;5;229", wt.branch.clone())   // gold — main worktree
415	            } else {
416	                ("38;5;75",  wt.branch.clone())   // blue — linked worktree
417	            };
418	
419	            let path_short = short_path_s(&wt.path);
420	            let line = format!(
421	                "\x1b[38;5;240m  @ \x1b[{branch_col}m{branch_label}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;240m{path_short}\x1b[0m"
422	            );
423	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16))?;
424	            write!(stdout, "{line}")?;
425	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
426	            row += 1;
427	        }
428	
429	        // Blank separator between worktrees and sessions
430	        if row < content_h {
431	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
432	            row += 1;
433	        }
434	    }
435	
436	    // ── Sessions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
437	    let sessions_start = row;
438	    let sessions_h = content_h.saturating_sub(sessions_start);
439	    let scroll = if sel >= sessions_h { sel + 1 - sessions_h } else { 0 };
440	
441	    if sessions.is_empty() {
442	        if row < content_h {
443	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16))?;
444	            write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;240m  no sessions found\x1b[0m")?;
445	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
446	            row += 1;
447	        }
448	    } else {
449	        // Pre-compute column widths for table alignment
450	        let name_w   = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.session_name.trim().chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0).min(40);
451	        let branch_w = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.branch.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
452	        let agent_w  = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.agent.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
453	
454	        for (i, s) in sessions.iter().enumerate().skip(scroll) {
455	            if row >= content_h { break; }
456	
457	            let id_short: String = s.session_id.chars().take(8).collect();
458	            let ts = relative_time(s.updated_at);
459	            let name: String = s.session_name.trim().chars().take(name_w).collect();
460	            let age = (Utc::now() - s.updated_at).num_seconds().max(0);
461	            let dot_col = match age {
462	                a if a < 900   => "38;5;82",
463	                a if a < 3_600 => "38;5;214",
464	                _              => "38;5;240",
465	            };
466	
467	            let (name_col, meta_col, dot_char) = if s.backed_up {
468	                ("38;5;255", "38;5;240", "*")
469	            } else {
470	                ("38;5;242", "38;5;238", "·")
471	            };
472	            let branch_col = if s.backed_up { "38;5;75" } else { "38;5;239" };
473	
474	            let name_padded = format!("{:<name_w$}", name);
475	            let mut line = format!("\x1b[{dot_col}m{dot_char}\x1b[0m \x1b[{name_col}m{name_padded}\x1b[0m");
476	
477	            if branch_w > 0 {
478	                let b: String = s.branch.chars().take(branch_w).collect();
479	                let pad = " ".repeat(branch_w - b.chars().count());
480	                line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{branch_col}m{b}{pad}\x1b[0m"));
481	            }
482	
483	            if agent_w > 0 {
484	                let col = if s.backed_up { agent_color(&s.agent) } else { 239 };
485	                let a: String = s.agent.chars().take(agent_w).collect();
486	                let pad = " ".repeat(agent_w - a.chars().count());
487	                line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[38;5;{col}m{a}{pad}\x1b[0m"));
488	            }
489	
490	            line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{meta_col}m{id_short}  {ts}\x1b[0m"));
491	
492	            print_row(stdout, &line, i == sel, SEL_BG, w, row as u16)?;
493	            row += 1;
494	        }
495	    }
496	
497	    while row < content_h {
498	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
499	        row += 1;
500	    }
501	
502	    let bar = format!(
503	        "  {} sessions   ↑↓/jk navigate   space: view   r: resume   s: new session   n: new worktree   /: search   ←/h: back   q: quit  ",
504	        sessions.len()
505	    );
506	    draw_status(stdout, &bar, w, h)?;
507	
508	    stdout.flush()
509	}
510	
511	fn print_row(stdout: &mut impl Write, line: &str, selected: bool, bg: &str, w: usize, row: u16) -> io::Result<()> {
512	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row))?;
513	    if selected {
514	        let colored = with_bg(line, bg);
515	        let vis = visible_width(line);
516	        let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);
517	        write!(stdout, "\x1b[{bg}m{colored}{}\x1b[0m", " ".repeat(pad))?;
518	    } else {
519	        write!(stdout, "{line}")?;
520	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
521	    }
522	    Ok(())
523	}
524	
525	fn draw_status(stdout: &mut impl Write, bar: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
526	    let display: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();
527	    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", display, width = w);
528	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;
529	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")
530	}

532	// ── Worktree loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
533	
534	fn fetch_worktrees(repo_dir: &str) -> Vec<RepoWorktree> {
535	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
536	        .args(["worktree", "list", "--porcelain"])
537	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
538	        .output();
539	
540	    let Ok(out) = out else { return vec![]; };
541	    if !out.status.success() { return vec![]; }
542	    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
543	
544	    let mut result = Vec::new();
545	    let mut first = true;
546	
547	    // Each worktree block is separated by a blank line.
548	    for block in text.split("\n\n") {
549	        let mut path = String::new();
550	        let mut head = String::new();
551	        let mut branch = String::new();
552	        let mut detached = false;
553	
554	        for line in block.lines() {
555	            if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("worktree ") {
556	                path = v.to_string();
557	            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("HEAD ") {
558	                head = v.chars().take(8).collect();
559	            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("branch refs/heads/") {
560	                branch = v.to_string();
561	            } else if line == "detached" {
562	                detached = true;
563	            }
564	        }
565	
566	        if path.is_empty() { continue; }
567	        if detached { branch = "(detached)".to_string(); }
568	        if branch.is_empty() { continue; } // bare worktree — skip
569	
570	        result.push(RepoWorktree { path, branch, head, is_main: first });
571	        first = false;
572	    }
573	
574	    result
575	}
