577	// ── Session loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
578	
579	fn load_sessions(cwd_prefix: &str) -> Vec<RepoSession> {
580	    let mut sessions: Vec<RepoSession> = Vec::new();
581	
582	    // From DB
583	    if let Ok(conn) = db::connect() {
584	        if let Ok(mut stmt) = conn.prepare(
585	            "SELECT session_id, session_name, updated_at, agent_name FROM sessions WHERE cwd LIKE ?1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC"
586	        ) {
587	            let prefix_pattern = format!("{cwd_prefix}%");
588	            let _ = stmt.query_map([&prefix_pattern], |row| {
589	                let ts_str: String = row.get(2)?;
590	                let updated_at = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str)
591	                    .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))
592	                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now());
593	                Ok(RepoSession {
594	                    session_id: row.get(0)?,
595	                    session_name: row.get(1)?,
596	                    updated_at,
597	                    branch: String::new(),
598	                    agent: row.get(3)?,
599	                    backed_up: true,
600	                })
601	            }).map(|rows| {
602	                for r in rows.flatten() { sessions.push(r); }
603	            });
604	        }
605	    }
606	
607	    // From ~/.claude/projects/ — refresh existing DB sessions and add new ones
608	    if let Ok(home) = std::env::var("HOME") {
609	        let projects = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
610	        if let Ok(dirs) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects) {
611	            for dir_entry in dirs.flatten() {
612	                let dir = dir_entry.path();
613	                if !dir.is_dir() { continue }
614	                if let Ok(files) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) {
615	                    for f in files.flatten() {
616	                        let path = f.path();
617	                        if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some("jsonl") { continue }
618	                        let session_id = match path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
619	                            Some(s) => s.to_string(),
620	                            None => continue,
621	                        };
622	
623	                        let file_mtime = f.metadata().ok()
624	                            .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
625	                            .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
626	                            .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
627	
628	                        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&path) else { continue };
629	                        let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);
630	                        let mut session_name = String::new();
631	                        let mut cwd_found = String::new();
632	                        let mut last_prompt = String::new();
633	                        let mut git_branch = String::new();
634	
635	                        for line in reader.lines().flatten() {
636	                            let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };
637	                            match v["type"].as_str() {
638	                                Some("custom-title") => {
639	                                    if let Some(t) = v["customTitle"].as_str() { session_name = t.to_string(); }
640	                                }
641	                                Some("user") | Some("system") => {
642	                                    if cwd_found.is_empty() {
643	                                        if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str() { cwd_found = c.to_string(); }
644	                                    }
645	                                }
646	                                _ => {}
647	                            }
648	                            if v["type"].as_str() == Some("user") {
649	                                if let Some(t) = user_text(&v["message"]["content"]) {
650	                                    last_prompt = t;
651	                                }
652	                            }
653	                            // Track the most recent branch seen in this session
654	                            if let Some(b) = v["gitBranch"].as_str() {
655	                                if !b.is_empty() { git_branch = b.to_string(); }
656	                            }
657	                        }
658	
659	                        let display_name = if !session_name.is_empty() { session_name } else { last_prompt };
660	
661	                        if let Some(existing) = sessions.iter_mut().find(|s| s.session_id == session_id) {
662	                            // Refresh the name, timestamp, and branch from live JSONL
663	                            if !display_name.is_empty() { existing.session_name = display_name; }
664	                            if file_mtime > existing.updated_at { existing.updated_at = file_mtime; }
665	                            if !git_branch.is_empty() { existing.branch = git_branch; }
666	                            continue;
667	                        }
668	
669	                        if !cwd_found.starts_with(cwd_prefix) { continue }
670	
671	                        sessions.push(RepoSession {
672	                            session_id,
673	                            session_name: display_name,
674	                            updated_at: file_mtime,
675	                            branch: git_branch,
676	                            agent: String::new(),
677	                            backed_up: false,
678	                        });
679	                    }
680	                }
681	            }
682	        }
683	    }
684	
685	    sessions.sort_by(|a, b| b.updated_at.cmp(&a.updated_at));
686	    sessions
687	}

689	// ── Text input prompt ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
690	
691	/// Generic single-line input shown in the status bar. Returns None on Esc.
692	fn collect_text_input(stdout: &mut impl Write, prefix: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<String> {
693	    let mut value = String::new();
694	    execute!(stdout, cursor::Show).ok();
695	    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
696	
697	    loop {
698	        match event::read().ok()? {
699	            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {
700	                KeyCode::Esc => {
701	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::Hide).ok();
702	                    return None;
703	                }
704	                KeyCode::Enter => {
705	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::Hide).ok();
706	                    return Some(value);
707	                }
708	                KeyCode::Backspace => {
709	                    value.pop();
710	                    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
711	                }
712	                KeyCode::Char(c) => {
713	                    value.push(c);
714	                    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
715	                }
716	                _ => {}
717	            },
718	            _ => {}
719	        }
720	    }
721	}
722	
723	fn draw_input_bar(stdout: &mut impl Write, prefix: &str, value: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
724	    let prefix_len = prefix.chars().count();
725	    let text: String = value.chars().take(w.saturating_sub(prefix_len + 2)).collect();
726	    let content = format!("{prefix}{text}");
727	    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", content, width = w);
728	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;
729	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")?;
730	    let col = (prefix_len + text.chars().count()).min(w.saturating_sub(1)) as u16;
731	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(col, (h - 1) as u16))?;
732	    stdout.flush()
733	}
734	
735	fn collect_search_query(stdout: &mut impl Write, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<String> {
736	    collect_text_input(stdout, "  / ", w, h)
737	}

739	// ── New session wizard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
740	
741	/// A 4-step panel drawn over the bottom of the screen. Each completed step
742	/// stays visible with its confirmed value while the user fills the next one.
743	fn new_session_wizard(stdout: &mut impl Write, repo_dir: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<NewSessionConfig> {
744	    const LABEL_W: usize = 24;
745	    // Panel rows: title, blank, agent, branch, name, prompt, blank  (7 rows + 1 status bar)
746	    const PANEL_H: usize = 7;
747	
748	    let panel_top = h.saturating_sub(PANEL_H + 1);
749	
750	    let mut step = 0usize;           // 0=agent 1=branch 2=name 3=prompt
751	    let mut agent_sel = 0usize;
752	    let mut confirmed_agent = 0usize;
753	    let mut inputs = [String::new(), String::new(), String::new()]; // branch, name, prompt
754	
755	    execute!(stdout, cursor::Show).ok();
756	
757	    loop {
758	        // ── Draw panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
759	        // Title row
760	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, panel_top as u16)).ok();
761	        write!(stdout, "\x1b[1;38;5;229m  New Session\x1b[0m").ok();
762	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine)).ok();
763	
764	        // Blank separator
765	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (panel_top + 1) as u16)).ok();
766	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine)).ok();
767	
768	        let step_rows  = [panel_top + 2, panel_top + 3, panel_top + 4, panel_top + 5];
769	        let step_labels = ["  Agent", "  Worktree branch", "  Session name", "  Prompt"];
770	
771	        for (i, (&row, &label)) in step_rows.iter().zip(step_labels.iter()).enumerate() {
772	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16)).ok();
773	            let lpart = format!("{label:<LABEL_W$}");
774	
775	            if i < step {
776	                // Completed — dim label, value in colour

878	fn create_worktree(repo_dir: &str, branch: &str) -> String {

883	    };

888	    let wt_path = parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{branch}"));
889	
890	    // Try -b (new branch) first; fall back to checking out an existing branch.
891	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
892	        .args(["worktree", "add", "-b", branch, wt_path.to_str().unwrap_or("")])
893	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
894	        .output();
895	
896	    match out {
897	        Err(e) => format!("Error: {e}"),
898	        Ok(o) if o.status.success() => {

900	        }

904	            format!("Error: {first}")
905	        }

907	}

950	fn visible_width(s: &str) -> usize {

955	            for nc in chars.by_ref() { if nc.is_ascii_alphabetic() { break; } }
956	        } else {
957	            w += 1;
958	        }
959	    }

963	fn relative_time(dt: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
964	    let secs = (Utc::now() - dt).num_seconds().max(0);
965	    if secs < 604_800 {
966	        match secs {
967	            s if s < 60     => "just now".to_string(),
968	            s if s < 3_600  => format!("{} min{} ago", s/60,     if s/60==1     {""} else {"s"}),
969	            s if s < 86_400 => format!("{} hr{} ago",  s/3_600,  if s/3_600==1  {""} else {"s"}),
970	            s               => format!("{} day{} ago", s/86_400, if s/86_400==1 {""} else {"s"}),
971	        }
972	    } else {
973	        dt.with_timezone(&Local).format("%m/%d/%y").to_string()
974	    }
975	}

match secs {\n            s if s < 60     => \"just now\".to_string(),\n            s if s < 3_600  => format!(\"{} min{} ago\", s/60,     if s/60==1     {\"\"} else {\"s\"}),\n            s if s < Clean build. Here's what changed:

- `gossamer sessions` (and `gossamer sessions --all`) is now a full TUI instead of plain print output
- Each row shows: freshness dot · session name · **short cwd** · branch (if any) · agent · id · age — all column-aligned
- Keys: `j`/`k`/arrows navigate, `space`/`enter`/`→` opens the session viewer, `r` resumes the session, `q`/`Esc` exits
- The `--all` flag still controls whether sessions older than 3 days are included
- Local-repo sessions still sort to the top when run from inside a tracked repo

770	enum PagerOutcome { Quit, Resume, Delete }
771	
772	fn pager(cards: Vec<Card>, start_ts: Option<&str>) -> Result<PagerOutcome> {
773	    let (term_w, term_h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
774	    let mut w = term_w as usize;
775	    let mut h = (term_h as usize).saturating_sub(1);
776	
777	    let mut collapsed: std::collections::HashSet<usize> = cards.iter().enumerate()
778	        .filter_map(|(i, c)| if matches!(c, Card::ToolRound { .. }) { Some(i) } else { None })
779	        .collect();
780	
781	    let (mut flat, mut selectables, mut starts) = build_flat(&cards, w, &collapsed);
782	
783	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
784	
785	    let orig_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
786	    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
787	        let mut out = io::stdout();
788	        let _ = execute!(out, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show);
789	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
790	        orig_hook(info);
791	    }));
792	
793	    terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
794	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide)?;
795	
796	    // If a target timestamp was given, jump to the first card whose ts matches.
797	    let initial_sel = start_ts.and_then(|ts| {
798	        cards.iter().enumerate().find_map(|(ci, card)| {
799	            let card_ts = match card {
800	                Card::UserMsg { ts, .. } | Card::AsstMsg { ts, .. } | Card::System { ts, .. } => ts.as_str(),
801	                _ => return None,
802	            };
803	            if card_ts == ts {
804	                selectables.iter().position(|s| *s == Selectable::Card(ci))
805	            } else {
806	                None
807	            }
808	        })
809	    }).unwrap_or(if selectables.len() > 1 { 1 } else { 0 });
810	
811	    let mut sel: usize = initial_sel;
812	    let mut scroll: usize = 0;
813	    let mut flash:  Option<&str> = None;
814	    let mut awaiting_delete = false;
815	
816	    let result: Result<PagerOutcome> = loop {
817	        let s = starts[sel];
818	        let e = starts.get(sel + 1).copied().unwrap_or(flat.len());
819	        if s < scroll          { scroll = s; }
820	        else if e > scroll + h { scroll = e.saturating_sub(h); }
821	
822	        if let Err(err) = draw(&mut stdout, &flat, &starts, sel, scroll, h, w, selectables.len(), flash) {
823	            break Err(anyhow::anyhow!(err));
824	        }
825	
826	        match event::read() {
827	            Err(e) => break Err(e.into()),
828	            Ok(Event::Key(k)) => {
829	                let prev_flash = flash.take();
830	                match (k.code, k.modifiers) {
831	                    (KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc | KeyCode::Left, _) => break Ok(PagerOutcome::Quit),
832	                    (KeyCode::Char('c'), KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => break Ok(PagerOutcome::Quit),
833	                    (KeyCode::Char('r'), _) => break Ok(PagerOutcome::Resume),
834	                    (KeyCode::Char('d'), _) => {
835	                        awaiting_delete = true;
836	                        flash = Some("  Delete session? Press y to confirm, any other key to cancel  ");
837	                        continue;
838	                    }
839	                    (KeyCode::Char('y'), _) if awaiting_delete => {
840	                        break Ok(PagerOutcome::Delete);
841	                    }
842	
843	                    (KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j'), _) => {
844	                        if sel + 1 < selectables.len() { sel += 1; }
845	                    }
846	                    (KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k'), _) => {
847	                        if sel > 0 { sel -= 1; }
848	                    }
849	                    (KeyCode::Char('g'), _) => { sel = 0; }

Clean build, no errors. Here's what was done:

- **New `Card::RepoLink`** — prepended to the card list when the session's cwd matches a tracked repo. Renders as `▸ repo  RepoName  ~/path/to/repo` in muted colours.
- **`Card::Header` (session info)** — space/enter/right on it goes to `gossamer sessions` (all-sessions list).
- **`Card::RepoLink`** — space/enter/right on it goes to the repo's detail page via `run_for_dir`.
- **`PagerOutcome::GoToRepo`** / **`GoToSessions`** — `run_at` loops: after returning from a repo/sessions screen it offers to re-enter the same session viewer (so back-navigation from those screens returns here).
- **Initial cursor** — skips the two nav cards and lands on the first real message, same as before.
- The navigation graph is now complete: sessions list → session viewer → repo details (and back in any direction via the cards at the top).

Clean. The behavior is now:

- **First Ctrl+C** (in the pager): breaks back to the calling screen — sessions list, repos list, or the shell
- **Second Ctrl+C** (in sessions list or repos list): restores the terminal and calls `std::process::exit(0)` immediately
- **Ctrl+C from `gossamer show <id>` directly**: one press exits, since the pager is the top level and returns cleanly to the shell

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/stephanostsoucas/p/gossamer/src/commands/show.rs",
  "old_string": "// ── Rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────",
  "new_string": "// ── Markdown rendering ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nstatic MD_SKIN: OnceLock<termimad::MadSkin> = OnceLock::new();\n\nfn md_skin() -> &'static termimad::MadSkin {\n    MD_SKIN.get_or_init(termimad::MadSkin::default)\n}\n\nfn render_md(text: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {\n    let rendered = format!(\"{}\", md_skin().text(text, Some(width)));\n    // termimad appends a trailing newline; drop it to avoid spurious blank lines\n    let trimmed = rendered.trim_end_matches('\\n');\n    trimmed.lines().map(str::to_string).collect()\n}\n\n// ── Rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────"
}

Clean. What this does:

- `termimad` v0.34 is added as a dependency
- A lazily-initialised `MadSkin` (default skin) is shared across all renders — one allocation, not one per redraw
- `render_md(text, width)` calls `skin.text(text, Some(width))` which handles line-wrapping, then splits the result into the per-line `Vec<String>` our pager expects; the trailing newline termimad adds is stripped to avoid a spurious blank line
- Both user and assistant text blocks now go through this path — bold, italic, inline code, code fences, headers, bullet lists, and numbered lists will all render with proper ANSI formatting instead of raw markdown syntax
- The 2-space body indent is preserved by prefixing each rendered line with `"  "`

  "old_string": "// Apply a background color code to a pre-colored ANSI string by re-inserting\n// the background after every reset sequence.\nfn with_bg(s: &str, bg: &str) -> String {\n    let reinsert = format!(\"\\x1b[0m\\x1b[{bg}m\");\n    let body = s.replace(\"\\x1b[0m\", &reinsert);\n    format!(\"\\x1b[{bg}m{body}\")\n}",
  "new_string": "// Apply a selection background to a pre-colored ANSI string.\n// Parses SGR sequences properly so that any explicit background color emitted\n// by termimad (e.g. `\\x1b[48;5;238m` for inline code) is replaced with the\n// selection background rather than overriding it.\nfn with_bg(s: &str, bg: &str) -> String {\n    let bg_seq  = format!(\"\\x1b[{bg}m\");\n    let mut out = bg_seq.clone();\n    let bytes   = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut i   = 0;\n\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        if bytes[i] == b'\\x1b' && bytes.get(i + 1) == Some(&b'[') {\n            // Parse CSI sequence: ESC [ <params> <cmd>\n            let esc_start   = i;\n            i += 2;\n            let params_start = i;\n            while i < bytes.len() && !bytes[i].is_ascii_alphabetic() { i += 1; }\n            let cmd    = *bytes.get(i).unwrap_or(&b'm');\n            let params = &s[params_start..i];\n            i += 1;\n\n            if cmd == b'm' {\n                out.push_str(&rewrite_sgr(params, &bg_seq));\n            } else {\n                out.push_str(&s[esc_start..i]);\n            }\n        } else {\n            let ch_len = s[i..].chars().next().map_or(1, |c| c.len_utf8());\n            out.push_str(&s[i..i + ch_len]);\n            i += ch_len;\n        }\n    }\n\n    out\n}\n\n// Rewrite a single SGR parameter string so that any background colour is\n// replaced with the selection background. Foreground / attribute codes are\n// kept; a pure reset gets the background re-appended.\nfn rewrite_sgr(params: &str, bg_seq: &str) -> String {\n    if params.is_empty() || params == \"0\" {\n        return format!(\"\\x1b[0m{bg_seq}\");\n    }\n\n    let mut non_bg: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();\n    let mut found_bg = false;\n    let mut segs = params.split(';').peekable();\n\n    while let Some(seg) = segs.next() {\n        match seg {\n            // Standard background colours 40-47 and bright 100-107\n            \"40\"|\"41\"|\"42\"|\"43\"|\"44\"|\"45\"|\"46\"|\"47\"\n            |\"100\"|\"101\"|\"102\"|\"103\"|\"104\"|\"105\"|\"106\"|\"107\" => {\n                found_bg = true;\n            }\n            // 256-colour or true-colour background: 48;5;N or 48;2;R;G;B\n            \"48\" => {\n                found_bg = true;\n                match segs.next().as_deref() {\n                    Some(\"5\") => { segs.next(); }          // skip N\n                    Some(\"2\") => { segs.next(); segs.next(); segs.next(); } // skip R;G;B\n                    _ => {}\n                }\n            }\n            // Reset within a combined sequence — keep it\n            \"0\" => non_bg.push(\"0\"),\n            other => non_bg.push(other),\n        }\n    }\n\n    if !found_bg {\n        return format!(\"\\x1b[{params}m\");\n    }\n\n    let mut result = String::new();\n    if !non_bg.is_empty() {\n        result.push_str(&format!(\"\\x1b[{}m\", non_bg.join(\";\")));\n    }\n    result.push_str(bg_seq);\n    result\n}"
}

> AGENT

Clean. The new `with_bg` walks the string byte-by-byte, parsing each CSI SGR sequence:

- **Reset** (`\x1b[0m` or `\x1b[m`) → reset + reapply selection background
- **Background colour** (`40`–`47`, `100`–`107`, `48;5;N`, `48;2;R;G;B`) → replaced entirely with the selection background
- **Foreground / attribute codes** (bold, italic, fg colour, etc.) → kept as-is so text styling is preserved
- **Combined sequences** (e.g. `\x1b[0;48;5;238m`) → split: non-background parts kept, background part replaced

The "black bars" on inline code and code block backgrounds should now show the selection highlight colour instead.

> AGENT

Found it. Termimad doesn't use `\x1b[0m` to reset — it uses `\x1b[49m` (background-only reset) and `\x1b[39m` (foreground-only reset) separately. My `rewrite_sgr` didn't include `49` in its background-code list, so the background reset slipped through and cleared the selection colour mid-line.

> AGENT

The probe showed termimad emits `\x1b[48;5;235m` to set the code background and `\x1b[49m` to reset it — not the full `\x1b[0m` reset I'd assumed. That `49` passed through `rewrite_sgr` unchanged, which reset the terminal background mid-line, knocking out the selection colour. Adding `"49"` to the background-code match means it's now replaced with the selection background instead of letting it pass through.

242	                if !tool_parts.is_empty() { split.push(Card::ToolRound { parts: tool_parts }); }
243	            }
244	            other => split.push(other),
245	        }
246	    }
247	    let mut result = split;
248	
249	    // Merge adjacent ToolRound cards (can arise when consecutive asst turns were all-tools).
250	    let mut i = 1;
251	    while i < result.len() {
252	        if matches!(&result[i - 1], Card::ToolRound { .. }) && matches!(&result[i], Card::ToolRound { .. }) {
253	            if let Card::ToolRound { parts: new_parts } = result.remove(i) {
254	                if let Card::ToolRound { parts } = &mut result[i - 1] {
255	                    parts.extend(new_parts);
256	                }
257	            }
258	        } else {
259	            i += 1;
260	        }
261	    }
262	
263	    result
264	}

266	fn parse_user(content: &Value, tool_names: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Vec<UserPart> {
267	    let mut out = Vec::new();
268	    match content {
269	        Value::String(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => out.push(UserPart::Text(s.clone())),
270	        Value::Array(blocks) => {
271	            for b in blocks {
272	                match b["type"].as_str() {
273	                    Some("text") => {
274	                        if let Some(t) = b["text"].as_str() {
275	                            if !t.trim().is_empty() { out.push(UserPart::Text(t.to_string())); }
276	                        }
277	                    }
278	                    Some("tool_result") => {
279	                        let id = b["tool_use_id"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
280	                        let name = tool_names.get(&id).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "tool".to_string());
281	                        let is_error = b["is_error"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false);
282	                        let content = match &b["content"] {
283	                            Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
284	                            Value::Array(arr) => arr.iter()
285	                                .filter(|x| x["type"].as_str() == Some("text"))
286	                                .filter_map(|x| x["text"].as_str())
287	                                .collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n"),
288	                            _ => String::new(),
289	                        };
290	                        out.push(UserPart::ToolResult { id, name, content, is_error });
291	                    }
292	                    _ => {}
293	                }
294	            }
295	        }
296	        _ => {}
297	    }
298	    out

332	fn card_text(card: &Card) -> String {
333	    let mut out = String::new();
334	    match card {
335	        Card::RepoLink { name, dir, branch } => {
336	            out.push_str(name); out.push('\n');
337	            out.push_str(dir);  out.push('\n');
338	            if !branch.is_empty() { out.push_str(branch); out.push('\n'); }
339	        }
340	        Card::Header { title, cwd, branch, agent, .. } => {
341	            if let Some(t) = title { out.push_str(t); out.push('\n'); }
342	            if !cwd.is_empty()    { out.push_str(cwd);               out.push('\n'); }
343	            if !branch.is_empty() { out.push_str(&format!("[{branch}]")); out.push('\n'); }
344	            if !agent.is_empty()  { out.push_str(agent); out.push('\n'); }
345	        }
346	        Card::System { content, .. } => { if !content.is_empty() { out.push_str(content); out.push('\n'); } }
347	        Card::UserMsg { parts, .. } => {
348	            for part in parts {
349	                match part {
350	                    UserPart::Text(t) => { out.push_str(t); out.push('\n'); }
351	                    UserPart::ToolResult { name, content, .. } => {
352	                        out.push_str(&format!("[Result: {name}]\n{content}\n"));
353	                    }
354	                }
355	            }
356	        }
357	        Card::AsstMsg { parts, .. } => {
358	            for part in parts {
359	                if let AsstPart::Text(t) = part { out.push_str(t); out.push('\n'); }
360	            }
361	        }
362	        Card::ToolRound { parts } => {
363	            for part in parts {
364	                if let AsstPart::ToolCall { name, input, result, .. } = part {
365	                    out.push_str(&format!("[Tool: {name}]\n"));
366	                    if let Some(obj) = input.as_object() {
367	                        for (k, v) in obj {
368	                            let val = if let Value::String(s) = v { s.clone() } else { v.to_string() };
369	                            out.push_str(&format!("{k}: {val}\n"));
370	                        }
371	                    }
372	                    if let Some((content, _)) = result {
373	                        out.push_str(&format!("[Result]\n{content}\n"));
374	                    }
375	                }
376	            }
377	        }
378	    }
379	    out
380	}

386	        if let Some(obj) = input.as_object() {

392	        if let Some((content, _)) = result { out.push_str(&format!("[Result]\n{content}\n")); }
393	    }

397	fn copy_to_clipboard(text: &str) {
398	    use std::io::Write as _;
399	    use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
400	    if let Ok(mut child) = Command::new("pbcopy").stdin(Stdio::piped()).spawn() {
401	        if let Some(stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
402	            let mut stdin = stdin;
403	            let _ = stdin.write_all(text.as_bytes());
404	        }
405	        let _ = child.wait();
406	    }
407	}

609	    let mut w = 0usize;
610	    let mut chars = s.chars().peekable();
611	    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
612	        if c == '\x1b' {
613	            // consume up to and including the final byte of the CSI sequence
614	            for nc in chars.by_ref() {
615	                if nc.is_ascii_alphabetic() { break; }
616	            }
617	        } else {
618	            w += 1;
619	        }
620	    }
621	    w
622	}

624	// Apply a selection background to a pre-colored ANSI string.
625	// Parses SGR sequences properly so that any explicit background color emitted
626	// by termimad (e.g. `\x1b[48;5;238m` for inline code) is replaced with the
627	// selection background rather than overriding it.
628	fn with_bg(s: &str, bg: &str) -> String {
629	    let bg_seq  = format!("\x1b[{bg}m");
630	    let mut out = bg_seq.clone();
631	    let bytes   = s.as_bytes();
632	    let mut i   = 0;
633	
634	    while i < bytes.len() {
635	        if bytes[i] == b'\x1b' && bytes.get(i + 1) == Some(&b'[') {
636	            // Parse CSI sequence: ESC [ <params> <cmd>
637	            let esc_start   = i;
638	            i += 2;
639	            let params_start = i;
640	            while i < bytes.len() && !bytes[i].is_ascii_alphabetic() { i += 1; }
641	            let cmd    = *bytes.get(i).unwrap_or(&b'm');
642	            let params = &s[params_start..i];
643	            i += 1;
644	
645	            if cmd == b'm' {
646	                out.push_str(&rewrite_sgr(params, &bg_seq));
647	            } else {
648	                out.push_str(&s[esc_start..i]);
649	            }
650	        } else {
651	            let ch_len = s[i..].chars().next().map_or(1, |c| c.len_utf8());
652	            out.push_str(&s[i..i + ch_len]);
653	            i += ch_len;
654	        }
655	    }
656	
657	    out
658	}
659	
660	// Rewrite a single SGR parameter string so that any background colour is
661	// replaced with the selection background. Foreground / attribute codes are
662	// kept; a pure reset gets the background re-appended.
663	fn rewrite_sgr(params: &str, bg_seq: &str) -> String {
664	    if params.is_empty() || params == "0" {
665	        return format!("\x1b[0m{bg_seq}");
666	    }
667	
668	    let mut non_bg: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
669	    let mut found_bg = false;
670	    let mut segs = params.split(';').peekable();
671	
672	    while let Some(seg) = segs.next() {
673	        match seg {
674	            // Standard background colours 40-47 and bright 100-107
675	            "40"|"41"|"42"|"43"|"44"|"45"|"46"|"47"
676	            |"100"|"101"|"102"|"103"|"104"|"105"|"106"|"107" => {
677	                found_bg = true;
678	            }
679	            // 256-colour or true-colour background: 48;5;N or 48;2;R;G;B
680	            "48" => {
681	                found_bg = true;
682	                match segs.next().as_deref() {
683	                    Some("5") => { segs.next(); }          // skip N
684	                    Some("2") => { segs.next(); segs.next(); segs.next(); } // skip R;G;B
685	                    _ => {}
686	                }
687	            }
688	            // \x1b[49m — reset background to default (termimad uses this, not \x1b[0m)
689	            "49" => { found_bg = true; }
690	            // Reset within a combined sequence — keep it
691	            "0" => non_bg.push("0"),
692	            other => non_bg.push(other),
693	        }
694	    }
695	
696	    if !found_bg {
697	        return format!("\x1b[{params}m");
698	    }
699	
700	    let mut result = String::new();
701	    if !non_bg.is_empty() {
702	        result.push_str(&format!("\x1b[{}m", non_bg.join(";")));
703	    }
704	    result.push_str(bg_seq);
705	    result
706	}

708	fn wrap(text: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
709	    if width < 4 { return text.lines().map(str::to_string).collect(); }
710	    let mut out = Vec::new();
711	    for raw_line in text.lines() {
712	        if raw_line.is_empty() { out.push(String::new()); continue; }
713	        let mut remaining = raw_line;
714	        loop {
715	            if remaining.chars().count() <= width {
716	                out.push(remaining.to_string());
717	                break;
718	            }
719	            let break_pos = remaining.chars().take(width)
720	                .collect::<String>()
721	                .rfind(' ')
722	                .unwrap_or(width);
723	            let byte_pos = remaining.char_indices().nth(break_pos)
724	                .map(|(i, _)| i)
725	                .unwrap_or(remaining.len());
726	            out.push(remaining[..byte_pos].to_string());
727	            remaining = remaining[byte_pos..].trim_start_matches(' ');
728	        }
729	    }
730	    out
731	}

733	fn rel_time(iso: &str) -> String {
734	    let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(iso) else { return iso.to_string(); };
735	    let secs = (Utc::now() - dt.with_timezone(&Utc)).num_seconds().max(0);
736	    if secs < 604_800 {
737	        match secs {
738	            s if s < 60     => "just now".into(),
739	            s if s < 3_600  => format!("{} min{} ago", s/60,     if s/60==1     {""} else {"s"}),
740	            s if s < 86_400 => format!("{} hr{} ago",  s/3_600,  if s/3_600==1  {""} else {"s"}),
741	            s               => format!("{} day{} ago", s/86_400, if s/86_400==1 {""} else {"s"}),
742	        }
743	    } else {
744	        dt.with_timezone(&Local).format("%m/%d/%y").to_string()
745	    }
746	}

750	fn git_current_branch(cwd: &str) -> Option<String> {
751	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
752	        .args(["rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"])
753	        .current_dir(cwd)
754	        .output()
755	        .ok()?;
756	    if !out.status.success() { return None; }
757	    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
758	    if s.is_empty() || s == "HEAD" { None } else { Some(s) }
759	}
760	
761	fn create_resume_worktree(cwd: &str, branch: &str) -> Option<String> {
762	    let root_out = std::process::Command::new("git")
763	        .args(["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
764	        .current_dir(cwd)
765	        .output()
766	        .ok()?;
767	    if !root_out.status.success() { return None; }
768	    let repo_root = String::from_utf8_lossy(&root_out.stdout).trim().to_string();
769	
770	    let repo_path = std::path::Path::new(&repo_root);
771	    let parent = repo_path.parent()?;
772	    let repo_name = repo_path.file_name()?.to_str()?;
773	    let wt_path = parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{branch}"));
774	
775	    // Branch already exists; add a worktree pointing at it.
776	    let _ = std::process::Command::new("git")
777	        .args(["worktree", "add", wt_path.to_str()?, branch])
778	        .current_dir(&repo_root)
779	        .output();
780	
781	    if wt_path.exists() { Some(wt_path.to_string_lossy().to_string()) } else { None }
782	}

784	fn resume_via_entire(dir: &str, branch: &str) {
785	    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
786	
787	    let launch_dir = if !branch.is_empty() {
788	        let current = git_current_branch(dir);
789	        if current.as_deref() != Some(branch) {
790	            create_resume_worktree(dir, branch).unwrap_or_else(|| dir.to_string())
791	        } else {
792	            dir.to_string()
793	        }
794	    } else {
795	        dir.to_string()
796	    };
797	
798	    let Ok(out) = std::process::Command::new("entire")
799	        .arg("resume")

813	/// Find a Claude session by ID. Returns `(cwd, git_branch)` from the JSONL if found,
814	/// so `claude --resume` can be run from the correct directory and branch is known.
815	fn find_claude_session_cwd(session_id: &str) -> Option<(String, String)> {
816	    use std::io::BufRead;
817	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
818	    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
819	    for dir in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()?.flatten() {
820	        let jsonl = dir.path().join(format!("{session_id}.jsonl"));
821	        if !jsonl.exists() { continue; }
822	        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&jsonl) else { return Some((String::new(), String::new())); };
823	        let mut cwd = String::new();
824	        let mut branch = String::new();
825	        for line in std::io::BufReader::new(file).lines().flatten() {
826	            let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };
827	            if matches!(v["type"].as_str(), Some("user") | Some("system")) {
828	                if cwd.is_empty() {
829	                    if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str() { cwd = c.to_string(); }
830	                }
831	                if branch.is_empty() {
832	                    if let Some(b) = v["gitBranch"].as_str() { branch = b.to_string(); }
833	                }
834	                if !cwd.is_empty() && !branch.is_empty() { break; }
835	            }
836	        }
837	        return Some((cwd, branch));
838	    }
839	    None
840	}

842	fn do_resume(_agent: &str, session_id: &str, session_branch: &str, session_cwd: &str) {
843	    let current = git_current_branch(session_cwd);
844	    let same_branch = !session_branch.is_empty()
845	        && current.as_deref() == Some(session_branch);
846	
847	    let dir = if same_branch || session_branch.is_empty() {
848	        session_cwd.to_string()
849	    } else {
850	        create_resume_worktree(session_cwd, session_branch)
851	            .unwrap_or_else(|| session_cwd.to_string())
852	    };
853	
854	    resume_session(session_id, &dir);

857	/// Resume a session by ID, falling back to `entire resume` if the Claude JSONL is absent.
858	/// `fallback_cwd` is used for `entire resume` if the Claude session isn't found.
859	pub fn resume_session(session_id: &str, fallback_cwd: &str) {
860	    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
861	    if let Some((session_cwd, session_branch)) = find_claude_session_cwd(session_id) {
862	        let launch_dir = if session_cwd.is_empty() || !std::path::Path::new(&session_cwd).exists() {
863	            fallback_cwd.to_string()
864	        } else {
865	            session_cwd
866	        };
867	        let err = std::process::Command::new("claude")
868	            .arg("--resume")
869	            .arg(session_id)
870	            .current_dir(&launch_dir)
871	            .exec();
872	        eprintln!("exec failed: {err}");
873	        // exec failed — fall back to entire resume, checking out the session branch first
874	        resume_via_entire(&launch_dir, &session_branch);
875	    } else {
876	        resume_via_entire(fallback_cwd, "");
877	    }
878	}

Now I have the full picture. Here's the plan:
- Add `line_sel: usize` (flat index) as a second cursor
- `j/k` → card-level navigation (snap `line_sel` to card start)
- `↑/↓` arrows → line-by-line navigation (updates `sel` by derivation from `flat[line_sel].0`)
- `draw()` renders the card selection in dark grey and the active line in a lighter/distinct shade

> AGENT

Done. Here's what changed:

**Key bindings:**
- `j/k` → card-level navigation (jumps between message turns, snaps line cursor to card top)
- `↑/↓` arrows → line-by-line navigation (line cursor moves one row at a time; if you arrow into a new card's territory, the card selection follows)
- `u` / `PageUp` → page up (moves line cursor up by half a page)
- `PageDown` → page down (moves line cursor down by half a page)

**Highlighting:**
- All lines in the selected card: dark grey background `48;5;236` (as before)
- The active line within the card: lighter grey `48;5;240` — distinctly brighter than the card highlight

**Status bar** now shows `line X/Y` for your position within the current card.

  "old_string": "fn draw(\n    stdout:   &mut impl Write,\n    flat:     &[(usize, String)],\n    starts:   &[usize],\n    sel:      usize,\n    line_sel: usize,\n    scroll:   usize,\n    h:        usize,\n    w:        usize,\n    total:    usize,\n    flash:    Option<&str>,\n) -> io::Result<()> {\n    const SEL_BG:  &str = \"48;5;236\";   // card selection — dark grey\n    const LINE_BG: &str = \"48;5;240\";   // active line within card — lighter grey\n\n    let end = (scroll + h).min(flat.len());\n\n    for row in 0..h {\n        // Clear the whole row first so tabs and short lines never leave stale chars.\n        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;\n\n        let flat_idx = scroll + row;\n        if flat_idx < end {\n            let (card_idx, line) = &flat[flat_idx];\n            let is_sel_card = *card_idx == sel;\n            let is_sel_line = flat_idx == line_sel;\n\n            if is_sel_line {\n                let line_bg = with_bg(line, LINE_BG);\n                let vis = visible_width(line);\n                let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);\n                write!(stdout, \"\\x1b[{LINE_BG}m{line_bg}{}\\x1b[0m\", \" \".repeat(pad))?;\n            } else if is_sel_card {\n                let line_bg = with_bg(line, SEL_BG);\n                let vis = visible_width(line);\n                let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);\n                write!(stdout, \"\\x1b[{SEL_BG}m{line_bg}{}\\x1b[0m\", \" \".repeat(pad))?;\n            } else {\n                write!(stdout, \"{line}\")?;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Status bar\n    let card_start = starts[sel];\n    let card_end   = starts.get(sel + 1).copied().unwrap_or(flat.len());\n    let card_line  = line_sel.saturating_sub(card_start) + 1;\n    let card_total = card_end.saturating_sub(card_start);\n    let base = format!(\n        \"  {}/{} msgs  line {}/{}  j/k card  ↑↓ line  u/PgDn page  g/G ends  y/c copy  r resume  d delete  q quit  \",\n        sel + 1, total, card_line, card_total,\n    );\n    let bar = if let Some(msg) = flash {\n        let skip = msg.chars().count();\n        let rest: String = base.chars().skip(skip).collect();\n        format!(\"{msg}{rest}\")\n    } else {\n        base\n    };\n    let bar_display: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();\n    let padded = format!(\"{:width$}\", bar_display, width = w);\n    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, h as u16))?;\n    write!(stdout, \"\\x1b[7m{padded}\\x1b[0m\")?;\n\n    stdout.flush()\n}",
  "new_string": "fn draw(\n    stdout: &mut impl Write,\n    flat:   &[(usize, String)],\n    starts: &[usize],\n    sel:    usize,\n    scroll: usize,\n    h:      usize,\n    w:      usize,\n    total:  usize,\n    flash:  Option<&str>,\n) -> io::Result<()> {\n    const SEL_BG: &str = \"48;5;236\";\n\n    let end = (scroll + h).min(flat.len());\n\n    // Build the entire frame in one buffer to eliminate flicker.\n    let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity((w + 40) * (h + 2));\n    buf.extend_from_slice(b\"\\x1b[H\");   // cursor to (0, 0)\n\n    for row in 0..h {\n        let flat_idx = scroll + row;\n        if flat_idx < end {\n            let (card_idx, line) = &flat[flat_idx];\n            if *card_idx == sel {\n                let line_bg = with_bg(line, SEL_BG);\n                let vis = visible_width(line);\n                let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);\n                write!(buf, \"\\x1b[{SEL_BG}m{line_bg}{}\\x1b[0m\", \" \".repeat(pad))?;\n            } else {\n                buf.extend_from_slice(line.as_bytes());\n            }\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(b\"\\x1b[K\\r\\n\");  // clear to EOL then advance\n    }\n\n    // Status bar — cursor arrives here after the last \\r\\n above.\n    let sel_end = starts.get(sel + 1).copied().unwrap_or(flat.len());\n    let base = format!(\n        \"  {}/{} msgs  lines {}-{}  j/k ↑↓ navigate  u/PgDn page  g/G ends  y/c copy  r resume  d delete  q quit  \",\n        sel + 1, total, starts[sel] + 1, sel_end,\n    );\n    let bar = if let Some(msg) = flash {\n        let skip = msg.chars().count();\n        let rest: String = base.chars().skip(skip).collect();\n        format!(\"{msg}{rest}\")\n    } else {\n        base\n    };\n    let bar_display: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();\n    let padded = format!(\"{bar_display:width$}\", width = w);\n    write!(buf, \"\\x1b[7m{padded}\\x1b[0m\")?;\n\n    stdout.write_all(&buf)?;\n    stdout.flush()\n}"
}

> AGENT

Done. Here's what changed:

- **Flicker fixed**: `draw()` now builds the entire frame in a single `Vec<u8>` buffer and calls `stdout.write_all()` once per frame, eliminating the per-line flush that caused tearing.
- **Starts at bottom**: `initial_sel` defaults to the last selectable, so the most recent message is selected and the viewport scrolls to show it.
- **Single card highlight**: the line-by-line secondary highlight is gone — just the single dark grey card selection remains.
- **j/k and ↑/↓** both navigate between cards (same as before the line-sel experiment). `u`/`PageUp` and `PageDown` scroll the viewport by half a page.

> DEVELOPER

There is a problem expanding the tool call windows, it's not completely drawing over what used to be there. see the yellow text

> AGENT

The root cause: the `\r\n` buffering approach breaks when any `flat` line contains an embedded newline (JSON values, markdown content, etc.) — the cursor drifts one row down, and all subsequent rows land in the wrong position, leaving stale content uncovered. The fix is to use explicit `cursor::MoveTo` per row (via `queue!` into the same buffer, so we still flush once).

flush once to eliminate flicker.\n    // Use explicit cursor::MoveTo per row so embedded newlines in content can't\n    // shift subsequent rows into the wrong position.\n    let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity((w + 40) * (h + 2));\n\n    for row in 0..h {\n        queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;\n\n        let flat_idx = scroll + row;\n        if flat_idx < end {\n            let (card_idx, line) = &flat[flat_idx];\n            if *card_idx == sel {\n                let line_bg = with_bg(line, SEL_BG);\n                let vis = visible_width(line);\n                let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);\n                write!(buf, \"\\x1b[{SEL_BG}m{line_bg}{}\\x1b[0m\", \" \".repeat(pad))?;\n            } else {\n                buf.extend_from_slice(line.as_bytes());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Status bar\n    let sel_end = starts.get(sel + 1).copied().unwrap_or(flat.len());\n    let base = format!(\n        \"  {}/{} msgs  lines {}-{}  j/k ↑↓ navigate  u/PgDn page  g/G ends  y/c copy  r resume  d delete  q quit  \",\n        sel + 1, total, starts[sel] + 1, sel_end,\n    );\n    let bar = if let Some(msg) = flash {\n        let skip = msg.chars().count();\n        let rest: String = base.chars().skip(skip).collect();\n        format!(\"{msg}{rest}\")\n    } else {\n        base\n    };\n    let bar_display: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();\n    let padded = format!(\"{bar_display:width$}\", width = w);\n    queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, h as u16))?;\n    write!(buf, \"\\x1b[7m{padded}\\x1b[0m\")?;\n\n    stdout.write_all(&buf)?;\n    stdout.flush()\n}"

> AGENT

The fix: each row now gets an explicit `cursor::MoveTo(0, row)` before its content. If a line had an embedded `\n` (e.g. from a JSON string value in a tool call input), the old `\r\n` approach would drift the cursor down and leave that row uncovered — that was the stale yellow text. The new approach positions each row absolutely, so embedded newlines can't corrupt subsequent rows. The single-buffer flush is preserved so there's still no flicker.

42	struct SearchHit {
43	    kind: HitKind,
44	    title: String,
45	    repo_name: String,  // last path component of the cwd/dir
46	    excerpt: String,    // one-line text snippet (log hits only)
47	    dir: String,        // short path — shown dim at the end
48	    session_id: Option<String>,
49	    repo_dir: Option<String>,
50	    start_ts: Option<String>,
51	}

53	// ── Entry point ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
54	
55	pub fn run(query: &str, top_k: usize) -> Result<()> {
56	    let assets = crate::config::resolve_warp_assets()
57	        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(
58	            "Witchcraft assets not configured.\nRun: gossamer config <path-to-witchcraft-assets>"
59	        ))?;
60	
61	    let db_path = dirs::home_dir()
62	        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("cannot determine home directory"))?
63	        .join(".gossamer/search.db");
64	
65	    let db = witchcraft::DB::new_reader(db_path).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("failed to open search DB: {e}"))?;
66	    let device = witchcraft::make_device();
67	    let embedder = witchcraft::Embedder::new(&device, &assets).context("failed to load embedder")?;
68	    let mut cache = witchcraft::EmbeddingsCache::new(1);
69	
70	    // Per-type thresholds. Fetch at the global minimum so witchcraft doesn't
71	    // filter anything we'd keep, then post-filter per source type.
72	    const FLOOR:         f32 = 0.20;
73	    const LOG_THRESHOLD: f32 = 0.40;
74	    const SES_THRESHOLD: f32 = 0.25;
75	    const REP_THRESHOLD: f32 = 0.25;
76	
77	    let t0 = std::time::Instant::now();
78	    // Over-fetch so there are enough candidates after per-type filtering.
79	    let raw = witchcraft::search(&db, &embedder, &mut cache, query, FLOOR, top_k * 4, true, None)?;
80	    let ms = t0.elapsed().as_millis();
81	
82	    let mut hits: Vec<SearchHit> = raw
83	        .iter()
84	        .filter_map(|(score, meta, bodies, sub_idx, _date)| {
85	            let hit = parse_hit(meta, bodies, *sub_idx as u32);
86	            let threshold = match hit.kind {
87	                HitKind::Log     => LOG_THRESHOLD,
88	                HitKind::Session => SES_THRESHOLD,
89	                HitKind::Repo    => REP_THRESHOLD,
90	            };
91	            if *score >= threshold { Some(hit) } else { None }
92	        })
93	        .take(top_k)
94	        .collect();
95	
96	    // Direct name-match search: finds sessions/repos whose names contain all
97	    // query words even when hyphens/underscores differ from the query.
98	    for hit in search_sessions_by_name(query) {
99	        let already = hits.iter().any(|h| {
100	            matches!(h.kind, HitKind::Session) && h.session_id == hit.session_id
101	        });
102	        if !already {
103	            hits.insert(0, hit);
104	        }
105	    }
106	    for hit in search_repos_by_name(query) {
107	        let already = hits.iter().any(|h| {
108	            matches!(h.kind, HitKind::Repo) && h.repo_dir == hit.repo_dir
109	        });
110	        if !already {
111	            hits.insert(0, hit);
112	        }
113	    }
114	    hits.truncate(top_k);
115	
116	    if !io::stdout().is_terminal() {
117	        for h in &hits {
118	            println!("[{}]  {}", h.kind.label(), h.title);
119	        }
120	        return Ok(());
121	    }
122	
123	    let orig_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
124	    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
125	        let mut out = io::stdout();
126	        let _ = execute!(out, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show);
127	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
128	        orig_hook(info);
129	    }));
130	
131	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
132	    terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
133	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide)?;
134	
135	    let result = tui_loop(&mut stdout, &hits, query, ms);
136	
137	    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show)?;
138	    terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;
139	
140	    result
141	}

143	// ── Hit parsing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
144	
145	fn parse_hit(metadata_json: &str, bodies: &[String], sub_idx: u32) -> SearchHit {
146	    let sub_idx = sub_idx as usize;
147	    let meta: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(metadata_json).unwrap_or_default();
148	    let source = meta["source"].as_str().unwrap_or("claude");
149	
150	    match source {
151	        "session" => {
152	            let name = meta["session_name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
153	            let cwd  = meta["cwd"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
154	            SearchHit {
155	                kind: HitKind::Session,
156	                title: name,
157	                repo_name: last_component(&cwd),
158	                excerpt: String::new(),
159	                dir: short_path(&cwd),
160	                session_id: meta["session_id"].as_str().map(str::to_string),
161	                repo_dir: None,
162	                start_ts: None,
163	            }
164	        }
165	        "repo" => {
166	            let name = meta["repo_name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
167	            let dir  = meta["repo_dir"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
168	            SearchHit {
169	                kind: HitKind::Repo,
170	                title: name,
171	                repo_name: String::new(), // same as title, skip
172	                excerpt: String::new(),
173	                dir: short_path(&dir),
174	                session_id: None,
175	                repo_dir: Some(dir),
176	                start_ts: None,
177	            }
178	        }
179	        _ => {
180	            // "claude" — session log turn
181	            let name    = meta["session_name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
182	            let project = meta["project"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
183	            let idx = sub_idx.min(bodies.len().saturating_sub(1));
184	            let excerpt: String = bodies
185	                .get(idx)
186	                .and_then(|b| b.lines().find(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()))
187	                .map(|l| l.chars().take(80).collect())
188	                .unwrap_or_default();
189	            // Prefer the stored path (most reliable); fall back to session UUID lookup.
190	            let open_id = meta["path"].as_str()
191	                .filter(|p| !p.is_empty())
192	                .map(str::to_string)
193	                .or_else(|| meta["session_id"].as_str().map(str::to_string));
194	            // sub_idx 0 = header chunk; 1+ maps to turns[sub_idx - 1].
195	            let start_ts = if sub_idx > 0 {
196	                meta["turns"][sub_idx - 1]["timestamp"].as_str()
197	                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
198	                    .map(str::to_string)
199	            } else {
200	                None
201	            };
202	            SearchHit {
203	                kind: HitKind::Log,
204	                title: name,
205	                repo_name: last_component(&project),
206	                excerpt,
207	                dir: short_path(&project),
208	                session_id: open_id,
209	                repo_dir: None,
210	                start_ts,
211	            }
212	        }
213	    }
214	}

216	// ── TUI ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
217	
218	fn tui_loop(stdout: &mut impl Write, hits: &[SearchHit], query: &str, ms: u128) -> Result<()> {
219	    let mut sel = 0usize;
220	
221	    loop {
222	        let (w, h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
223	        draw(stdout, hits, query, ms, sel, w as usize, h as usize)?;
224	
225	        match event::read()? {
226	            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {
227	                KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => break,
228	                KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if sel > 0 { sel -= 1; } }
229	                KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if sel + 1 < hits.len() { sel += 1; } }
230	                KeyCode::Char('g') => { sel = 0; }
231	                KeyCode::Char('G') => { sel = hits.len().saturating_sub(1); }
232	                KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right | KeyCode::Enter => {
233	                    if let Some(hit) = hits.get(sel) {
234	                        // Temporarily leave the TUI, open the view, then come back.
235	                        execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
236	                        terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
237	
238	                        match hit.kind {
239	                            HitKind::Log => {
240	                                if let Some(id) = &hit.session_id {
241	                                    let _ = super::show::run_at(id, hit.start_ts.as_deref());
242	                                }
243	                            }
244	                            HitKind::Session => {
245	                                if let Some(id) = &hit.session_id {
246	                                    let _ = super::show::run(id);
247	                                }
248	                            }
249	                            HitKind::Repo => {
250	                                if let Some(dir) = &hit.repo_dir {
251	                                    let _ = super::status::run_for_dir(dir);
252	                                }
253	                            }
254	                        }
255	
256	                        terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();
257	                        execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();
258	                        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
259	                    }
260	                }
261	                _ => {}
262	            },
263	            Event::Resize(_, _) => {
264	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
265	            }
266	            _ => {}
267	        }
268	    }
269	
270	    Ok(())
271	}
272	
273	// ── Rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
274	
275	fn draw(
276	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
277	    hits: &[SearchHit],
278	    query: &str,
279	    ms: u128,
280	    sel: usize,
281	    w: usize,
282	    h: usize,
283	) -> io::Result<()> {
284	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
285	
286	    let query_words: Vec<String> = query
287	        .split_whitespace()
288	        .map(|s| s.to_lowercase())
289	        .collect();
290	
291	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
292	
293	    // Header
294	    let header = format!("search: \"{}\"  {} result(s)  {}ms", query, hits.len(), ms);
295	    let header_t: String = header.chars().take(w).collect();
296	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[1m{header_t}\x1b[0m")?;
297	    execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
298	
299	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2); // header + status bar
300	    let scroll = if sel >= content_h { sel + 1 - content_h } else { 0 };
301	    let mut row = 1usize;
302	
303	    for (i, hit) in hits.iter().enumerate().skip(scroll) {
304	        if row >= content_h { break; }
305	
306	        // ── Layout (left→right): badge  title  repo  excerpt  dir ──────────
307	        //
308	        // Fixed overhead: 2 (indent) + 5 (badge) + 2 (sep after badge) = 9
309	        // Dir: up to 28 chars, always at the end
310	        // Repo: up to 18 chars, only when non-empty
311	        // Excerpt: up to 45 chars, only when non-empty
312	        // Title: whatever's left, min 8
313	
314	        let dir_raw: String   = hit.dir.chars().take(28).collect();
315	        let dir_vis           = dir_raw.chars().count();
316	
317	        // Don't repeat the repo name when it's the same as the title (repo hits).
318	        let repo_raw: String  = if !hit.repo_name.is_empty() && hit.repo_name != hit.title {
319	            hit.repo_name.chars().take(18).collect()
320	        } else {
321	            String::new()
322	        };
323	        let repo_vis = repo_raw.chars().count();
324	
325	        // Right-side budget consumed by dir + repo
326	        let right_fixed = 2 + dir_vis + if repo_vis > 0 { 2 + repo_vis } else { 0 };
327	
328	        // Excerpt gets up to 45 chars of whatever's left after a min title of 10
329	        let excerpt_budget = w.saturating_sub(9 + 10 + right_fixed + 2).min(45);
330	        let excerpt_raw: String = hit.excerpt.chars().take(excerpt_budget).collect();
331	        let excerpt_vis = excerpt_raw.chars().count();
332	
333	        // Title fills the rest
334	        let title_budget = w.saturating_sub(
335	            9 + right_fixed + if excerpt_vis > 0 { 2 + excerpt_vis } else { 0 }
336	        ).max(8);
337	        let title_raw: String = hit.title.chars().take(title_budget).collect();
338	
339	        // Apply query-word highlighting to title and excerpt
340	        let title_hl   = highlight(&title_raw, &query_words);
341	        let excerpt_hl = highlight(&excerpt_raw, &query_words);
342	
343	        let badge_col = hit.kind.color();
344	        let badge     = hit.kind.badge();
345	
346	        let mut line = format!(
347	            "\x1b[{badge_col}m{badge}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;255m{title_hl}\x1b[0m"
348	        );
349	        if repo_vis > 0 {

376	fn print_row(stdout: &mut impl Write, line: &str, selected: bool, bg: &str, w: usize, row: u16) -> io::Result<()> {
377	    let content = format!("  {line}");

379	    if selected {
380	        let colored = with_bg(&content, bg);
381	        let vis = visible_len(&content);

383	        write!(stdout, "\x1b[{bg}m{colored}{}\x1b[0m", " ".repeat(pad))?;
384	    } else {
385	        write!(stdout, "{content}")?;
386	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
387	    }
388	    Ok(())

475	/// Highlight query words in `text` with bold amber. Works on byte positions in
476	/// the (ASCII-safe) lowercased copy, applied back to the original text.
477	fn highlight(text: &str, words: &[String]) -> String {
478	    if words.is_empty() || text.is_empty() {
479	        return text.to_string();
480	    }
481	
482	    let lower = text.to_lowercase();
483	    let mut ranges: Vec<(usize, usize)> = vec![];
484	
485	    for word in words {
486	        let mut start = 0;
487	        while let Some(pos) = lower[start..].find(word.as_str()) {
488	            let abs = start + pos;
489	            let end = abs + word.len();
490	            if lower.is_char_boundary(abs) && lower.is_char_boundary(end) {
491	                ranges.push((abs, end));
492	            }
493	            start = abs + 1;
494	        }
495	    }
496	
497	    if ranges.is_empty() {
498	        return text.to_string();
499	    }
500	
501	    ranges.sort_unstable();
502	    let mut merged: Vec<(usize, usize)> = vec![];
503	    for (s, e) in ranges {
504	        if let Some(last) = merged.last_mut() {
505	            if s < last.1 {
506	                last.1 = last.1.max(e);
507	                continue;
508	            }
509	        }
510	        merged.push((s, e));
511	    }
512	
513	    let mut out = String::new();
514	    let mut cursor = 0;
515	    for (s, e) in merged {
516	        out.push_str(&text[cursor..s]);
517	        out.push_str("\x1b[38;5;220;1m");
518	        out.push_str(&text[s..e]);
519	        out.push_str("\x1b[0m");
520	        cursor = e;
521	    }
522	    out.push_str(&text[cursor..]);
523	    out
524	}
525	
526	fn with_bg(s: &str, bg: &str) -> String {
527	    let reinsert = format!("\x1b[0m\x1b[{bg}m");
528	    let body = s.replace("\x1b[0m", &reinsert);
529	    format!("\x1b[{bg}m{body}")
530	}
531	
532	fn visible_len(s: &str) -> usize {
533	    let mut w = 0usize;
534	    let mut chars = s.chars().peekable();
535	    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
536	        if c == '\x1b' {
537	            for nc in chars.by_ref() { if nc.is_ascii_alphabetic() { break; } }
538	        } else {
539	            w += 1;
540	        }
541	    }
542	    w
543	}

545	fn short_path(path: &str) -> String {
546	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_default();
547	    if !home.is_empty() && path.starts_with(&home) {
548	        format!("~{}", &path[home.len()..])
549	    } else {
550	        path.to_string()
551	    }
552	}
553	
554	fn last_component(path: &str) -> String {
555	    std::path::Path::new(path)
556	        .file_name()
557	        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
558	        .unwrap_or_default()
559	}

We render only those\n    // whose absolute row index falls in [scroll, scroll + content_h).\n    let mut screen_row = 1usize; // next screen row available for content\n\n    for (i, hit) in hits.iter().enumerate() {\n        let flat_start = row_start_of(hits, i);\n        let selected   = i == sel;\n        let badge_col  = hit.kind.color();\n        let badge      = hit.kind.badge();\n\n        // ── Header row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n        let flat_hdr = flat_start;\n        if flat_hdr >= scroll && screen_row <= content_h {\n            // Right portion: repo (if distinct from title) + dir\n            let dir_vis  = hit.dir.chars().count();\n            let (right_ansi, right_vis) =\n                if !hit.repo_name.is_empty() && hit.repo_name != hit.title {\n                    let v = hit.repo_name.chars().count() + 2 + dir_vis;\n                    let s = format!(\n                        \"\\x1b[38;5;244m{}\\x1b[0m  \\x1b[38;5;238m{}\\x1b[0m\",\n                        hit.repo_name, hit.dir\n                    );\n                    (s, v)\n                } else {\n                    (format!(\"\\x1b[38;5;238m{}\\x1b[0m\", hit.dir), dir_vis)\n                };\n\n            // Left portion: indent + badge + title (title fills remaining space)\n            let badge_vis   = badge.len();\n            let left_fixed  = 2 + badge_vis + 2; // indent + badge + gap\n            let right_total = 2 + right_vis;      // gap before right + right\n            let title_w     = w.saturating_sub(left_fixed + right_total).max(4);\n            let title_t: String = hit.title.chars().take(title_w).collect();\n            let title_vis   = title_t.chars().count();\n\n            let gap = w.saturating_sub(left_fixed + title_vis + right_total);\n            let hdr_line = format!(\n                \"  \\x1b[{badge_col}m{badge}\\x1b[0m  \\x1b[38;5;255m{title_t}\\x1b[0m{}  {right_ansi}\",\n                \" \".repeat(gap),\n            );\n\n            queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, screen_row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;\n            if selected {\n                let colored = with_bg(&hdr_line, SEL_BG);\n                let vis = visible_len(&hdr_line);\n                let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);\n                write!(buf, \"\\x1b[{SEL_BG}m{colored}{}\\x1b[0m\", \" \".repeat(pad))?;\n            } else {\n                write!(buf, \"{hdr_line}\")?;\n            }\n            screen_row += 1;\n        } else if flat_hdr < scroll {\n            // This row is above the viewport — skip but don't increment screen_row.\n        } else {\n            break; // screen is full\n        }\n\n        // ── Excerpt row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n        if !hit.excerpt.is_empty() {\n            let flat_exc = flat_start + 1;\n            if flat_exc >= scroll && screen_row <= content_h {\n                let exc_t: String = hit.excerpt.chars().take(w.saturating_sub(4)).collect();\n                let exc_line = format!(\"    \\x1b[38;5;242m{exc_t}\\x1b[0m\");\n\n                queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, screen_row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;\n                if selected {\n                    let colored = with_bg(&exc_line, SEL_BG);\n                    let vis = visible_len(&exc_line);\n                    let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);\n                    write!(buf, \"\\x1b[{SEL_BG}m{colored}{}\\x1b[0m\", \" \".repeat(pad))?;\n                } else {\n                    write!(buf, \"{exc_line}\")?;\n                }\n                screen_row += 1;\n            } else if flat_exc >= scroll {\n                break;\n            }\n            // flat_exc < scroll: skip, no screen_row increment\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Clear any leftover rows below the results.\n    while screen_row <= content_h {\n        queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, screen_row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;\n        screen_row += 1;\n    }\n\n    // ── Status bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    let bar = \"  ↑↓/jk: navigate   space/→: open   q/esc: quit  \";\n    let bar_t: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();\n    let padded = format!(\"{bar_t:<width$}\", width = w);\n    queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;\n    write!(buf, \"\\x1b[7m{padded}\\x1b[0m\")?;\n\n    stdout.write_all(&buf)?;\n    stdout.flush()\n}"
}

  "old_string": "/// Highlight query words in `text` with bold amber. Works on byte positions in\n/// the (ASCII-safe) lowercased copy, applied back to the original text.\nfn highlight(text: &str, words: &[String]) -> String {\n    if words.is_empty() || text.is_empty() {\n        return text.to_string();\n    }\n\n    let lower = text.to_lowercase();\n    let mut ranges: Vec<(usize, usize)> = vec![];\n\n    for word in words {\n        let mut start = 0;\n        while let Some(pos) = lower[start..].find(word.as_str()) {\n            let abs = start + pos;\n            let end = abs + word.len();\n            if lower.is_char_boundary(abs) && lower.is_char_boundary(end) {\n                ranges.push((abs, end));\n            }\n            start = abs + 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if ranges.is_empty() {\n        return text.to_string();\n    }\n\n    ranges.sort_unstable();\n    let mut merged: Vec<(usize, usize)> = vec![];\n    for (s, e) in ranges {\n        if let Some(last) = merged.last_mut() {\n            if s < last.1 {\n                last.1 = last.1.max(e);\n                continue;\n            }\n        }\n        merged.push((s, e));\n    }\n\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    let mut cursor = 0;\n    for (s, e) in merged {\n        out.push_str(&text[cursor..s]);\n        out.push_str(\"\\x1b[38;5;220;1m\");\n        out.push_str(&text[s..e]);\n        out.push_str(\"\\x1b[0m\");\n        cursor = e;\n    }\n    out.push_str(&text[cursor..]);\n    out\n}\n\n",
  "new_string": "\n"
}

123	fn tui_loop(stdout: &mut impl Write, sessions: &[DisplaySession]) -> Option<Action> {
124	    let mut sel = 0usize;
125	
126	    loop {
127	        let (w, h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
128	        let w = w as usize;
129	        let h = h as usize;
130	
131	        draw(stdout, sessions, sel, w, h).ok();
132	
133	        match event::read().ok()? {
134	            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {
135	                KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => break,
136	                KeyCode::Char('c') if k.modifiers.contains(crossterm::event::KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
137	                    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
138	                    terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
139	                    std::process::exit(0);
140	                }
141	                KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if sel > 0 { sel -= 1; } }
142	                KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if sel + 1 < sessions.len() { sel += 1; } }
143	                KeyCode::Char('g') => { sel = 0; }
144	                KeyCode::Char('G') => { sel = sessions.len().saturating_sub(1); }
145	                KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right | KeyCode::Enter => {
146	                    return Some(Action::Show(sessions[sel].session_id.clone()));
147	                }
148	                KeyCode::Char('r') => {
149	                    let s = &sessions[sel];
150	                    return Some(Action::Resume(s.session_id.clone(), s.cwd.clone()));
151	                }
152	                _ => {}
153	            },
154	            Event::Resize(_, _) => {
155	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
156	            }
157	            _ => {}
158	        }
159	    }
160	
161	    None
162	}

164	fn draw(stdout: &mut impl Write, sessions: &[DisplaySession], sel: usize, w: usize, h: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
165	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
166	
167	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(1);
168	    let scroll = if sel >= content_h { sel + 1 - content_h } else { 0 };
169	
170	    // Pre-compute column widths
171	    let name_w = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.session_name.trim().chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0).min(40);
172	    let cwd_w  = sessions.iter().map(|s| short_cwd(&s.cwd).chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
173	    let branch_w = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.branch.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
174	    let agent_w  = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.agent_name.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
175	
176	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
177	
178	    for row in 0..content_h {
179	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16))?;
180	        let idx = scroll + row;
181	        if idx >= sessions.len() {
182	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
183	            continue;
184	        }
185	
186	        let s = &sessions[idx];
187	        let is_sel = idx == sel;
188	
189	        let id_short: String = s.session_id.chars().take(8).collect();
190	        let ts = relative_time(s.updated_at);
191	        let age = (Utc::now() - s.updated_at).num_seconds().max(0);
192	        let dot_col = match age {
193	            a if a < 900   => "38;5;82",
194	            a if a < 3_600 => "38;5;214",
195	            _              => "38;5;240",
196	        };
197	        let (name_col, meta_col, dot_char) = if s.backed_up {
198	            ("1;38;5;255", "38;5;240", "*")
199	        } else {
200	            ("38;5;242", "38;5;238", "·")
201	        };
202	        let branch_col = if s.backed_up { "38;5;75" } else { "38;5;239" };
203	
204	        let name: String = s.session_name.trim().chars().take(name_w).collect();
205	        let name_padded = format!("{:<name_w$}", name);
206	
207	        let cwd_short = short_cwd(&s.cwd);
208	        let cwd_padded = format!("{:<cwd_w$}", cwd_short);
209	
210	        let mut line = format!(
211	            "\x1b[{dot_col}m{dot_char}\x1b[0m \x1b[{name_col}m{name_padded}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;240m{cwd_padded}\x1b[0m"
212	        );
213	
214	        if branch_w > 0 {
215	            let b: String = s.branch.chars().take(branch_w).collect();
216	            let pad = " ".repeat(branch_w - b.chars().count());
217	            line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{branch_col}m{b}{pad}\x1b[0m"));

219	
220	        if agent_w > 0 {

222	            let a: String = s.agent_name.chars().take(agent_w).collect();
223	            let pad = " ".repeat(agent_w - a.chars().count());

225	        }
226	
227	        line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{meta_col}m{id_short}  {ts}\x1b[0m"));
228	
229	        if is_sel {

252	fn scan_claude_projects(known_ids: &HashSet<String>, all: bool, cutoff: DateTime<Utc>) -> Vec<DisplaySession> {
253	    let home = match std::env::var("HOME") {
254	        Ok(h) => h,
255	        Err(_) => return vec![],
256	    };
257	    let projects_dir = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
258	    let Ok(projects) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects_dir) else { return vec![] };
259	
260	    let mut sessions: Vec<DisplaySession> = Vec::new();
261	
262	    for project_entry in projects.flatten() {
263	        let project_dir = project_entry.path();
264	        if !project_dir.is_dir() { continue }
265	
266	        let Ok(files) = std::fs::read_dir(&project_dir) else { continue };
267	
268	        for file_entry in files.flatten() {
269	            let path = file_entry.path();
270	            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some("jsonl") { continue }
271	
272	            let session_id = match path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
273	                Some(s) => s.to_string(),
274	                None => continue,
275	            };
276	
277	            let file_mtime = file_entry.metadata().ok()
278	                .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
279	                .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)

305	
306	// ── Rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
307	
308	fn draw(
309	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
310	    hits:   &[SearchHit],
311	    query:  &str,
312	    ms:     u128,
313	    sel:    usize,
314	    scroll: usize,
315	    w:      usize,
316	    h:      usize,
317	) -> io::Result<()> {
318	    use crossterm::queue;
319	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
320	
321	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2); // title bar (row 0) + status bar (row h-1)
322	    let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity((w + 40) * (h + 2));
323	
324	    // ── Title bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
325	    queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
326	    let hdr = format!("  search: \"{}\"  {} result(s)  {}ms", query, hits.len(), ms);
327	    let hdr_t: String = hdr.chars().take(w).collect();
328	    write!(buf, "\x1b[1m{hdr_t}\x1b[0m")?;
329	
330	    // ── Results ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
331	    // Each hit occupies rows_for_hit() absolute rows.  We render only those
332	    // whose absolute row index falls in [scroll, scroll + content_h).
333	    let mut screen_row = 1usize; // next screen row available for content
334	
335	    for (i, hit) in hits.iter().enumerate() {
336	        let flat_start = row_start_of(hits, i);
337	        let selected   = i == sel;

> AGENT

There's the answer. Both the UUID (`session_id`) and the full path are stored in the metadata — the ingest code writes both fields on lines 338 and 341. Then in `parse_hit`, we added this logic:

```rust
let open_id = meta["path"].as_str()
    .filter(|p| !p.is_empty())
    .map(str::to_string)
    .or_else(|| meta["session_id"].as_str().map(str::to_string));
```

The `path` field was added so `show::run_at` could open the session by file path directly (the file could be in any `~/.claude/projects/*/` subdirectory without having to search). But we then accidentally used that path as the `session_id` for everything including the DB lookup in `enrich_hits`.

The fix we already applied (stripping the path to its file stem) is the right workaround, but we could also clean this up at the source — `parse_hit` should store `path` and `session_id` in separate `SearchHit` fields so the two aren't conflated. The `session_id` field should always hold the UUID, and `path` can be used just for opening. That would be the cleaner fix if you want to revisit it, but the current workaround is correct.

55	    role: String,
56	    text: String,
57	    timestamp: String,
58	    ts_ms: i64,
59	    byte_offset: u64,
60	    byte_len: u64,
61	    git_branch: Option<String>,
62	}

66	    cwd: Option<String>,
