69	fn codepoint_len(s: &str) -> usize {
70	    s.chars().count()
71	}
72	
73	fn extract_text(content: &Content) -> Option<String> {
74	    match content {
75	        Content::Text(s) => Some(s.clone()),
76	        Content::Blocks(blocks) => {
77	            let texts: Vec<&str> = blocks
78	                .iter()
79	                .filter(|b| b.block_type == "text")
80	                .filter_map(|b| b.text.as_deref())
81	                .collect();
82	            if texts.is_empty() {
83	                None
84	            } else {
85	                Some(texts.join("\n"))
86	            }
87	        }
88	    }
89	}
90	
91	fn sanitize(text: &str) -> String {
92	    let s = strip_system_content(text);
93	    let s = strip_code(&s);
94	    let s = strip_tables(&s);
95	    compact(&s)
96	}
97	
98	fn strip_system_content(text: &str) -> String {
99	    let mut s = text.to_string();
100	    let re_open = Regex::new(r"<([a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-:][a-z0-9_]+)+)[\s>]").unwrap();
101	    loop {
102	        let m = match re_open.find(&s) {
103	            Some(m) => m,
104	            None => break,
105	        };
106	        let start = m.start();
107	        let caps = re_open.captures(&s[start..]).unwrap();
108	        let tag_name = caps.get(1).unwrap().as_str().to_string();
109	        let close_tag = format!("</{tag_name}>");
110	        let after_open = match s[start..].find('>') {
111	            Some(i) => start + i + 1,
112	            None => break,
113	        };
114	        let end = match s[after_open..].find(&close_tag) {
115	            Some(i) => after_open + i + close_tag.len(),
116	            None => {
117	                let line_end = s[start..].find('\n').map(|i| start + i + 1).unwrap_or(s.len());
118	                s.replace_range(start..line_end, "");
119	                continue;
120	            }
121	        };
122	        s.replace_range(start..end, "");
123	    }
124	    let re = Regex::new(r"\[Request interrupted by user[^\]]*\]").unwrap();
125	    s = re.replace_all(&s, "").to_string();
126	    if let Some(idx) = s.find("This session is being continued from a previous conversation") {
127	        s.truncate(idx);
128	    }
129	    s
130	}
131	
132	fn strip_code(text: &str) -> String {
133	    let re = Regex::new(r"```[\s\S]*?```").unwrap();
134	    let s = re.replace_all(text, " ").to_string();
135	    let re = Regex::new(r"```[\s\S]*$").unwrap();
136	    let s = re.replace_all(&s, " ").to_string();
137	    let re = Regex::new(r"`[^`]*`").unwrap();
138	    re.replace_all(&s, " ").to_string()
139	}
140	
141	fn strip_tables(text: &str) -> String {
142	    text.lines()
143	        .filter(|line| {
144	            let t = line.trim();
145	            !(t.starts_with('|') && t.ends_with('|'))
146	        })
147	        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
148	        .join("\n")
149	}
150	
151	fn compact(text: &str) -> String {
152	    let re = Regex::new(r"\s{2,}").unwrap();
153	    re.replace_all(text, " ").trim().to_string()
154	}
155	
156	fn decode_project_name(dir_name: &str) -> String {
157	    dir_name.replace('-', "/").trim_start_matches('/').to_string()
158	}
159	
160	fn file_mtime_ms(path: &Path) -> Option<i64> {
161	    fs::metadata(path)
162	        .ok()?
163	        .modified()
164	        .ok()?
165	        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
166	        .ok()
167	        .map(|d| d.as_millis() as i64)
168	}
169	
170	fn parse_session_file(path: &Path) -> (SessionInfo, Vec<Chunk>) {
171	    let raw = match fs::read_to_string(path) {
172	        Ok(s) => s,
173	        Err(_) => return (SessionInfo { custom_title: None, cwd: None }, vec![]),
174	    };
175	
176	    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
177	    let mut info = SessionInfo { custom_title: None, cwd: None };
178	    let mut offset: u64 = 0;
179	
180	    for line in raw.lines() {
181	        let line_offset = offset;
182	        offset += line.len() as u64 + 1; // +1 for newline
183	
184	        if line.trim().is_empty() {
185	            continue;
186	        }
187	
188	        let entry: SessionEntry = match serde_json::from_str(line) {
189	            Ok(e) => e,
190	            Err(_) => continue,
191	        };
192	
193	        if entry.entry_type == "custom-title" {
194	            if let Some(ref title) = entry.custom_title {
195	                info.custom_title = Some(title.clone());
196	            }
197	            continue;
198	        }
199	
200	        if info.cwd.is_none() {
201	            if let Some(ref cwd) = entry.cwd {
202	                info.cwd = Some(cwd.clone());
203	            }
204	        }
205	
206	        if entry.entry_type != "user" && entry.entry_type != "assistant" {
207	            continue;
208	        }
209	
210	        let msg = match &entry.message {
211	            Some(m) => m,
212	            None => continue,
213	        };
214	
215	        let role = match &msg.role {
216	            Some(r) if r == "user" || r == "assistant" => r.clone(),
217	            _ => continue,
218	        };
219	
220	        let content = match &msg.content {
221	            Some(c) => c,
222	            None => continue,
223	        };
224	
225	        let raw_text = match extract_text(content) {
226	            Some(t) => t,
227	            None => continue,
228	        };
229	
230	        let text = sanitize(&raw_text);
231	        if text.is_empty() {
232	            continue;
233	        }
234	
235	        if !(MIN_CHUNK_CODEPOINTS..=MAX_CHUNK_CODEPOINTS).contains(&codepoint_len(&text)) {
236	            continue;
237	        }
238	
239	        let timestamp = match &entry.timestamp {
240	            Some(ts) if !ts.is_empty() => ts.clone(),
241	            _ => continue,
242	        };
243	
244	        let ts_ms = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&timestamp)
245	            .map(|dt| dt.timestamp_millis())
246	            .unwrap_or(0);
247	
248	        if ts_ms <= 0 {
249	            continue;
250	        }
251	
252	        chunks.push(Chunk {
253	            role,
254	            text,
255	            timestamp,
256	            ts_ms,
257	            byte_offset: line_offset,
258	            byte_len: line.len() as u64,
259	            git_branch: entry.git_branch,
260	        });
261	    }
262	
263	    chunks.sort_by_key(|c| c.ts_ms);
264	    (info, chunks)
265	}
266	
267	fn ingest_session(db: &mut DB, path: &Path, project_name: &str, mtime_ms: i64) -> Result<(usize, Option<String>)> {
268	    let (info, chunks) = parse_session_file(path);
269	    if chunks.is_empty() {
270	        return Ok((0, info.custom_title));
271	    }
272	
273	    let project_name = info
274	        .cwd
275	        .as_deref()
276	        .map(|cwd| cwd.trim_start_matches('/').to_string())
277	        .unwrap_or_else(|| project_name.to_string());
278	
279	    let session_id = path.file_stem().unwrap().to_string_lossy();
280	    let custom_title = info.custom_title.clone();
281	
282	    let session_title: String = info.custom_title.unwrap_or_else(|| {
283	        chunks
284	            .iter()
285	            .find(|c| c.role == "user")
286	            .map(|c| c.text.chars().take(240).collect())
287	            .unwrap_or_default()
288	    });
289	
290	    // Split into interactions: each starts at a user message
291	    let mut interactions: Vec<&[Chunk]> = Vec::new();
292	    let mut start = 0;
293	    for (i, chunk) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
294	        if chunk.role == "user" && i > start {
295	            interactions.push(&chunks[start..i]);
296	            start = i;
297	        }
298	    }
299	    interactions.push(&chunks[start..]);
300	
301	    let mut count = 0;
302	    for (turn_idx, interaction) in interactions.iter().enumerate() {
303	        let header = format!("[{project_name}] {session_title}\n");
304	        let mut all_parts = vec![header];
305	        let mut turns_meta: Vec<serde_json::Value> = Vec::new();
306	
307	        for chunk in *interaction {
308	            let label = if chunk.role == "user" { "[User]" } else { "[Claude]" };
309	            all_parts.push(format!("{label} {}\n", chunk.text));
310	            turns_meta.push(serde_json::json!({
311	                "role": chunk.role,
312	                "timestamp": chunk.timestamp,
313	                "off": chunk.byte_offset,
314	                "len": chunk.byte_len,
315	            }));
316	        }
317	
318	        let lengths: Vec<usize> = all_parts.iter().map(|p| p.chars().count()).collect();
319	        let body = all_parts.join("");
320	
321	        if body.trim().is_empty() {
322	            continue;
323	        }
324	
325	        let uuid = Uuid::new_v5(
326	            &CLAUDE_CODE_NAMESPACE,
327	            format!("{session_id}:{turn_idx}").as_bytes(),
328	        );
329	
330	        let branch: Option<&str> = interaction
331	            .iter()
332	            .filter_map(|c| c.git_branch.as_deref())
333	            .last();
334	
335	        let metadata = serde_json::json!({
336	            "source": "claude",
337	            "project": project_name,
338	            "session_id": session_id.to_string(),
339	            "session_name": session_title,
340	            "turn": turn_idx,
341	            "path": path.to_string_lossy(),
342	            "cwd": info.cwd,
343	            "mtime_ms": mtime_ms,
344	            "turns": turns_meta,
345	            "branch": branch,
346	        })
347	        .to_string();
348	
349	        let date = iso8601_timestamp::Timestamp::parse(&interaction[0].timestamp);
350	        db.add_doc(&uuid, date, &metadata, &body, Some(lengths))?;
351	        count += 1;
352	    }
353	
354	    Ok((count, custom_title))
355	}
356	
357	/// Ingest new or modified Claude Code sessions from ~/.claude/projects/ into
358	/// the witchcraft DB. Uses a watermark file to skip unchanged sessions on
359	/// subsequent runs. Returns the number of session turns ingested.
360	pub fn ingest_claude_code(db: &mut DB) -> Result<usize> {
361	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_default();
362	    let projects_dir = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
363	
364	    if !projects_dir.is_dir() {
365	        return Ok(0);
366	    }
367	
368	    let wm_path = watermark::claude_path();
369	    let wm_ts = watermark::mtime_ms(&wm_path);
370	
371	    let gossamer_conn = crate::db::connect().ok();
372	
373	    let mut turn_count = 0usize;
374	
375	    let mut entries: Vec<_> = fs::read_dir(&projects_dir)?
376	        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
377	        .collect();
378	    entries.sort_by_key(|e| e.file_name());
379	
380	    for entry in entries {
381	        let dir_path = entry.path();
382	        if !dir_path.is_dir() {
383	            continue;
384	        }
385	
386	        let dir_name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
387	        let project_name = decode_project_name(&dir_name);
388	
389	        let mut jsonl_files: Vec<PathBuf> = fs::read_dir(&dir_path)?
390	            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
391	            .map(|e| e.path())
392	            .filter(|p| p.extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "jsonl"))
393	            .collect();
394	        jsonl_files.sort();
395	
396	        for jsonl_path in &jsonl_files {
397	            if !watermark::file_newer_than(jsonl_path, wm_ts) {
398	                continue;
399	            }
400	            let mtime_ms = file_mtime_ms(jsonl_path).unwrap_or(0);
401	            eprintln!("{}", jsonl_path.display());
402	            match ingest_session(db, jsonl_path, &project_name, mtime_ms) {
403	                Ok((n, custom_title)) => {
404	                    turn_count += n;
405	                    if let (Some(conn), Some(title)) = (&gossamer_conn, custom_title) {
406	                        let sid = jsonl_path.file_stem().unwrap().to_string_lossy();
407	                        let _ = conn.execute(
408	                            "UPDATE sessions SET session_name = ?1 WHERE session_id = ?2",
409	                            rusqlite::params![title, sid.as_ref()],
410	                        );
411	                    }
412	                }
413	                Err(e) => eprintln!("  warning: failed to ingest {}: {e}", jsonl_path.display()),
414	            }
415	        }
416	    }
417	
418	    watermark::touch(&wm_path);
419	    Ok(turn_count)
420	}

> AGENT

No — the `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch isn't touched by the search indexer at all. The two pipelines are completely separate:

**What `gossamer index` / `gossamer refresh` does (the DB pipeline):**  
Reads git commits from `entire/checkpoints/v1`, extracts session metadata (session_id, name, cwd, agent, timestamps), and writes rows into the gossamer SQLite DB (`~/.gossamer/gossamer.db`). That's where `backed_up = true` comes from — it means "entireio has checkpointed this session."

**What the witchcraft indexer does (the search pipeline):**  
Reads JSONL files directly from `~/.claude/projects/*/`. It never looks at the git branch. It indexes the raw conversation turns for semantic search, storing the JSONL file path (and the session UUID as `session_id`) in the witchcraft metadata.

So a session is indexed into witchcraft by scanning `~/.claude/projects/`, independently of whether it was ever checkpointed onto `entire/checkpoints/v1`. The two indices overlap (most sessions appear in both) but are built from different sources. The `backed_up` flag just means "we can find this session's metadata in the gossamer DB", not "it was read from the checkpoint branch."

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use dirs::home_dir;
use rusqlite::Connection;
use std::fs;

pub fn connect() -> Result<Connection> {
    let gossamer_dir = home_dir()
        .context("cannot determine home directory")?
        .join(".gossamer");

    fs::create_dir_all(&gossamer_dir).context("failed to create ~/.gossamer")?;

    let db_path = gossamer_dir.join("gossamer.db");
    let conn = Connection::open(&db_path).context("failed to open database")?;

    conn.execute_batch("
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repositories (
            id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            directory TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            remote   TEXT NOT NULL,
            name     TEXT NOT NULL
        );")
    .context("failed to run schema migrations")?;

    // Idempotent column additions (ignored if column already exists)
    let _ = conn.execute("ALTER TABLE repositories ADD COLUMN last_indexed_commit TEXT", []);

    conn.execute_batch("
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
            session_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            agent_name   TEXT NOT NULL,
            user         TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
            cwd          TEXT NOT NULL,
            session_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            tokens_used  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_log (
            id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            type       TEXT NOT NULL,
            data       TEXT NOT NULL
        );
    ")
    .context("failed to run schema migrations")?;

    Ok(conn)
}

7	pub fn run() -> Result<()> {
8	    let conn = db::connect()?;
9	
10	    let mut stmt = conn.prepare("SELECT directory, name FROM repositories")?;
11	    let repos: Vec<(String, String)> = stmt
12	        .query_map([], |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?)))?
13	        .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
14	
15	    if repos.is_empty() {
16	        println!("No repositories tracked. Run `gossamer init` first.");
17	        return Ok(());
18	    }
19	
20	    let mut grand_total = 0usize;
21	
22	    for (dir, name) in &repos {
23	        match refresh_repo(&conn, dir) {
24	            Ok(0) => println!("'{}': up to date.", name),
25	            Ok(n) => {
26	                println!("'{}': {} new session(s) indexed.", name, n);
27	                grand_total += n;
28	            }
29	            Err(e) => eprintln!("'{}': error — {}", name, e),
30	        }
31	    }
32	
33	    println!();
34	    if grand_total > 0 {
35	        println!("{} new session(s) indexed.", grand_total);
36	    } else {
37	        println!("All repositories up to date.");
38	    }
39	
40	    Ok(())
41	}
42	
43	fn refresh_repo(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, repo_dir: &str) -> Result<usize> {
44	    // Fetch the branch from remote if possible.
45	    if let Some(remote_url) = checkpoint_remote_url(repo_dir) {
46	        let _ = Command::new("git")
47	            .args(["fetch", &remote_url, &format!("{}:{}", BRANCH, BRANCH)])
48	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
49	            .output();
50	    }
51	
52	    // Check branch exists.
53	    let check = Command::new("git")
54	        .args(["rev-parse", "--verify", BRANCH])
55	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
56	        .output()?;
57	
58	    if !check.status.success() {
59	        return Ok(0);
60	    }
61	
62	    let current_head = String::from_utf8(check.stdout)?.trim().to_string();
63	
64	    // Load stored watermark.
65	    let stored_head: Option<String> = conn.query_row(
66	        "SELECT last_indexed_commit FROM repositories WHERE directory = ?1",
67	        [repo_dir],
68	        |row| row.get(0),
69	    ).ok().flatten();
70	
71	    if stored_head.as_deref() == Some(current_head.as_str()) {
72	        return Ok(0); // nothing new
73	    }
74	
75	    // Collect metadata paths: added or modified since watermark (or all if first run).
76	    let meta_paths: Vec<String> = if let Some(ref last) = stored_head {
77	        // git diff gives a deduplicated file list between two tree states, so each
78	        // session appears at most once even if it was checkpointed many times.
79	        let out = Command::new("git")
80	            .args(["diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=AM", last, BRANCH])
81	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
82	            .output()?;
83	        String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?
84	            .lines()
85	            .filter(|l| is_meta_path(l))
86	            .map(str::to_string)
87	            .collect()
88	    } else {
89	        let out = Command::new("git")
90	            .args(["ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", BRANCH])
91	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
92	            .output()?;
93	        String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?
94	            .lines()
95	            .filter(|l| is_meta_path(l))
96	            .map(str::to_string)
97	            .collect()
98	    };
99	
100	    let user = std::env::var("USER")
101	        .or_else(|_| std::env::var("USERNAME"))
102	        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".to_string());
103	
104	    let mut count = 0;
105	    for meta_path in &meta_paths {
106	        let jsonl_path = format!(
107	            "{}full.jsonl",
108	            &meta_path[..meta_path.len() - "metadata.json".len()]
109	        );
110	        let meta_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, meta_path) {
111	            Ok(b) => b,
112	            Err(e) => { eprintln!("  skipping {}: {}", meta_path, e); continue; }
113	        };
114	        let jsonl_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, &jsonl_path) {
115	            Ok(b) => b,
116	            Err(_) => continue,
117	        };
118	        match parse_session(&meta_bytes, &jsonl_bytes, &user) {
119	            Ok((session_id, agent_name, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name)) => {
120	                upsert_session(conn, &session_id, &agent_name, &user,
121	                               &created_at, &updated_at, &cwd, &session_name)?;
122	                count += 1;
123	            }
124	            Err(e) => eprintln!("  skipping {}: {}", meta_path, e),
125	        }
126	    }
127	
128	    // Advance watermark.
129	    conn.execute(
130	        "UPDATE repositories SET last_indexed_commit = ?1 WHERE directory = ?2",
131	        rusqlite::params![current_head, repo_dir],
132	    )?;
133	
134	    Ok(count)
135	}
136

51	pub(crate) fn is_meta_path(l: &str) -> bool {
52	    l.ends_with("/metadata.json")
53	        && l.matches('/').count() == 3
54	        && l.split('/').nth(2).map_or(false, |s| s.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()))
55	}

57	fn index_repo(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, repo_dir: &str, _repo_name: &str) -> Result<usize> {
58	    if let Some(remote_url) = checkpoint_remote_url(repo_dir) {
59	        let _ = Command::new("git")
60	            .args(["fetch", &remote_url, &format!("{}:{}", BRANCH, BRANCH)])
61	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
62	            .output();
63	    }
64	
65	    let check = Command::new("git")
66	        .args(["rev-parse", "--verify", BRANCH])
67	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
68	        .output()
69	        .context("failed to run git")?;
70	
71	    if !check.status.success() {
72	        return Ok(0);
73	    }
74	
75	    let ls = Command::new("git")
76	        .args(["ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", BRANCH])
77	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
78	        .output()
79	        .context("git ls-tree failed")?;
80	
81	    let listing = String::from_utf8(ls.stdout)?;
82	
83	    let meta_paths: Vec<&str> = listing.lines().filter(|l| is_meta_path(l)).collect();
84	
85	    let user = std::env::var("USER")
86	        .or_else(|_| std::env::var("USERNAME"))
87	        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".to_string());
88	
89	    let mut count = 0;
90	
91	    for meta_path in meta_paths {
92	        let jsonl_path = format!("{}full.jsonl", &meta_path[..meta_path.len() - "metadata.json".len()]);
93	
94	        let meta_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, meta_path) {
95	            Ok(b) => b,
96	            Err(e) => { eprintln!("  skipping {}: {}", meta_path, e); continue; }
97	        };
98	        let jsonl_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, &jsonl_path) {
99	            Ok(b) => b,
100	            Err(_) => continue,
101	        };
102	
103	        match parse_session(&meta_bytes, &jsonl_bytes, &user) {
104	            Ok((session_id, agent_name, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name)) => {
105	                upsert_session(conn, &session_id, &agent_name, &user, &created_at, &updated_at, &cwd, &session_name)?;
106	                count += 1;
107	            }
108	            Err(e) => eprintln!("  skipping {}: {}", meta_path, e),
109	        }
110	    }
111	
112	    // Save commit watermark so `gossamer refresh` knows where to start next time.
113	    if let Ok(out) = Command::new("git").args(["rev-parse", BRANCH]).current_dir(repo_dir).output() {
114	        if out.status.success() {

116	            let _ = conn.execute(

120	        }
121	    }
122	
123	    Ok(count)
124	}

126	pub(crate) fn git_show(repo_dir: &str, path: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
127	    let out = Command::new("git")
128	        .args(["show", &format!("{}:{}", BRANCH, path)])
129	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
130	        .output()
131	        .context("failed to run git show")?;
132	
133	    if !out.status.success() {
134	        anyhow::bail!("object not found: {}", path);
135	    }
136	    Ok(out.stdout)

139	pub(crate) fn checkpoint_remote_url(repo_dir: &str) -> Option<String> {
140	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
141	    struct EntireSettings {
142	        strategy_options: Option<StrategyOptions>,
143	    }
144	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
145	    struct StrategyOptions {
146	        checkpoint_remote: Option<CheckpointRemote>,
147	    }
148	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
149	    struct CheckpointRemote {
150	        repo: String,
151	    }
152	
153	    let settings_path = std::path::Path::new(repo_dir).join(".entire").join("settings.json");
154	    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(settings_path).ok()?;
155	    let settings: EntireSettings = serde_json::from_str(&raw).ok()?;
156	    let cp_repo = settings.strategy_options?.checkpoint_remote?.repo;
157	
158	    let use_ssh = Command::new("git")
159	        .args(["remote", "get-url", "origin"])
160	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
161	        .output()
162	        .ok()
163	        .and_then(|o| String::from_utf8(o.stdout).ok())
164	        .map(|u| u.trim_start().starts_with("git@") || u.trim_start().starts_with("ssh://"))
165	        .unwrap_or(true);
166	
167	    let url = if use_ssh {
168	        format!("git@github.com:{}.git", cp_repo)
169	    } else {
170	        format!("https://github.com/{}.git", cp_repo)
171	    };
172	
173	    Some(url)
174	}

176	#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
177	pub(crate) fn parse_session(
178	    meta_bytes: &[u8],
179	    jsonl_bytes: &[u8],
180	    user: &str,
181	) -> Result<(String, String, String, String, String, String)> {
182	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
183	    struct SessionMetadata {
184	        session_id: String,
185	        agent: Option<String>,
186	        created_at: Option<String>,
187	        summary: Option<Summary>,
188	    }
189	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
190	    struct Summary {
191	        intent: Option<String>,
192	    }
193	
194	    let meta: SessionMetadata = serde_json::from_slice(meta_bytes)
195	        .context("failed to parse metadata.json")?;
196	
197	    let created_at: DateTime<Utc> = meta
198	        .created_at
199	        .as_deref()
200	        .and_then(|s| DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(s).ok())
201	        .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))
202	        .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
203	
204	    let session_name = meta
205	        .summary
206	        .and_then(|s| s.intent)
207	        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
208	        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("session:{}", &meta.session_id[..8]));
209	
210	    let agent_name = meta.agent.unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
211	
212	    let mut latest: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;
213	    let mut cwd = String::new();
214	    let mut last_prompt: Option<String> = None;
215	    let mut custom_title: Option<String> = None;
216	
217	    for line in jsonl_bytes.split(|&b| b == b'\n') {
218	        if line.is_empty() { continue; }
219	        let v: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(line) {
220	            Ok(v) => v,
221	            Err(_) => continue,
222	        };
223	
224	        if let Some(ts) = v.get("timestamp").and_then(Value::as_str) {
225	            if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(ts) {
226	                let dt: DateTime<Utc> = dt.with_timezone(&Utc);
227	                if latest.map_or(true, |l| dt > l) { latest = Some(dt); }
228	            }
229	        }
230	
231	        if cwd.is_empty() {
232	            if let Some(c) = v.get("cwd").and_then(Value::as_str) { cwd = c.to_string(); }
233	        }
234	
235	        match v.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
236	            Some("custom-title") => {
237	                if let Some(t) = v.get("customTitle").and_then(Value::as_str) {
238	                    if !t.trim().is_empty() { custom_title = Some(t.trim().to_string()); }
239	                }
240	            }
241	            Some("user") => {
242	                if let Some(Value::String(text)) = v.get("message").and_then(|m| m.get("content")) {
243	                    let text = text.trim().to_string();
244	                    if !text.is_empty() { last_prompt = Some(text); }
245	                }
246	            }
247	            _ => {}
248	        }
249	    }
250	
251	    let updated_at = latest.unwrap_or(created_at);
252	    // Priority: explicit rename > last user prompt > metadata summary
253	    let session_name = custom_title.or(last_prompt).unwrap_or(session_name);
254	
255	    Ok((
256	        meta.session_id,
257	        agent_name,
258	        created_at.to_rfc3339(),
259	        updated_at.to_rfc3339(),
260	        cwd,
261	        session_name,
262	    ))
263	}

265	pub(crate) fn upsert_session(
266	    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,

268	    agent_name: &str,
269	    user: &str,
270	    created_at: &str,
271	    updated_at: &str,
272	    cwd: &str,
273	    session_name: &str,
274	) -> Result<()> {
275	    conn.execute(
276	        "INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, agent_name, user, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name)
277	         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7)
278	         ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
279	           agent_name   = excluded.agent_name,
280	           updated_at   = excluded.updated_at,
281	           cwd          = excluded.cwd,
282	           session_name = excluded.session_name",
283	        rusqlite::params![session_id, agent_name, user, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name],
284	    )?;
285	    Ok(())
286	}

> AGENT

Now I have the full picture. The branch uses `<2char>/<10char>/<num>/` paths, and `session_id` is a UUID stored in `metadata.json`. The gossamer DB uses those UUIDs. There's no `cwd` in metadata — it comes from the JSONL content.

The right fix: read `full.jsonl` directly from the git branch for each tracked repo, indexed by the `session_id` from metadata. The `~/.claude/projects/` path is completely wrong for non-Claude agents.

Here's what needs changing:
1. `db.rs` — add `last_search_commit` column to track the search index watermark per repo
2. `claude_code.rs` — refactor to read from git branch instead of `~/.claude/projects/`

{\n        match ingest_repo(db, &gossamer_conn, repo_dir) {\n            Ok(n) => total += n,\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"  warning: failed to ingest repo {repo_dir}: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(total)\n}\n\nfn ingest_repo(\n    db: &mut DB,\n    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,\n    repo_dir: &str,\n) -> Result<usize> {\n    let head_out = Command::new(\"git\")\n        .args([\"rev-parse\", BRANCH])\n        .current_dir(repo_dir)\n        .output()?;\n\n    if !head_out.status.success() {\n        return Ok(0);\n    }\n    let current_head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&head_out.stdout).trim().to_string();\n\n    let stored_head: Option<String> = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT last_search_commit FROM repositories WHERE directory = ?1\",\n        [repo_dir],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    ).ok().flatten();\n\n    if stored_head.as_deref() == Some(current_head.as_str()) {\n        return Ok(0);\n    }\n\n    // Find meta paths changed since last search index run\n    let meta_paths: Vec<String> = if let Some(ref last) = stored_head {\n        let out = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .args([\"diff\", \"--name-only\", \"--diff-filter=AM\", last, BRANCH])\n            .current_dir(repo_dir)\n            .output()?;\n        String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?\n            .lines()\n            .filter(|l| is_meta_path(l))\n            .map(str::to_string)\n            .collect()\n    } else {\n        let out = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .args([\"ls-tree\", \"-r\", \"--name-only\", BRANCH])\n            .current_dir(repo_dir)\n            .output()?;\n        String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?\n            .lines()\n            .filter(|l| is_meta_path(l))\n            .map(str::to_string)\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    // Deduplicate: keep only the latest checkpoint per session (highest num in path)\n    // Path: <prefix2>/<id10>/<num>/metadata.json\n    let mut latest: std::collections::HashMap<String, (u32, String)> = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n    for meta_path in &meta_paths {\n        let parts: Vec<&str> = meta_path.splitn(4, '/').collect();\n        if parts.len() != 4 { continue }\n        let checkpoint_key = format!(\"{}/{}\", parts[0], parts[1]);\n        let num: u32 = parts[2].parse().unwrap_or(0);\n        let entry = latest.entry(checkpoint_key).or_insert((0, meta_path.clone()));\n        if num >= entry.0 {\n            *entry = (num, meta_path.clone());\n        }\n    }\n\n    let mut count = 0usize;\n\n    for (_key, (_num, meta_path)) in &latest {\n        let jsonl_path = format!(\n            \"{}full.jsonl\",\n            &meta_path[..meta_path.len() - \"metadata.json\".len()]\n        );\n\n        let meta_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, meta_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(e) => { eprintln!(\"  skipping {meta_path}: {e}\"); continue }\n        };\n        let jsonl_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, &jsonl_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let meta: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_slice(&meta_bytes) {\n            Ok(v) => v,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n        let session_id = match meta[\"session_id\"].as_str() {\n            Some(s) => s.to_string(),\n            None => continue,\n        };\n\n        let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(&jsonl_bytes);\n        eprintln!(\"{jsonl_path}\");\n\n        match ingest_session(db, &session_id, &content, \"\") {\n            Ok((n, custom_title)) => {\n                count += n;\n                if let Some(title) = custom_title {\n                    let _ = conn.execute(\n                        \"UPDATE sessions SET session_name = ?1 WHERE session_id = ?2\",\n                        rusqlite::params![title, session_id.as_str()],\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"  warning: failed to ingest {session_id}: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE repositories SET last_search_commit = ?1 WHERE directory = ?2\",\n        rusqlite::params![current_head, repo_dir],\n    )?;\n\n    Ok(count)\n}\n"
}

> AGENT

Done. Here's what changed:

- **Source**: Reads `full.jsonl` directly from the `entire/checkpoints/v1` git branch via `git show`, not from `~/.claude/projects/`. This means sessions from any agent (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) are indexed as long as `entire` checkpointed them.
- **Watermark**: Per-repo `last_search_commit` column in the `repositories` table (separate from `last_indexed_commit` used by `gossamer refresh`). Only re-indexes when the branch HEAD has advanced.
- **Deduplication**: When a session has multiple checkpoint numbers (0, 1, 2…), only the latest one's `full.jsonl` is indexed — it contains the complete conversation up to that point.
- **`session_id`**: Comes from `metadata.json` (the UUID), not the path, so it matches the gossamer DB correctly.

84	    let raw = witchcraft::search(&db, &embedder, &mut cache, query, FLOOR, top_k * 4, true, None)?;

233	fn tui_loop(stdout: &mut impl Write, hits: &[SearchHit], query: &str, ms: u128) -> Result<()> {
234	    let mut sel    = 0usize;
235	    let mut scroll = 0usize;
236	
237	    loop {
238	        let (w, h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
239	        let w = w as usize;
240	        let h = h as usize;
241	        let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2);
242	
243	        // Keep selected hit visible in the viewport.
244	        let sel_start = row_start_of(hits, sel);
245	        let sel_end   = sel_start + hits.get(sel).map_or(1, rows_for_hit);
246	        if sel_start < scroll               { scroll = sel_start; }
247	        else if sel_end > scroll + content_h { scroll = sel_end.saturating_sub(content_h); }
248	
249	        draw(stdout, hits, query, ms, sel, scroll, w, h)?;
250	
251	        match event::read()? {
252	            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {
253	                KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => break,
254	                KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if sel > 0 { sel -= 1; } }
255	                KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if sel + 1 < hits.len() { sel += 1; } }
256	                KeyCode::Char('g') => { sel = 0; scroll = 0; }
257	                KeyCode::Char('G') => { sel = hits.len().saturating_sub(1); }
258	                KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right | KeyCode::Enter => {
259	                    if let Some(hit) = hits.get(sel) {
260	                        execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
261	                        terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
262	
263	                        match hit.kind {
264	                            HitKind::Log => {
265	                                if let Some(id) = &hit.session_id {
266	                                    let _ = super::show::run_at(id, hit.start_ts.as_deref());
267	                                }
268	                            }
269	                            HitKind::Session => {
270	                                if let Some(id) = &hit.session_id {
271	                                    let _ = super::show::run(id);
272	                                }
273	                            }
274	                            HitKind::Repo => {
275	                                if let Some(dir) = &hit.repo_dir {
276	                                    let _ = super::status::run_for_dir(dir);
277	                                }
278	                            }
279	                        }
280	
281	                        terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();
282	                        execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();
283	                        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
284	                    }
285	                }
286	                _ => {}
287	            },
288	            Event::Resize(_, _) => {
289	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
290	            }
291	            _ => {}
292	        }
293	    }
294	
295	    Ok(())
296	}

298	fn rows_for_hit(hit: &SearchHit) -> usize {
299	    if hit.excerpt.is_empty() { 1 } else { 2 }
300	}

302	fn row_start_of(hits: &[SearchHit], idx: usize) -> usize {
303	    hits[..idx.min(hits.len())].iter().map(rows_for_hit).sum()
304	}

308	fn draw(
309	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
310	    hits:   &[SearchHit],
311	    query:  &str,
312	    ms:     u128,
313	    sel:    usize,
314	    scroll: usize,
315	    w:      usize,
316	    h:      usize,
317	) -> io::Result<()> {
318	    use crossterm::queue;
319	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
320	
321	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2); // title bar (row 0) + status bar (row h-1)
322	    let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity((w + 40) * (h + 2));
323	
324	    // ── Title bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
325	    queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
326	    let hdr = format!("  search: \"{}\"  {} result(s)  {}ms", query, hits.len(), ms);
327	    let hdr_t: String = hdr.chars().take(w).collect();
328	    write!(buf, "\x1b[1m{hdr_t}\x1b[0m")?;
329	
330	    // ── Results ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
331	    // Pre-compute column widths across all hits for tabular alignment.
332	    let name_w  = hits.iter().map(|h| h.title.trim().chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0).min(45);
333	    let agent_w = hits.iter().map(|h| h.agent.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
334	
335	    let mut screen_row = 1usize;
336	
337	    for (i, hit) in hits.iter().enumerate() {
338	        let flat_start = row_start_of(hits, i);
339	        let selected   = i == sel;
340	
341	        // ── Header row (sessions-screen style) ────────────────────────────
342	        let flat_hdr = flat_start;
343	        if flat_hdr >= scroll && screen_row <= content_h {
344	            let age       = age_secs_hit(&hit.updated_at);
345	            let dot_col   = match age {
346	                a if a < 900   => "38;5;82",
347	                a if a < 3_600 => "38;5;214",
348	                _              => "38;5;240",
349	            };
350	            let (name_col, meta_col, dot_char) = if hit.backed_up {
351	                ("1;38;5;255", "38;5;240", "*")
352	            } else {
353	                ("38;5;242", "38;5;238", "·")
354	            };
355	
356	            let name: String = hit.title.trim().chars().take(name_w).collect();
357	            let name_padded  = format!("{name:<name_w$}");
358	
359	            let mut hdr_line = format!(
360	                "\x1b[{dot_col}m{dot_char}\x1b[0m \x1b[{name_col}m{name_padded}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;240m{}\x1b[0m",
361	                hit.dir,
362	            );
363	
364	            if agent_w > 0 {
365	                let col = if hit.backed_up { agent_color(&hit.agent) } else { 239 };
366	                let a: String = hit.agent.chars().take(agent_w).collect();
367	                let pad = " ".repeat(agent_w - a.chars().count());
368	                hdr_line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[38;5;{col}m{a}{pad}\x1b[0m"));
369	            }
370	
371	            if let Some(sid) = &hit.session_id {
372	                let id_short: String = sid.chars().take(8).collect();
373	                let ts = rel_time_hit(&hit.updated_at);
374	                hdr_line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{meta_col}m{id_short}  {ts}\x1b[0m"));
375	            } else if matches!(hit.kind, HitKind::Repo) {
376	                hdr_line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{meta_col}mrepo\x1b[0m"));
377	            }
378	
379	            queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, screen_row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
380	            if selected {
381	                let colored = with_bg(&hdr_line, SEL_BG);
382	                let vis = visible_len(&hdr_line);
383	                let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);
384	                write!(buf, "\x1b[{SEL_BG}m{colored}{}\x1b[0m", " ".repeat(pad))?;
385	            } else {
386	                write!(buf, "{hdr_line}")?;
387	            }
388	            screen_row += 1;
389	        } else if flat_hdr < scroll {
390	            // above viewport — skip without advancing screen_row
391	        } else {
392	            break;
393	        }
394	
395	        // ── Excerpt row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
396	        if !hit.excerpt.is_empty() {
397	            let flat_exc = flat_start + 1;
398	            if flat_exc >= scroll && screen_row <= content_h {
399	                let exc_t: String = hit.excerpt.chars().take(w.saturating_sub(4)).collect();
400	                let exc_line = format!("    \x1b[38;5;242m{exc_t}\x1b[0m");
401	
402	                queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, screen_row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
403	                if selected {
404	                    let colored = with_bg(&exc_line, SEL_BG);
405	                    let vis = visible_len(&exc_line);
406	                    let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);
407	                    write!(buf, "\x1b[{SEL_BG}m{colored}{}\x1b[0m", " ".repeat(pad))?;
408	                } else {
409	                    write!(buf, "{exc_line}")?;
410	                }
411	                screen_row += 1;
412	            } else if flat_exc >= scroll {
413	                break;
414	            }
415	        }
416	    }
417	
418	    // Clear any leftover rows below the results.
419	    while screen_row <= content_h {
420	        queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, screen_row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
421	        screen_row += 1;
422	    }
423	
424	    // ── Status bar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
425	    let bar = "  ↑↓/jk: navigate   space/→: open   q/esc: quit  ";
426	    let bar_t: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();
427	    let padded = format!("{bar_t:<width$}", width = w);
428	    queue!(buf, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;
429	    write!(buf, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")?;
430	
431	    stdout.write_all(&buf)?;
432	    stdout.flush()
433	}

521	fn enrich_hits(hits: &mut Vec<SearchHit>) {
522	    let Ok(conn) = crate::db::connect() else { return };
523	    for hit in hits.iter_mut() {
524	        let Some(sid) = &hit.session_id else { continue };
525	        // session_id may be a full JSONL path — extract the UUID file stem if so
526	        let uuid: &str = if sid.contains('/') {
527	            std::path::Path::new(sid.as_str())
528	                .file_stem()
529	                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
530	                .unwrap_or(sid.as_str())
531	        } else {
532	            sid.as_str()
533	        };
534	        if let Ok((agent, updated_at)) = conn.query_row(
535	            "SELECT agent_name, updated_at FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?1",
536	            [uuid],
537	            |row| Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?)),
538	        ) {
539	            hit.agent      = agent;
540	            hit.updated_at = updated_at;
541	            hit.backed_up  = true;
542	        }
543	    }
544	}
545	
546	fn rel_time_hit(iso: &str) -> String {
547	    if iso.is_empty() { return String::new(); }
548	    let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(iso) else { return String::new(); };
549	    let secs = (Utc::now() - dt.with_timezone(&Utc)).num_seconds().max(0);
550	    if secs < 604_800 {
551	        match secs {
552	            s if s < 60     => "just now".into(),
553	            s if s < 3_600  => format!("{} min ago", s / 60),
554	            s if s < 86_400 => format!("{} hr ago", s / 3_600),
555	            s               => format!("{} day{} ago", s / 86_400, if s / 86_400 == 1 { "" } else { "s" }),
556	        }
557	    } else {
558	        dt.with_timezone(&chrono::Local).format("%m/%d/%y").to_string()
559	    }
560	}
561	
562	fn age_secs_hit(iso: &str) -> i64 {
563	    if iso.is_empty() { return i64::MAX; }
564	    let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(iso) else { return i64::MAX; };
565	    (Utc::now() - dt.with_timezone(&Utc)).num_seconds().max(0)
566	}

570	fn with_bg(s: &str, bg: &str) -> String {
571	    let reinsert = format!("\x1b[0m\x1b[{bg}m");
572	    let body = s.replace("\x1b[0m", &reinsert);
573	    format!("\x1b[{bg}m{body}")
574	}
575	
576	fn visible_len(s: &str) -> usize {
577	    let mut w = 0usize;
578	    let mut chars = s.chars().peekable();
579	    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
580	        if c == '\x1b' {
581	            for nc in chars.by_ref() { if nc.is_ascii_alphabetic() { break; } }
582	        } else {
583	            w += 1;
584	        }
585	    }
586	    w
587	}

589	fn short_path(path: &str) -> String {
590	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_default();
591	    if !home.is_empty() && path.starts_with(&home) {
592	        format!("~{}", &path[home.len()..])
593	    } else {
594	        path.to_string()
595	    }
596	}

600	        .file_name()
601	        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
602	        .unwrap_or_default()
603	}

114	fn find_session(id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
115	    let p = PathBuf::from(id);
116	    if p.exists() { return Some(p); }
117	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
118	    let projects = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
119	    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()? {
120	        let dir = entry.ok()?.path();
121	        let candidate = dir.join(format!("{id}.jsonl"));
122	        if candidate.exists() { return Some(candidate); }
123	    }
124	    None
125	}

             }\n            }\n            if let Some(matched) = bodies.get(sub_idx) {\n                let t: String = matched.trim().chars().take(400).collect();\n                if !t.is_empty() { excerpt_lines.push(t); }\n            }\n            if sub_idx + 1 < bodies.len() {\n                if let Some(next) = bodies.get(sub_idx + 1) {\n                    let t: String = next.trim().chars().take(220).collect();\n                    if !t.is_empty() { excerpt_lines.push(t); }\n                }\n            }\n\n            let hit_ts = if sub_idx > 0 {\n                meta[\"turns\"][sub_idx - 1][\"timestamp\"].as_str()\n                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n                    .map(str::to_string)\n            } else {\n                None\n session_id: meta[\"session_id\"].as_str().map(str::to_string),\n                repo_dir: None,\n                start_ts: hit_ts.clone(),\n                hit_ts,\n                branch,\n build_groups(hits: Vec<SearchHit>) -> Vec<Group> {\n    let mut groups: Vec<Group> = Vec::new();\n    let mut log_group_idx: std::collections::HashMap<String, usize> =                    lines: hit.excerpt_lines,\n                    });\n                } else {\n                    let gi = groups.len();\n                    if !sid.is_empty() { log_group_idx.insert(sid, gi); }\n                    groups.push(Group {\n                        title: hit.title,\n                        dir: hit.dir,\n                        branch: hit.branch,\n                        agent: hit.agent,\n                        backed_up: hit.backed_up,\n                        updated_at: hit.updated_at,\n                        session_id: hit.session_id,\n                        repo_dir: None,\n                        kind: HitKind::Log,\n                        rows: vec![GroupRow {\n                            hit_ts: hit.hit_ts,\n   agent: hit.agent,\n                    backed_up: hit.backed_up,\n                    updated_at: hit.updated_at,\n                    session_id: hit.session_id,\n                    repo_dir: None,\n                    kind: HitKind::Session,\n                    rows: vec![],\n                });\n            }\n            HitKind::Repo => {\n                groups.push(Group {\n &[Group], query: &str, ms: u128) -> Result<()> {\n    let mut sel    = 0usize;\n    let mut scroll = 0usize;\n\n    loop {\n        let (w, h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));\n        let w = w as usize;\n        let h = h as usize;\n        let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2);\n\n        let sel_start = group_start_of(groups, sel);\n        let sel_end   = sel_start + groups.get(sel).map_or(1, rows_for_group);\n        if sel_start < scroll                { scroll = sel_start; }\n        else if sel_end > scroll + content_h { scroll = sel_end.saturating_sub(content_h); }\n\n        draw(stdout, groups, query, ms, sel, scroll, w, h)?;\n\n        match event::read()? {\n            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {\n                KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => break,\n                KeyCode::Char('c') if k.modifiers.contains(crossterm::event::KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {\n                    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();\n                    terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();\n                    std::process::exit(0);\n                }\n                KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if sel > 0 { sel -= 1; } }\n                KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if sel + 1 < groups.len() { sel += 1; } }\n                KeyCode::Char('g') => { sel = 0; scroll = 0; }\n                KeyCode::Char('G') => { sel = groups.len().saturating_sub(1); }\n                KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right | KeyCode::Enter => {\n                    if let Some(group) = groups.get(sel) {\n                        execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();\n                        terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();\n\n                        match group.kind {\n                            HitKind::Log | HitKind::Session => {\n                                if let Some(id) = &group.session_id {\n                                    let ts = group.rows.first().and_then(|r| r.start_ts.as_deref());\n                                    let _ = super::show::run_at(id, ts);\n                                }\n                            }\n                            HitKind::Repo => {\n                                if let Some(dir) = &group.repo_dir {\n                                    let _ = super::status::run_for_dir(dir);\n                                }\n                            }\n                        }\n\n                        terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();\n                        execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();\n                        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {}\n rows_for_group(g: &Group) -> usize {\n    1 + g.rows.iter().map(|r| r.lines.len().max(1)).sum::<usize>()\n}\n\nfn group_start_of(groups: &[Group], idx: usize) -> usize {\n SEL_BG: &str  = \"48;5;236\";\n    const TS_W:   usize = 12; // fixed width of the timestamp column in excerpt rows\n\n    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2);\n    let mut buf: Vec<u8> = g.agent.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);\n    let branch_w = groups.iter().map(|g| g.branch.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0).min(30);\n\n    let mut screen_row = 1usize; // next terminal row to > AGENT

Done. Here's what changed in search results:

- **More context per hit**: Each match now shows up to 3 lines — the preceding turn (truncated to 220 chars), the matched turn (up to 400 chars), and the following turn (truncated to 220 chars). This gives you "before and after" context around each semantic hit.

- **Grouped by session**: Multiple hits from the same session appear under one shared header row. The session name, dir, agent, ID, and time are shown once; each matching turn is listed beneath with its own timestamp and context.

- **Timestamp per hit**: Each excerpt row is prefixed with a right-aligned relative timestamp (e.g., `2 hrs ago`, `3 days ago`) showing when that specific turn occurred.

- **Branch**: Shown after the dir in the session header, colored `38;5;75` (blue) for backed-up sessions — same color as in the sessions screen.

20	    /// Initialize gossamer in the current git repository
21	    Init,
22	    /// Print all repositories tracked by gossamer
23	    Repo,
24	    /// Print sessions from the past 3 days
25	    Sessions {
26	        /// Show all sessions regardless of age
27	        #[arg(long)]
28	        all: bool,
29	    },
30	    /// Scan checkpoint logs and index sessions into the database
31	    Index,
32	    /// Incrementally index only new checkpoint commits since the last index/refresh
33	    Refresh,
34	    /// Browse a session's messages interactively (arrow keys to navigate)
35	    Show {
36	        /// Session ID or path to a JSONL file
37	        session: String,
38	    },
39	    /// Semantic search across indexed sessions
40	    Search {
41	        /// Search query (separate words are joined into one query)
42	        #[arg(required = true)]
43	        query: Vec<String>,
44	        /// Number of results to return
45	        #[arg(short = 'n', long, default_value = "10")]
46	        top_k: usize,
47	    },
48	    /// Remove a session: runs `entire clean`, deletes from DB, removes search index entries
49	    Clean {
50	        /// Session ID to clean up
51	        session_id: String,
52	    },
53	    /// Attach an existing session with entireio and index it into witchcraft
54	    Attach {
55	        /// Session ID to attach
56	        session_id: String,
57	        /// Agent name passed to `entire attach`
58	        #[arg(short, long, default_value = "claude-code")]
59	        agent: String,
60	        /// Pass --force to `entire attach`
61	        #[arg(short, long)]
62	        force: bool,
63	    },
64	    /// Show or set gossamer configuration
65	    Config {
66	        /// Path to the witchcraft assets directory (enables semantic search)
67	        assets: Option<String>,
68	    },
69	    /// Called by the Claude Code SessionStart hook — reads JSON from stdin
70	    #[command(hide = true)]
71	    SessionStart,
72	    /// Called by the Claude Code Stop hook — ingests the finished session
73	    #[command(hide = true)]
74	    SessionStop,
75	}
76	
77	fn main() -> Result<()> {
78	    let cli = Cli::parse();
79	    match cli.command.unwrap_or(Commands::Repo) {
80	        Commands::Init => commands::init::run()?,
81	        Commands::Repo => commands::status::run()?,
82	        Commands::Sessions { all } => commands::sessions::run(all)?,
83	        Commands::Index => commands::index::run()?,
84	        Commands::Refresh => commands::refresh::run()?,
85	        Commands::Show { session } => commands::show::run(&session)?,
86	        Commands::Search { query, top_k } => commands::search::run(&query.join(" "), top_k)?,
87	        Commands::Clean { session_id } => commands::clean::run(&session_id)?,
88	        Commands::Attach { session_id, agent, force } => commands::attach::run(&session_id, &agent, force)?,
89	        Commands::Config { assets: Some(path) } => config::set_warp_assets(&path)?,
90	        Commands::Config { assets: None }       => config::show(),
91	        Commands::SessionStart => commands::session_start::run()?,
92	        Commands::SessionStop  => commands::session_stop::run()?,
93	    }
