36	    branch: Option<String>, // None = no new worktree
37	    session_name: String,
38	    prompt: String,
39	    repo_dir: String,
40	}
41	
42	// (display_name, cli_command, terminal_256_color)
43	const AGENTS: &[(&str, &str, u8)] = &[
44	    ("Claude Code", "claude", 214),
45	    ("Gemini CLI",  "gemini", 75),
46	    ("Aider",       "aider",  42),
47	];
48	
49	// ── Entry point ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
50	
51	pub fn run() -> Result<()> {
52	    let conn = db::connect()?;
53	    let repos = fetch_repos(&conn)?;
54	
55	    if repos.is_empty() {
56	        println!("No repositories tracked. Run `gossamer init` in a git repo to get started.");
57	        return Ok(());
58	    }
59	
60	    // The shell wrapper sets GOSSAMER_CDPATH to a temp file path.
61	    // We write the selected directory there instead of stdout, avoiding all
62	    // the stdout-capture / /dev/tty complexity.
63	    let cd_file = std::env::var("GOSSAMER_CDPATH").ok();
64	
65	    if !io::stdout().is_terminal() && cd_file.is_none() {
66	        // Plain list when truly non-interactive (piped, no wrapper)
67	        let cwd = env::current_dir().ok().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string());
68	        let current_dir = cwd.as_deref().and_then(|cwd| {
69	            repos.iter().find(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())).map(|r| r.directory.as_str())
70	        });
71	        for repo in &repos {
72	            let is_cur = current_dir == Some(repo.directory.as_str());
73	            let dot = if is_cur { "*" } else { " " };
74	            println!("{dot} {}  {}  {}", repo.name, repo.directory, repo.remote);
75	        }
76	        return Ok(());
77	    }
78	
79	    // Register panic hook to restore terminal
80	    let orig_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
81	    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
82	        let mut out = io::stdout();
83	        let _ = execute!(out, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show);
84	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
85	        orig_hook(info);
86	    }));
87	
88	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
89	    terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
90	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide)?;
91	
92	    let outcome = tui_loop(&mut stdout, &repos, cd_file.is_some(), None);
93	
94	    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show)?;
95	    terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;
96	
97	    match outcome? {
98	        Some(TuiOutcome::CdTo(path)) => {
99	            if let Some(file) = cd_file {
100	                std::fs::write(&file, &path)?;
101	            }
102	        }
103	        Some(TuiOutcome::ResumeSession { id, cwd }) => {
104	            super::show::resume_session(&id, &cwd);
105	        }
106	        Some(TuiOutcome::LaunchAgent { cli, cwd, session_name, prompt }) => {
107	            use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
108	            let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(&cli);
109	            if !cwd.is_empty() { cmd.current_dir(&cwd); }
110	            if !session_name.is_empty() { cmd.args(["-n", &session_name]); }
111	            if !prompt.is_empty() { cmd.arg(&prompt); }
112	            let err = cmd.exec();
113	            eprintln!("Failed to launch {cli}: {err}");
114	        }
115	        None => {}
116	    }
117	
118	    Ok(())
119	}
120	
121	enum TuiOutcome {
122	    CdTo(String),
123	    ResumeSession { id: String, cwd: String },
124	    LaunchAgent { cli: String, cwd: String, session_name: String, prompt: String },
125	}
126	
127	enum Screen {
128	    Repos { sel: usize },
129	    Sessions { repo_idx: usize, sel: usize, sessions: Vec<RepoSession>, worktrees: Vec<RepoWorktree> },
130	}
131	
132	fn tui_loop(stdout: &mut impl Write, repos: &[Repository], has_cd: bool, start_repo: Option<usize>) -> Result<Option<TuiOutcome>> {
133	    let cwd = env::current_dir().ok().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string());
134	    let current_repo_dir = cwd.as_deref().and_then(|cwd| {
135	        repos.iter().find(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())).map(|r| r.directory.as_str())
136	    });
137	
138	    let start_sel = cwd.as_deref()
139	        .and_then(|cwd| repos.iter().position(|r| cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str())))
140	        .unwrap_or(0);
141	
142	    let initial = if let Some(idx) = start_repo.filter(|&i| i < repos.len()) {
143	        let sessions = load_sessions(&repos[idx].directory);
144	        let worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[idx].directory);
145	        Screen::Sessions { repo_idx: idx, sel: 0, sessions, worktrees }
146	    } else {
147	        Screen::Repos { sel: start_sel }
148	    };
149	
150	    // Navigation stack — back pops; when empty the TUI exits.
151	    let mut stack: Vec<Screen> = vec![initial];
152	
153	    // Commands produced inside match arms, executed after the borrow ends.
154	    enum Cmd {
155	        None,
156	        Break,
157	        Back,
158	        PushSessions(usize),
159	        Cd(String),
160	        ShowSession(String),
161	        ResumeSession(String, String), // (session_id, repo_dir)
162	        Search(String),
163	        NewWorktree(String), // branch name
164	        NewSession(NewSessionConfig),
165	        Redraw,
166	    }
167	
168	    loop {
169	        let (w, h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
170	        let w = w as usize;
171	        let h = h as usize;
172	
173	        match stack.last().unwrap() {
174	            Screen::Repos { sel } => draw_repos(stdout, repos, *sel, current_repo_dir, w, h, has_cd)?,
175	            Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, sel, sessions, worktrees } => {
176	                draw_sessions(stdout, repos, *repo_idx, sessions, worktrees, *sel, w, h)?
177	            }
178	        }
179	
180	        let cmd = match event::read()? {
181	            Event::Key(k) => match stack.last_mut().unwrap() {
182	                Screen::Repos { sel } => match k.code {
183	                    KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => Cmd::Break,
184	                    KeyCode::Char('c') if k.modifiers.contains(crossterm::event::KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
185	                        execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
186	                        terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
187	                        std::process::exit(0);
188	                    }
189	                    KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if *sel > 0 { *sel -= 1; } Cmd::None }
190	                    KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if *sel + 1 < repos.len() { *sel += 1; } Cmd::None }
191	                    KeyCode::Char('g') => { *sel = 0; Cmd::None }
192	                    KeyCode::Char('G') => { *sel = repos.len().saturating_sub(1); Cmd::None }
193	                    KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right => Cmd::PushSessions(*sel),
194	                    KeyCode::Char('c') if has_cd => Cmd::Cd(repos[*sel].directory.clone()),
195	                    KeyCode::Char('s') => {
196	                        let repo_dir = repos[*sel].directory.clone();
197	                        match new_session_wizard(stdout, &repo_dir, w, h) {
198	                            Some(cfg) => Cmd::NewSession(cfg),
199	                            None => Cmd::Redraw,
200	                        }
201	                    }
202	                    KeyCode::Char('/') => match collect_search_query(stdout, w, h) {
203	                        Some(q) if !q.trim().is_empty() => Cmd::Search(q),
204	                        _ => Cmd::Redraw,
205	                    },
206	                    _ => Cmd::None,
207	                },
208	                Screen::Sessions { sel, sessions, repo_idx, .. } => match k.code {
209	                    KeyCode::Char('q') => Cmd::Break,
210	                    KeyCode::Char('c') if k.modifiers.contains(crossterm::event::KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
211	                        execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
212	                        terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
213	                        std::process::exit(0);
214	                    }
215	                    KeyCode::Esc | KeyCode::Char('h') | KeyCode::Left => Cmd::Back,
216	                    KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if *sel > 0 { *sel -= 1; } Cmd::None }
217	                    KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if *sel + 1 < sessions.len() { *sel += 1; } Cmd::None }
218	                    KeyCode::Char('g') => { *sel = 0; Cmd::None }
219	                    KeyCode::Char('G') => { *sel = sessions.len().saturating_sub(1); Cmd::None }
220	                    KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right => {
221	                        if sessions.is_empty() { Cmd::None }
222	                        else { Cmd::ShowSession(sessions[*sel].session_id.clone()) }
223	                    }
224	                    KeyCode::Char('r') => {
225	                        if sessions.is_empty() { Cmd::None }
226	                        else { Cmd::ResumeSession(sessions[*sel].session_id.clone(), repos[*repo_idx].directory.clone()) }
227	                    }
228	                    KeyCode::Char('/') => match collect_search_query(stdout, w, h) {
229	                        Some(q) if !q.trim().is_empty() => Cmd::Search(q),
230	                        _ => Cmd::Redraw,
231	                    },
232	                    KeyCode::Char('n') => match collect_text_input(stdout, "  new worktree branch: ", w, h) {
233	                        Some(b) if !b.trim().is_empty() => Cmd::NewWorktree(b.trim().to_string()),
234	                        _ => Cmd::Redraw,
235	                    },
236	                    KeyCode::Char('s') => {
237	                        let repo_dir = repos[*repo_idx].directory.clone();
238	                        match new_session_wizard(stdout, &repo_dir, w, h) {
239	                            Some(cfg) => Cmd::NewSession(cfg),
240	                            None => Cmd::Redraw,
241	                        }
242	                    }
243	                    _ => Cmd::None,
244	                },
245	            },
246	            Event::Resize(_, _) => Cmd::Redraw,
247	            _ => Cmd::None,
248	        };
249	
250	        match cmd {
251	            Cmd::None => {}
252	            Cmd::Break => break,
253	            Cmd::Back => {
254	                stack.pop();
255	                if stack.is_empty() { break; }
256	            }
257	            Cmd::PushSessions(idx) => {
258	                let sessions = load_sessions(&repos[idx].directory);
259	                let worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[idx].directory);
260	                stack.push(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx: idx, sel: 0, sessions, worktrees });
261	            }
262	            Cmd::Cd(path) => return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::CdTo(path))),
263	            Cmd::ResumeSession(id, cwd) => return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::ResumeSession { id, cwd })),
264	            Cmd::ShowSession(id) => {
265	                execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
266	                terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
267	                let _ = super::show::run(&id);
268	                terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();
269	                execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();
270	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
271	            }
272	            Cmd::Search(query) => {
273	                execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
274	                terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
275	                let _ = super::search::run(&query, 10);
276	                terminal::enable_raw_mode().ok();
277	                execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide).ok();
278	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
279	            }
280	            Cmd::NewWorktree(branch) => {
281	                if let Some(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, worktrees, .. }) = stack.last_mut() {
282	                    let repo_dir = &repos[*repo_idx].directory;
283	                    let notification = create_worktree(repo_dir, &branch);
284	                    // Refresh the worktree list whether or not it succeeded.
285	                    *worktrees = fetch_worktrees(repo_dir);
286	                    // Show the result in the status bar until the next keypress.
287	                    let (tw, th) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
288	                    let msg: String = notification.chars().take(tw as usize).collect();
289	                    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", msg, width = tw as usize);
290	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, th - 1)).ok();
291	                    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m").ok();
292	                    stdout.flush().ok();
293	                }
294	            }
295	            Cmd::NewSession(cfg) => {
296	                // Create worktree if requested, then launch the agent.
297	                let launch_dir = if let Some(ref branch) = cfg.branch {
298	                    let _ = create_worktree(&cfg.repo_dir, branch);
299	                    if let Some(Screen::Sessions { repo_idx, worktrees, .. }) = stack.last_mut() {
300	                        *worktrees = fetch_worktrees(&repos[*repo_idx].directory);
301	                    }
302	                    let repo_path = std::path::Path::new(&cfg.repo_dir);
303	                    let parent = repo_path.parent().unwrap_or(repo_path);
304	                    let repo_name = repo_path.file_name()
305	                        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
306	                        .unwrap_or_else(|| "repo".to_string());
307	                    parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{}", branch)).to_string_lossy().to_string()
308	                } else {
309	                    cfg.repo_dir.clone()
310	                };
311	
312	                // Copy prompt to clipboard as a convenience.
313	                let prompt = cfg.prompt.trim().to_string();
314	                if !prompt.is_empty() {
315	                    if let Ok(mut child) = std::process::Command::new("pbcopy")
316	                        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
317	                        .spawn()
318	                    {
319	                        if let Some(stdin) = child.stdin.as_mut() {
320	                            let _ = stdin.write_all(prompt.as_bytes());
321	                        }
322	                        let _ = child.wait();
323	                    }
324	                }
325	
326	                let session_name = cfg.session_name.trim().to_string();
327	                return Ok(Some(TuiOutcome::LaunchAgent {
328	                    cli: cfg.agent_cli,
329	                    cwd: launch_dir,
330	                    session_name,
331	                    prompt,
332	                }));
333	            }
334	            Cmd::Redraw => { execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok(); }
335	        }
336	    }
337	
338	    Ok(None)
339	}
340	
341	// ── Renderers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
342	
343	fn draw_repos(
344	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
345	    repos: &[Repository],
346	    sel: usize,
347	    current_repo_dir: Option<&str>,
348	    w: usize,
349	    h: usize,
350	    has_cd: bool,
351	) -> io::Result<()> {
352	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
353	
354	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
355	
356	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(1);
357	    let mut row = 0usize;
358	
359	    let name_w = repos.iter().map(|r| r.name.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
360	    let dir_w  = repos.iter().map(|r| r.directory.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
361	
362	    for (i, repo) in repos.iter().enumerate() {
363	        if row >= content_h { break }
364	
365	        let is_sel = i == sel;
366	        let is_cur = current_repo_dir == Some(repo.directory.as_str());
367	        let dot_col = if is_cur { "38;5;82" } else { "38;5;240" };
368	
369	        let name_padded = format!("{:<name_w$}", repo.name);
370	        let dir_padded  = format!("{:<dir_w$}",  repo.directory);
371	        let line = format!(
372	            "\x1b[{dot_col}m*\x1b[0m \x1b[38;5;255m{name_padded}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;240m{dir_padded}  {}\x1b[0m",
373	            repo.remote
374	        );
375	
376	        print_row(stdout, &line, is_sel, SEL_BG, w, row as u16)?;
377	        row += 1;
378	    }
379	
380	    // Clear remaining rows
381	    while row < content_h {
382	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
383	        row += 1;
384	    }
385	
386	    // Status bar
387	    let cd_hint = if has_cd { "   c: cd" } else { "" };
388	    let bar = format!(
389	        "  {} repos   ↑↓/jk navigate   space: sessions   s: new session   /: search{}   q: quit  ",
390	        repos.len(), cd_hint
391	    );
392	    draw_status(stdout, &bar, w, h)?;
393	
394	    stdout.flush()
395	}
396	
397	fn draw_sessions(
398	    stdout: &mut impl Write,
399	    repos: &[Repository],
400	    repo_idx: usize,
401	    sessions: &[RepoSession],
402	    worktrees: &[RepoWorktree],
403	    sel: usize,
404	    w: usize,
405	    h: usize,
406	) -> io::Result<()> {
407	    const SEL_BG: &str = "48;5;236";
408	
409	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
410	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[1;38;5;229m{}\x1b[0m", repos[repo_idx].name)?;
411	    execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
412	
413	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(2); // header + status bar
414	    let mut row = 1usize;
415	
416	    // ── Worktrees ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
417	    if !worktrees.is_empty() {
418	        for wt in worktrees.iter().take(content_h.saturating_sub(row + 1)) {
419	            if row >= content_h { break; }
420	
421	            let (branch_col, branch_label) = if wt.branch == "(detached)" {
422	                ("38;5;196", format!("detached:{}", &wt.head))
423	            } else if wt.is_main {
424	                ("38;5;229", wt.branch.clone())   // gold — main worktree
425	            } else {
426	                ("38;5;75",  wt.branch.clone())   // blue — linked worktree
427	            };
428	
429	            let path_short = short_path_s(&wt.path);
430	            let line = format!(
431	                "\x1b[38;5;240m  @ \x1b[{branch_col}m{branch_label}\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;240m{path_short}\x1b[0m"
432	            );
433	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16))?;
434	            write!(stdout, "{line}")?;
435	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
436	            row += 1;
437	        }
438	
439	        // Blank separator between worktrees and sessions
440	        if row < content_h {
441	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
442	            row += 1;
443	        }
444	    }
445	
446	    // ── Sessions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
447	    let sessions_start = row;
448	    let sessions_h = content_h.saturating_sub(sessions_start);
449	    let scroll = if sel >= sessions_h { sel + 1 - sessions_h } else { 0 };
450	
451	    if sessions.is_empty() {
452	        if row < content_h {
453	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16))?;
454	            write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;240m  no sessions found\x1b[0m")?;
455	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
456	            row += 1;
457	        }
458	    } else {
459	        // Pre-compute column widths for table alignment
460	        let name_w   = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.session_name.trim().chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0).min(40);
461	        let branch_w = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.branch.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
462	        let agent_w  = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.agent.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
463	
464	        for (i, s) in sessions.iter().enumerate().skip(scroll) {
465	            if row >= content_h { break; }
466	
467	            let id_short: String = s.session_id.chars().take(8).collect();
468	            let ts = relative_time(s.updated_at);
469	            let name: String = s.session_name.trim().chars().take(name_w).collect();
470	            let age = (Utc::now() - s.updated_at).num_seconds().max(0);
471	            let dot_col = match age {
472	                a if a < 900   => "38;5;82",
473	                a if a < 3_600 => "38;5;214",
474	                _              => "38;5;240",
475	            };
476	
477	            let (name_col, meta_col, dot_char) = if s.backed_up {
478	                ("1;38;5;255", "38;5;240", "*")
479	            } else {
480	                ("38;5;242", "38;5;238", "·")
481	            };
482	            let branch_col = if s.backed_up { "38;5;75" } else { "38;5;239" };
483	
484	            let name_padded = format!("{:<name_w$}", name);
485	            let mut line = format!("\x1b[{dot_col}m{dot_char}\x1b[0m \x1b[{name_col}m{name_padded}\x1b[0m");
486	
487	            if branch_w > 0 {
488	                let b: String = s.branch.chars().take(branch_w).collect();
489	                let pad = " ".repeat(branch_w - b.chars().count());
490	                line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{branch_col}m{b}{pad}\x1b[0m"));
491	            }
492	
493	            if agent_w > 0 {
494	                let col = if s.backed_up { agent_color(&s.agent) } else { 239 };
495	                let a: String = s.agent.chars().take(agent_w).collect();
496	                let pad = " ".repeat(agent_w - a.chars().count());
497	                line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[38;5;{col}m{a}{pad}\x1b[0m"));
498	            }
499	
500	            line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{meta_col}m{id_short}  {ts}\x1b[0m"));
501	
502	            print_row(stdout, &line, i == sel, SEL_BG, w, row as u16)?;
503	            row += 1;
504	        }
505	    }
506	
507	    while row < content_h {
508	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16), terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
509	        row += 1;
510	    }
511	
512	    let bar = format!(
513	        "  {} sessions   ↑↓/jk navigate   space: view   r: resume   s: new session   n: new worktree   /: search   ←/h: back   q: quit  ",
514	        sessions.len()
515	    );
516	    draw_status(stdout, &bar, w, h)?;
517	
518	    stdout.flush()
519	}
520	
521	fn print_row(stdout: &mut impl Write, line: &str, selected: bool, bg: &str, w: usize, row: u16) -> io::Result<()> {
522	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row))?;
523	    if selected {
524	        let colored = with_bg(line, bg);
525	        let vis = visible_width(line);
526	        let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);
527	        write!(stdout, "\x1b[{bg}m{colored}{}\x1b[0m", " ".repeat(pad))?;
528	    } else {
529	        write!(stdout, "{line}")?;
530	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
531	    }
532	    Ok(())
533	}
534	
535	fn draw_status(stdout: &mut impl Write, bar: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
536	    let display: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();
537	    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", display, width = w);
538	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;
539	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")
540	}
541	
542	// ── Worktree loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
543	
544	fn fetch_worktrees(repo_dir: &str) -> Vec<RepoWorktree> {
545	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
546	        .args(["worktree", "list", "--porcelain"])
547	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
548	        .output();
549	
550	    let Ok(out) = out else { return vec![]; };
551	    if !out.status.success() { return vec![]; }
552	    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
553	
554	    let mut result = Vec::new();
555	    let mut first = true;
556	
557	    // Each worktree block is separated by a blank line.
558	    for block in text.split("\n\n") {
559	        let mut path = String::new();
560	        let mut head = String::new();
561	        let mut branch = String::new();
562	        let mut detached = false;
563	
564	        for line in block.lines() {
565	            if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("worktree ") {
566	                path = v.to_string();
567	            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("HEAD ") {
568	                head = v.chars().take(8).collect();
569	            } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("branch refs/heads/") {
570	                branch = v.to_string();
571	            } else if line == "detached" {
572	                detached = true;
573	            }
574	        }
575	
576	        if path.is_empty() { continue; }
577	        if detached { branch = "(detached)".to_string(); }
578	        if branch.is_empty() { continue; } // bare worktree — skip
579	
580	        result.push(RepoWorktree { path, branch, head, is_main: first });
581	        first = false;
582	    }
583	
584	    result
585	}

587	// ── Session loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
588	
589	fn load_sessions(cwd_prefix: &str) -> Vec<RepoSession> {
590	    let mut sessions: Vec<RepoSession> = Vec::new();
591	
592	    // From DB
593	    if let Ok(conn) = db::connect() {
594	        if let Ok(mut stmt) = conn.prepare(
595	            "SELECT session_id, session_name, updated_at, agent_name FROM sessions WHERE cwd LIKE ?1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC"
596	        ) {
597	            let prefix_pattern = format!("{cwd_prefix}%");
598	            let _ = stmt.query_map([&prefix_pattern], |row| {
599	                let ts_str: String = row.get(2)?;
600	                let updated_at = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str)
601	                    .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))
602	                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now());
603	                Ok(RepoSession {
604	                    session_id: row.get(0)?,
605	                    session_name: row.get(1)?,
606	                    updated_at,
607	                    branch: String::new(),
608	                    agent: row.get(3)?,
609	                    backed_up: true,
610	                })
611	            }).map(|rows| {
612	                for r in rows.flatten() { sessions.push(r); }
613	            });
614	        }
615	    }
616	
617	    // From ~/.claude/projects/ — refresh existing DB sessions and add new ones
618	    if let Ok(home) = std::env::var("HOME") {
619	        let projects = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
620	        if let Ok(dirs) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects) {
621	            for dir_entry in dirs.flatten() {
622	                let dir = dir_entry.path();
623	                if !dir.is_dir() { continue }
624	                if let Ok(files) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) {
625	                    for f in files.flatten() {
626	                        let path = f.path();
627	                        if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some("jsonl") { continue }
628	                        let session_id = match path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
629	                            Some(s) => s.to_string(),
630	                            None => continue,
631	                        };
632	
633	                        let file_mtime = f.metadata().ok()
634	                            .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
635	                            .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
636	                            .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
637	
638	                        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&path) else { continue };
639	                        let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);
640	                        let mut session_name = String::new();
641	                        let mut cwd_found = String::new();
642	                        let mut last_prompt = String::new();
643	                        let mut git_branch = String::new();
644	
645	                        for line in reader.lines().flatten() {
646	                            let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };
647	                            match v["type"].as_str() {
648	                                Some("custom-title") => {
649	                                    if let Some(t) = v["customTitle"].as_str() { session_name = t.to_string(); }
650	                                }
651	                                Some("user") | Some("system") => {
652	                                    if cwd_found.is_empty() {
653	                                        if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str() { cwd_found = c.to_string(); }
654	                                    }
655	                                }
656	                                _ => {}
657	                            }
658	                            if v["type"].as_str() == Some("user") {
659	                                if let Some(t) = user_text(&v["message"]["content"]) {
660	                                    last_prompt = t;
661	                                }
662	                            }
663	                            // Track the most recent branch seen in this session
664	                            if let Some(b) = v["gitBranch"].as_str() {
665	                                if !b.is_empty() { git_branch = b.to_string(); }
666	                            }
667	                        }
668	
669	                        let display_name = if !session_name.is_empty() { session_name } else { last_prompt };
670	
671	                        if let Some(existing) = sessions.iter_mut().find(|s| s.session_id == session_id) {
672	                            // Refresh the name, timestamp, and branch from live JSONL
673	                            if !display_name.is_empty() { existing.session_name = display_name; }
674	                            if file_mtime > existing.updated_at { existing.updated_at = file_mtime; }
675	                            if !git_branch.is_empty() { existing.branch = git_branch; }
676	                            continue;
677	                        }
678	
679	                        if !cwd_found.starts_with(cwd_prefix) { continue }
680	
681	                        sessions.push(RepoSession {
682	                            session_id,
683	                            session_name: display_name,
684	                            updated_at: file_mtime,
685	                            branch: git_branch,
686	                            agent: String::new(),
687	                            backed_up: false,
688	                        });
689	                    }
690	                }
691	            }
692	        }
693	    }
694	
695	    sessions.sort_by(|a, b| b.updated_at.cmp(&a.updated_at));
696	    sessions
697	}

701	/// Generic single-line input shown in the status bar. Returns None on Esc.
702	fn collect_text_input(stdout: &mut impl Write, prefix: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<String> {
703	    let mut value = String::new();
704	    execute!(stdout, cursor::Show).ok();
705	    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
706	
707	    loop {
708	        match event::read().ok()? {
709	            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {
710	                KeyCode::Esc => {
711	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::Hide).ok();
712	                    return None;
713	                }
714	                KeyCode::Enter => {
715	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::Hide).ok();
716	                    return Some(value);
717	                }
718	                KeyCode::Backspace => {
719	                    value.pop();
720	                    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
721	                }
722	                KeyCode::Char(c) => {
723	                    value.push(c);
724	                    draw_input_bar(stdout, prefix, &value, w, h).ok();
725	                }
726	                _ => {}
727	            },
728	            _ => {}
729	        }
730	    }
731	}
732	
733	fn draw_input_bar(stdout: &mut impl Write, prefix: &str, value: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
734	    let prefix_len = prefix.chars().count();
735	    let text: String = value.chars().take(w.saturating_sub(prefix_len + 2)).collect();
736	    let content = format!("{prefix}{text}");
737	    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", content, width = w);
738	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;
739	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")?;
740	    let col = (prefix_len + text.chars().count()).min(w.saturating_sub(1)) as u16;
741	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(col, (h - 1) as u16))?;
742	    stdout.flush()
743	}
744	
745	fn collect_search_query(stdout: &mut impl Write, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<String> {
746	    collect_text_input(stdout, "  / ", w, h)
747	}

749	// ── New session wizard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
750	
751	/// A 4-step panel drawn over the bottom of the screen. Each completed step
752	/// stays visible with its confirmed value while the user fills the next one.
753	fn new_session_wizard(stdout: &mut impl Write, repo_dir: &str, w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<NewSessionConfig> {
754	    const LABEL_W: usize = 24;
755	    // Panel rows: title, blank, agent, branch, name, prompt, blank  (7 rows + 1 status bar)
756	    const PANEL_H: usize = 7;
757	
758	    let panel_top = h.saturating_sub(PANEL_H + 1);
759	
760	    let mut step = 0usize;           // 0=agent 1=branch 2=name 3=prompt
761	    let mut agent_sel = 0usize;
762	    let mut confirmed_agent = 0usize;
763	    let mut inputs = [String::new(), String::new(), String::new()]; // branch, name, prompt
764	
765	    execute!(stdout, cursor::Show).ok();
766	
767	    loop {
768	        // ── Draw panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
769	        // Title row
770	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, panel_top as u16)).ok();
771	        write!(stdout, "\x1b[1;38;5;229m  New Session\x1b[0m").ok();
772	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine)).ok();
773	
774	        // Blank separator
775	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (panel_top + 1) as u16)).ok();
776	        execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine)).ok();
777	
778	        let step_rows  = [panel_top + 2, panel_top + 3, panel_top + 4, panel_top + 5];
779	        let step_labels = ["  Agent", "  Worktree branch", "  Session name", "  Prompt"];
780	
781	        for (i, (&row, &label)) in step_rows.iter().zip(step_labels.iter()).enumerate() {
782	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16)).ok();
783	            let lpart = format!("{label:<LABEL_W$}");
784	
785	            if i < step {
786	                // Completed — dim label, value in colour
787	                let val = if i == 0 {
788	                    let (name, _, col) = AGENTS[confirmed_agent];
789	                    format!("\x1b[38;5;{col}m{name}\x1b[0m")
790	                } else {
791	                    let v = inputs[i - 1].trim();
792	                    if v.is_empty() { "\x1b[38;5;238m(skip)\x1b[0m".to_string() }
793	                    else            { format!("\x1b[38;5;255m{v}\x1b[0m") }
794	                };
795	                write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;240m{lpart}\x1b[0m{val}").ok();
796	            } else if i == step {
797	                // Active step
798	                write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;255m{lpart}\x1b[0m").ok();
799	                if i == 0 {
800	                    // Inline agent picker
801	                    for (ai, (name, _, col)) in AGENTS.iter().enumerate() {
802	                        if ai > 0 { write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;238m │ \x1b[0m").ok(); }
803	                        if ai == agent_sel {
804	                            write!(stdout, "\x1b[48;5;236;38;5;{col}m {name} \x1b[0m").ok();
805	                        } else {
806	                            write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;240m {name}\x1b[0m").ok();
807	                        }
808	                    }
809	                } else {
810	                    // Text input — print typed chars, terminal cursor sits here
811	                    write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;255m{}\x1b[0m", inputs[i - 1]).ok();
812	                }
813	            } else {
814	                // Future step — very dim label only
815	                write!(stdout, "\x1b[38;5;238m{lpart}\x1b[0m").ok();
816	            }
817	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine)).ok();
818	        }
819	
820	        // Trailing blank row
821	        let blank2 = panel_top + 6;
822	        if blank2 < h.saturating_sub(1) {
823	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, blank2 as u16)).ok();
824	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine)).ok();
825	        }
826	
827	        // Status bar hint
828	        let bar = if step == 0 {
829	            "  ↑↓/jk: select agent   enter: confirm   esc: cancel  "
830	        } else {
831	            "  type to enter   enter: next   esc: cancel  "
832	        };
833	        draw_status(stdout, bar, w, h).ok();
834	
835	        // Position terminal cursor for text input steps
836	        if step > 0 {
837	            let row = step_rows[step];
838	            let col = (LABEL_W + inputs[step - 1].len()).min(w.saturating_sub(1));
839	            execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(col as u16, row as u16)).ok();
840	        }
841	        stdout.flush().ok();
842	
843	        // ── Handle input ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
844	        match event::read().ok()? {
845	            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {
846	                KeyCode::Esc => {
847	                    execute!(stdout, cursor::Hide).ok();
848	                    return None;
849	                }
850	                KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') if step == 0 => {
851	                    if agent_sel > 0 { agent_sel -= 1; }
852	                }
853	                KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') if step == 0 => {
854	                    if agent_sel + 1 < AGENTS.len() { agent_sel += 1; }
855	                }
856	                KeyCode::Backspace if step > 0 => {
857	                    inputs[step - 1].pop();
858	                }
859	                KeyCode::Char(c) if step > 0 && !k.modifiers.contains(crossterm::event::KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
860	                    inputs[step - 1].push(c);
861	                }
862	                KeyCode::Enter => match step {
863	                    0 => { confirmed_agent = agent_sel; step = 1; }
864	                    1 | 2 => { step += 1; }
865	                    _ => {
866	                        execute!(stdout, cursor::Hide).ok();
867	                        let (agent_name, agent_cli, _) = AGENTS[confirmed_agent];
868	                        let branch_raw = inputs[0].trim().to_string();
869	                        return Some(NewSessionConfig {
870	                            agent_name: agent_name.to_string(),
871	                            agent_cli: agent_cli.to_string(),
872	                            branch: if branch_raw.is_empty() { None } else { Some(branch_raw) },
873	                            session_name: inputs[1].trim().to_string(),
874	                            prompt: inputs[2].trim().to_string(),
875	                            repo_dir: repo_dir.to_string(),
876	                        });
877	                    }
878	                },
879	                _ => {}
880	            },
881	            _ => {}
882	        }
883	    }
884	}

888	fn create_worktree(repo_dir: &str, branch: &str) -> String {
889	    let repo_path = std::path::Path::new(repo_dir);
890	    let parent = match repo_path.parent() {
891	        Some(p) => p,
892	        None => return "Error: cannot determine repo parent directory".to_string(),
893	    };
894	    let repo_name = repo_path
895	        .file_name()
896	        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
897	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "repo".to_string());
898	    let wt_path = parent.join(format!("{repo_name}-{branch}"));
899	
900	    // Try -b (new branch) first; fall back to checking out an existing branch.
901	    let out = std::process::Command::new("git")
902	        .args(["worktree", "add", "-b", branch, wt_path.to_str().unwrap_or("")])
903	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
904	        .output();
905	
906	    match out {
907	        Err(e) => format!("Error: {e}"),
908	        Ok(o) if o.status.success() => {
909	            format!("Created worktree: {}", short_path_s(wt_path.to_str().unwrap_or("")))
910	        }
911	        Ok(o) => {
912	            let msg = String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stderr);
913	            let first = msg.lines().find(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).unwrap_or("unknown error");
914	            format!("Error: {first}")
915	        }
916	    }
917	}

937	                } else { None }

950	fn visible_width(s: &str) -> usize {
951	    let mut w = 0usize;
952	    let mut chars = s.chars().peekable();
953	    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
954	        if c == '\x1b' {
955	            for nc in chars.by_ref() { if nc.is_ascii_alphabetic() { break; } }
956	        } else {
957	            w += 1;
958	        }
959	    }
960	    w
961	}

963	fn relative_time(dt: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
964	    let secs = (Utc::now() - dt).num_seconds().max(0);
965	    if secs < 604_800 {
966	        match secs {
967	            s if s < 60     => "just now".to_string(),
968	            s if s < 3_600  => format!("{} min{} ago", s/60,     if s/60==1     {""} else {"s"}),
969	            s if s < 86_400 => format!("{} hr{} ago",  s/3_600,  if s/3_600==1  {""} else {"s"}),
970	            s               => format!("{} day{} ago", s/86_400, if s/86_400==1 {""} else {"s"}),
971	        }
972	    } else {
973	        dt.with_timezone(&Local).format("%m/%d/%y").to_string()
974	    }
975	}

977	pub fn run_for_dir(repo_dir: &str) -> Result<()> {
978	    let conn = db::connect()?;
979	    let repos = fetch_repos(&conn)?;
980	    let start = repos.iter().position(|r| r.directory == repo_dir);
981	
982	    let orig_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
983	    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
984	        let mut out = io::stdout();
985	        let _ = execute!(out, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show);
986	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
987	        orig_hook(info);
988	    }));
989	
990	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
991	    terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
992	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, cursor::Hide)?;
993	
994	    let outcome = tui_loop(&mut stdout, &repos, false, start);
995	
996	    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show)?;
997	    terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;
998	
999	    match outcome? {
1000	        Some(TuiOutcome::ResumeSession { id, cwd }) => {
1001	            super::show::resume_session(&id, &cwd);
1002	        }
1003	        Some(TuiOutcome::LaunchAgent { cli, cwd, session_name, prompt }) => {
1004	            use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
1005	            let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(&cli);
1006	            if !cwd.is_empty() { cmd.current_dir(&cwd); }
1007	            if !session_name.is_empty() { cmd.args(["-n", &session_name]); }
1008	            if !prompt.is_empty() { cmd.arg(&prompt); }
1009	            let err = cmd.exec();
1010	            eprintln!("Failed to launch {cli}: {err}");
1011	        }
1012	        _ => {}
1013	    }
1014	
1015	    Ok(())
1016	}

1018	pub fn fetch_repos(conn: &rusqlite::Connection) -> Result<Vec<Repository>> {
1019	    let mut stmt = conn.prepare("SELECT id, directory, remote, name FROM repositories ORDER BY name")?;
1020	    let repos = stmt.query_map([], |row| {
1021	        Ok(Repository {
1022	            id: row.get(0)?,
1023	            directory: row.get(1)?,
1024	            remote: row.get(2)?,
1025	            name: row.get(3)?,
1026	        })
1027	    })?
1028	    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
1029	    Ok(repos)
1030	}

9	/// Resolve a session identifier (UUID or name) to the UUID used as the JSONL file stem.
10	/// Priority: exact session_id in DB → session_name in DB → customTitle scan of JSONL files → input as-is.
11	fn resolve_session_id(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, input: &str) -> String {
12	    if conn.query_row(
13	        "SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?1",
14	        rusqlite::params![input], |_| Ok(()),
15	    ).is_ok() {
16	        return input.to_string();
17	    }
18	
19	    if let Ok(id) = conn.query_row(
20	        "SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE session_name = ?1 LIMIT 1",
21	        rusqlite::params![input], |row| row.get::<_, String>(0),
22	    ) {
23	        return id;
24	    }
25	
26	    if let Some(id) = find_jsonl_by_title(input) {
27	        return id;
28	    }
29	
30	    input.to_string()
31	}
32	
33	fn find_jsonl_by_title(title: &str) -> Option<String> {
34	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
35	    let projects = std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
36	    for dir in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()?.flatten() {
37	        for file in std::fs::read_dir(dir.path()).ok()?.flatten() {
38	            let path = file.path();
39	            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some("jsonl") { continue; }
40	            let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) else { continue };
41	            for line in content.lines() {
42	                let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(line) else { continue };
43	                if v["type"].as_str() == Some("custom-title")
44	                    && v["customTitle"].as_str() == Some(title)
45	                {
46	                    if let Some(stem) = path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
47	                        return Some(stem.to_string());
48	                    }
49	                }
50	            }
51	        }
52	    }
53	    None
54	}
55

1	use anyhow::{Context, Result};
2	use std::process::Command;
3	
4	use crate::{ingest, watermark};
5	
6	pub fn run(session_id: &str, agent: &str, force: bool) -> Result<()> {
7	    let mut cmd = Command::new("entire");
8	    cmd.arg("attach").arg(session_id);
9	    if !agent.is_empty() && agent != "claude-code" {
10	        cmd.args(["--agent", agent]);
11	    }
12	    if force {
13	        cmd.arg("--force");
14	    }
15	
16	    let status = cmd.status().context("failed to run `entire attach`")?;
17	    if !status.success() {
18	        anyhow::bail!("`entire attach` exited with status {}", status);
19	    }
20	
21	    // Clear watermark so the newly attached session (whose JSONL mtime may be
22	    // older than the watermark) gets picked up by the ingest scan.
23	    let wm = watermark::claude_path();
24	    if wm.exists() {
25	        std::fs::remove_file(&wm).ok();
26	    }
27	
28	    let mut wc_db = ingest::open_search_db()?;
29	    let turns = ingest::claude_code::ingest_claude_code(&mut wc_db)?;
30	    if turns > 0 {
31	        println!("{turns} turn(s) ingested.");
32	        ingest::embed_and_index(&wc_db)?;
33	    } else {
34	        println!("No new turns to index.");
35	    }
36	
37	    Ok(())
38	}
39

> AGENT

Done. Every command now accepts `--json`. The three data commands produce rich output:

- **`gossamer repo --json`** → `{ "repos": [{ "name", "directory", "remote", "worktrees": [...], "sessions": [...] }] }`
- **`gossamer sessions --json`** → `{ "sessions": [{ "session_id", "session_name", "cwd", "branch", "agent", "updated_at", "backed_up" }] }`
- **`gossamer search "query" --json`** → `{ "query", "results": [{ "kind", "session_id", "session_name", "dir", "branch", "agent", "hits": [{ "timestamp", "excerpt" }] }] }`

The operational commands (`index`, `refresh`, `attach`, `clean`) suppress human-readable progress output and emit a JSON summary instead. `init` accepts the flag but is a wizard so it behaves normally regardless.
